Descriptions are the listing agents' words: a fact is used only where two or more listings agree.

descriptions.desc: Come experience Coastal living at its Best in Tidewater Plantation! Welcome to this beautifly 3BR/2BA single story home located in the highly sought-after gated community of Tidewater Plantation in the Cherry Grove area of North Myrtle Beach. This inviting home features a bright, open floor plan with high ceiling and custom crown molding and a comfortable layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Recent updates provide added peace of mind and energy efficiency, including a NEW ROOF installed in 2025 and fully paid-for solar panels added in 2026. The home also features a convenient Tesla charger hookup. Tidewater Plantation offers an exceptional coastal lifestyle with amenities that are truly second to none. Residents enjoy a 24/7 manned gated entrance, multiple pools, clubhouse, fitness center and a private oceanfront beach cabana exclusively for Tidewater owners. Conveniently located just minutes from the beach and all that North Myrtle Beach and the surrounding Grand Strand have to offer, you'll have endless opportunities for shopping, dining, golf, entertainment, and activities for the whole family!

Check out this stunning under construction home expected to be complete in early Spring with options for reasonable selections to be made. Fully custom 3 bedroom / 2 bath, 1 level home located in private community known as Tidewater Plantation.! As soon as you walk through the front door you cant help to notice no detail left behind. Featuring a gourmet chiefs kitchen with range cooktop, hood, wall oven/microwave and refrigerator included!! Tons of cabinets space and walk in pantry with custom built inns to complete the kitchen. Home will feature a luxury vinyl plank throughout and beautiful must see Calcutta Gold tile in the bathrooms. Quartz is finished throughout the entire home with a healthy amount of counter space. This home has its own laundry utility room with extra cabinets for storage. This floorplan has that open concept with dinning, living, kitchen room combo. Large living room with electric fireplace and coffered ceilings. Oversized master suite with double trey ceilings and master bath that will instantly grab your attention. Huge fully custom shower with rainfall shower and bench. Split vanities for his and hers and a very large desirable fully finished walk in closet !! Enjoy your day in the Carolinas sitting back watchin tv on your bigger than average covered porch equipped for a complete outdoor kitchen. Fully landscaped all around the home with trees, shrubs. The home is in the heart of the Plantation minutes away from Tidewater amenities, including the jewel in the crown of a gated ocean front beach cabana for owner's use. Tidewater also has an overflow parking lot to accommodate owners. Tidewater Golf Course was named the best golf course in the nation in 2022! In addition to golf & being in an ICW community near the beach, Tidewater boasts many other rich, upscale amenities, including that owners' beach cabana on the Cherry Grove Beach, named the 11th best in the nation, featuring driving range and putting green. There's more: 24-hour gated, manned, roving security, and a newly remodeled state of the art amenities center, a clubhouse with bar & restaurants. There is even a complimentary gated storage yard for boats, campers, recreational vehicles and the like. The on-site, convenient HOA building has rooms for business and other meetings and events and a lending library. There are many clubs and activities year-round. In Tidewater, you can do it all, or just relax in the Tidewater lifestyle. On the Plantation side, the Intracoastal Waterway backs up to and meanders along the golf course, stunning. This home is highly sought after for primary or vacation homeowner who desires to acquire an extraordinary golf/ICW/beach property. Ask for a tour of it all plus, pools, tennis, fitness, dining and highlights of North Myrtle Beach. Owners are licensed South Carolina real estate agents.

Open the door to exceptional golf-course living in Tidewater Plantation! Custom built and lovingly maintained by its original owner, this inviting home combines peaceful surroundings, beautiful views and flexible living spaces—all within one of North Myrtle Beach's most desirable golf communities. Wood flooring enhances the main living areas, while comfortable carpeting warms the bedrooms, including newly installed carpet in the primary suite. A formal dining room welcomes entertaining, complemented by a convenient dry bar and beverage refrigerator. Plantation shutters and light-filtering window treatments add both style and privacy throughout much of the home. The real showstopper is the golf-course view stretching across the rear of the home. Enjoy the scenery from the primary bedroom, kitchen and breakfast area, Carolina room, screened porch, deck and second bedroom. The spacious kitchen provides abundant workspace and pantry storage, while the laundry room includes a utility sink for added convenience. Bedrooms two and three share a Jack-and-Jill bath with dual sinks. Upstairs, a large bonus room offers tremendous flexibility as a media room, office, hobby space, guest retreat or fourth bedroom, along with easily accessible storage. Need room for vehicles, tools, hobbies and recreational gear? The oversized 600+ square-foot garage delivers exceptional space and possibilities. A new roof and newer HVAC system add even more value. This entire package is tucked away down a longer driveway and nestled in the trees. At the street and front of the house, one has no immediate neighbor with a traffic island acting as a separator and the golf course buffers the rear of the property for maximum privacy, peace and quiet. Tidewater Plantation offers an impressive amenity package including three pools, tennis, clay tennis, pickleball, bocce, fitness facilities and activity space, plus an oceanfront owners' cabana in Cherry Grove with reserved owner parking. Enjoy quiet golf-course surroundings at home, then venture out to the beaches, restaurants, shopping, entertainment and year-round activities of North Myrtle Beach and the Grand Strand. This is more than a home—it's an opportunity to enjoy the Tidewater lifestyle. Open the door and discover it for yourself!

ASK YOUR REALTOR ABOUT LENDER AND RATE INFO. The golf course greets you at the front door of this Mediterranean home in Tidewater Plantation, where arched openings and rounded corners draw the eye to a two-story arched window wall framing the fairway, greens, and pond. Imported tile, stone, and mahogany millwork carry through four bedrooms, three full baths, and a half bath, with an interior elevator serving both floors. The living room features a gas fireplace and built-ins, flowing to a formal dining room under a coffered tray ceiling. The glass-walled Carolina room brings the 14th green into everyday life, made for morning coffee and evening wind-downs. The kitchen is built for entertaining, with solid cherry cabinetry, a Wolf gas range beneath a brick arch, Sub-Zero refrigerator and ice maker, new double wall ovens and dishwasher, wine cooler, granite counters, a work island, breakfast bar, and walk-in pantry. The first-floor primary suite offers dual walk-in closets and a spa-style bath with a whirlpool tub, dual vanities, tiled shower, and stained glass window. A second bedroom, half bath, den, and laundry complete the main level. Upstairs, a second primary suite opens to a balcony over the course, joined by a fourth bedroom with full bath and a 26-foot recreation room for media, games, or bonus living space. Outside, a brick paver patio and rear porch shaded by grand oaks, a deck, a front porch, and irrigation fill the 0.26-acre lot. Updates include a whole-home generator, three AC units (two replaced in 2024), a new water heater, and propane service. Tidewater Plantation is a gated golf community on the Intracoastal Waterway with an oceanfront beach cabana and parking at Cherry Grove, pools and hot tubs, tennis, pickleball, bocce, a fitness center, and a clubhouse. Golf course living comes together in Tidewater Plantation, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582. Measurements are not guaranteed. Buyer is responsible for verifying.

Welcome to this exceptional home in Tidewater Plantation, one of North Myrtle Beach’s premier gated communities, known for its championship golf course, Intracoastal Waterway, and breathtaking marsh surroundings. Perfectly situated on an oversized lot in the highly desirable Bluffs section, this impressive residence offers nearly 3,000 heated square feet and just under 4,000 square feet under roof. From the moment you step into the foyer, you’ll appreciate the spacious layout and distinctive character of this home. The expansive family room features a vaulted ceiling, creating a bright and open gathering space, while the formal dining room provides an elegant setting for entertaining. French doors from the family room open to a large screened porch and patio overlooking the 14th hole of the Tidewater Golf Course — an ideal place to relax, enjoy the view, or host family and friends. The eat-in kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring 42-inch solid wood cabinetry, granite countertops, a large breakfast bar, and a generous pantry. Just beyond the kitchen, a comfortable den offers additional living space for relaxing or entertaining. The spacious primary suite is a true retreat, complete with vaulted ceilings, private access to the screened porch, and a luxurious bath with dual vanities, a whirlpool tub, walk-in shower, and a large walk-in closet. Two additional well-sized bedrooms are located on the main level, while the bonus room above the oversized garage includes its own full bath, making it ideal for guests, a home office, or a private flex space. Additional highlights include a sizable workshop just off the garage and impact glass windows throughout, eliminating the need for hurricane shutters. This home truly has it all, complemented by Tidewater Plantation’s outstanding amenities, including three swimming pools, a fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, and a private beach cabana just minutes away. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, entertainment, and everything North Myrtle Beach has to offer, this is a rare opportunity to own a remarkable home in one of the area’s most sought-after communities. Schedule your private showing today — this beautiful home is ready to welcome its next owner

Wow! Meticulously kept, fully upgraded (inside and out), gorgeous home along with an extra lot in the prestigious Tidewater community in North Myrtle Beach! The large homesite and extra lot, totaling just over one acre, create a huge natural buffer with so much elbow room, along with the versatility to sell off the extra lot. The first things you’ll notice in this serene setting are the incredible curb appeal (front and back) and the huge 50’ x 10’ front porch with a large porch swing. Exterior features and upgrades include beautiful new grass (2025) with a 10-zone irrigation system, new high-end exterior paint (2024), full roof replacement in 2023 with three powered fans and a ridge vent, new gutters and downspouts (2023), oversized driveway, new concrete walkway with an inset flower bed, rear grilling area with lighting, 3-hole mini golf course, paved brick seating area, horseshoe pit, enclosed 10’ x 14’ rear sunroom with windows installed in 2023, garden tool shed on the back of the house, new exterior spotlights, and a large two-car garage with cabinets and an additional room that could potentially be converted into a third garage bay. Inside, you’ll find four large bedrooms, an office with a window, and two oversized walk-in attic areas offering tons of storage. As you walk through the front door, you’ll immediately notice the abundance of natural light, new glass windows in the dining room, 12’ ceilings in the living and dining room areas, and 10’ ceilings throughout the remaining rooms on the first floor. The primary suite is conveniently located on the main level. Additional upgrades include two separate HVAC systems, a fully painted interior (2024), flat ceilings throughout, even in the closets, new door handles and hinges, new weather stripping on the doors, new LVP flooring, new carpet on the second floor, beautiful stained stairs with spindles and railings, propane fireplace with a new façade, custom built-ins, wide crown molding, all-new ceiling fans (2025), gorgeous fixtures, and LED recessed lighting. The beautiful kitchen features all-new GE Café appliances (2025), built-in refrigerator, new cabinets extending all the way to the ceiling, a huge island with an open sink, quartz countertops, beverage refrigerator, dimmable accent lighting with glass-front cabinets, dimmable under-cabinet lighting, two 8’ tall pantries, large adjustable range hood fan that vents to outside, and dedicated appliance storage to conceal small appliances. This must-see home has everything and is in the prestigious Tidewater golf community, offering an oceanfront cabana for owners, multiple pools and hot tubs, tennis courts, pickleball, bocce ball, and a fitness center. The community is fully gated with 24-hour security. An exceptional home on two lots in one of the premier communities of the Grand Strand!

Welcome to 820 Morrall Drive, an exquisite residence located in the exclusive Bluffs at Tidewater Plantation, a highly sought-after gated golf course community in North Myrtle Beach, SC. Recognized as the top golf course in 2022, and under new PGA ownership, this world-class community offers 24-hour security and a wealth of amenities. This stunning one-and-a-half-story home, situated on a quiet corner lot, is a rare find with its brick and cement board siding and convenient side-loading garage. The inviting covered front porch, complete with rocking chairs, sets the stage for relaxed Southern living. Step inside to discover an elegant interior with 12-foot ceilings, extensive molding, and architectural columns. The spacious living area boasts abundant natural light, plantation shutters installed in 2024, recessed lighting, and a gas-log fireplace. The well-appointed kitchen features upgraded cabinets with soft-close features, a new stainless steel refrigerator and five-burner gas stove, both installed in 2024, and a new garbage disposal installed in July 2023. The primary suite opens to the expansive back deck and offers a tranquil retreat, while the bathrooms showcase marble tile and high-rise toilets upgraded within the past year. The home includes three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and an upper-level bonus/flex space with the potential for a future third bathroom. Ample storage, including floored attic space, enhances functionality. Thoughtfully designed for accessibility, the home features a ramp in the garage and wider doorways. Outdoors, enjoy serene views of mature, wooded landscaping from the large back deck. The Bluffs at Tidewater Plantation offers exceptional amenities, including exclusive access to a private pool for Bluff residents, plus a private beach cabana with a kitchen, elevator, changing rooms, and private parking. The community also features five pools, a fitness center, tennis courts, pickleball, bocce ball court, restaurant, and a vibrant social scene with a monthly newsletter and resident website. Owners receive discounted golf memberships and are just minutes from the beach. Don’t miss this exceptional opportunity to own a beautifully upgraded home in one of North Myrtle Beach’s most prestigious communities!

An exceptional blend of elegance and serene coastal living awaits in the prestigious gated golf community of Tidewater Plantation. Nestled between the Intracoastal Waterway and the gorgeous beaches of the Atlantic Ocean in North Myrtle Beach, this exceptional home offers the perfect balance of luxury, privacy, and an unparalleled coastal lifestyle. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac overlooking the scenic 7th fairway, this like-new luxury residence showcases beautiful upgrades, meticulous maintenance, and picturesque golf course views while offering privacy and tranquility just minutes from the beach, premier shopping, dining, and entertainment. Thoughtfully designed for refined coastal living, this stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home features TWO EN SUITE BEDROOMS on the main level, including a luxurious primary suite. Just off the foyer, a private office provides the perfect work-from-home space and includes a built-in queen Murphy bed and closet, allowing the room to easily function as comfortable guest accommodations when needed. Elegant luxury vinyl plank flooring flows throughout the home, complemented by gorgeous granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a gas range, and a tankless water heater. Custom cabinetry with convenient pull-out shelving enhances both functionality and style. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with multiple inviting spaces, including a charming front porch, a screened porch off the main living area, and an expansive balcony off the upstairs loft—perfect for relaxing while taking in tranquil fairway views. Upstairs also offers a spacious walk-in attic with impressive storage, an uncommon and highly desirable feature in newer homes. The climate-controlled garage is a standout, showcasing pristine epoxy flooring and a mini-split system that creates a clean, comfortable space ideal for vehicles, hobbies, fitness, or workshop use. Built in 2022 with upgrades throughout, this exceptional home offers the rare opportunity to enjoy newer construction within one of North Myrtle Beach's most sought-after gated communities. Residents of Tidewater Plantation enjoy resort-style amenities, including a championship golf course, clubhouse, fitness center, swimming pools, tennis courts, scenic walking trails, and exclusive access to a private oceanfront beach cabana with parking, making beach days effortless while maintaining the peaceful atmosphere of this premier golf course community. PARTIAL OWNER FINANCING WILL BE CONSIDERED.

Come and experience this custom built, 4-bedroom, 3 full bath home situated along the 2nd fairway of the prestigious Tidewater Golf Club. This property has been lovingly maintained by its only owner, and it shows. The open floor plan features multiple living spaces -- one boasting a beautiful gas fireplace with accompanying built-ins, the other touting a triple slider offering access to a substantial back deck. The kitchen comes equipped with abundant cabinetry, work island, double ovens and a pantry while the owner's suite contains a bay window, tray ceiling, two sinks, shower and a whirlpool tub. The bonus room over the garage could serve as a fourth bedroom or multiple other functions with its own bathroom upstairs. Tidewater is a gated community tucked along the Intracoastal Waterway offering 24-hour security and world-class amenities featuring a championship golf course with clubhouse and restaurant, pools, tennis courts, fitness facility, oceanfront beach cabana and so much more. Call your agent and schedule a showing today!

Nestled within the gated golf course community of Tidewater Plantation, this stunning 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom home offers serene pond views, a park-like setting with mature trees and lush landscaping, and beautifully updated living spaces designed for comfort and entertaining. Filled with an abundance of natural light, the open floor plan features a spacious living room with a tray ceiling and a gas fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the main living areas. The open kitchen is equipped with Corian countertops, a large breakfast bar, eating nook, and walk-in pantry with custom shelving, while the formal dining area provides the perfect setting for family meals and gatherings. The private primary suite is tucked away from the additional bedrooms and showcases large windows overlooking the peaceful pond, a tray ceiling, and two walk-in closets. Enter the spa-like primary bathroom through elegant pocket doors where you'll find a tiled walk-in shower, jetted tub, and custom freestanding dual sink vanity. Two additional bedrooms and a guest bathroom are thoughtfully positioned at the front of the home, offering added privacy for family and guests. Large sliding glass doors in both the living room and dining room open to the oversized back porch and expansive backyard, creating the perfect indoor-outdoor living experience with tranquil pond views. Additional features include a large laundry room with utility sink, countertops, and cabinetry, a convenient half bath accessible through pocket doors, and an attached 2-car garage. Residents and guests of Tidewater Plantation enjoy exceptional amenities including a gated entrance, championship golf course, clubhouse, pools, tennis courts, fitness center, walking trails, and private oceanfront beach cabana. Located in the heart of North Myrtle Beach, you'll be just minutes from beautiful beaches, waterfront dining, shopping, entertainment, marinas, and all the attractions the Grand Strand has to offer. Be sure to ask your agent about the lender credit being offered! Some photos in this listing have been virtually staged.

Just listed in the gated community of Tidewater Plantation, this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 3 full bath home is ideally located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac and includes a 3-car garage. An inviting front porch welcomes you, while the spacious back patio offers a private outdoor retreat perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Inside, the large windows fill the home with abundant natural light throughout the day. A generous flex room over the garage provides versatile living space suitable for a bonus room, home office, guest suite or media room. The desirable split bedroom floor plan offers added privacy, and the primary suite features a large walk-in closet. Pride of ownership is evident throughout this move in ready home. Tidewater Plantation offers outstanding amenities, including championship golf, a beautiful clubhouse, multiple swimming pools, tennis and pickle ball courts, a private beach cabana, a fitness center and a beautiful amenity center.

Located in the exclusive, gated community of Tidewater Plantation, this 4 bedroom, 4 bathroom home is the definition of coastal luxury. From real hardwood floors throughout to a private elevator and temperature-controlled wine room, every detail was designed to impress. The custom kitchen is a true centerpiece, while three back porches give you front-row views of both the golf course and marsh. Spa-like bathrooms with stone showers add the perfect finishing touch. Top tier amenities include private beach cabana with parking, state of the art fitness center, tennis and pickleball, on site dining, clubhouse, owners pools, and more. This home is a must see. Schedule your private showing before it’s gone.

Beautiful 3BR 2.5BA Lowcountry style home in Tidewater Plantation featuring rare pond views and a private wooded setting. Enjoy peaceful water views from the living room, breakfast area, screened porch, and main level primary suite. Open floor plan with vaulted ceilings, engineered hardwood flooring, crown molding, and a fireplace with gas logs. The kitchen offers 42” cabinetry, two pantries, excellent storage, and flows seamlessly into the main living spaces. The primary suite is located on the first floor and includes dual closets and a spacious bath with convenient access to the oversized laundry room. Upstairs provides flexible space ideal for guests, plus additional storage including a climate controlled bonus room. Additional features include Andersen low E windows, central vacuum system, large covered front porch, screened in lanai, irrigation system, two car garage, dual HVAC units. Located in a 24 hour gated golf community offering pools, tennis courts, fitness center, on site dining, and private oceanfront beach cabana access. Just minutes to the beach!

Recent Price Adjustment, This home is priced to sell and totally move in ready. If you have seen this home before, you must check out the new updates. Laundry room is newly renovated to make the home more accommodating. New Neutral paint in Living areas and master bathroom. Welcome to your new home in the highly sought-after Tidewater Plantation gated community. This unique 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence features a beautiful sunroom and is one of the few homes in the community with a fully fenced backyard, installed three years ago. Brand new Leafguard gutter system installed this year. The property has been meticulously maintained, with a roof replaced four years ago and both bathrooms completely remodeled within the last two years. The interior boasts hardwood flooring throughout most living areas, complemented by ceramic tile in the kitchen, the primary bedroom, and both bathrooms. Closets in all 3 bedrooms have custom shelving. The kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring granite countertops, a kitchen island with a custom wooden topper, an extended layout with ample custom cabinetry, and a spacious pantry. The home also includes an upgraded laundry room and a two-car garage, recently updated with a new door motor and a new side entryway door. Outside, the expansive tiled porch includes a Sunsetter shade, providing the perfect space to enjoy your large, private backyard. Owners in Tidewater Plantation enjoy the privacy and security of a gated community with 24 hour monitored entry. Also, 2 large pools with Hot Tubs, a newly renovated Amenity Center, Fitness Center, Tennis and Pickleball courts and a beautiful Beach Cabana located at 58th and Ocean that allows for easy parking at the beach. The Cabana has a kitchen, bathrooms, tables and chairs and a large deck with pool chairs overlooking the Ocean. Separate document with all updates is uploaded in the document section. Owner is a SC Real Estate Licensee.

Gorgeous fit and finishes in this fully custom, 4 bedroom (plus huge loft), 3 ½ bathroom, spacious home with 3470 heated/cooled square feet and 4730 under roof. So many upgrades on this estate lot, located directly on the 1st hole tee box on the pristine Tidewater Golf Club golf course. This very high efficiency, better than new home has so much to offer including amazing views, tremendous curb appeal, gorgeous architecture, three car side load garage, huge screened-in porch with 20 ft. ceilings and sunshades, Hardee Board siding, private setting, amazing views, professionally landscaped, irrigation system, large driveway and sidewalk, grill area, patio space, 2x6 exterior walls, beautiful entryway with a wood ceiling and double doors. Coffered ceilings at the entry way, soaring ceilings throughout, extensive molding and trim, hardwood and tile flooring, wide baseboards, plantation shutters custom built-ins, large living space, fireplace with mantle, formal dining room with extensive crown molding, large windows to let in lots of light, beautiful fixtures and fans throughout, gorgeous kitchen, high end GE Café stainless steel appliances, propane gas stove, large pantry, upgraded cabinets with soft close door and drawers, granite countertops throughout, large counter peninsula, breakfast nook, ground floor master suite, with huge walk-in closet and custom shelves, jetted tub, walk-in tiled shower with glass doors, double vanities, wide staircase leading up to the loft area (overlooking living area) and other bedrooms, wonderful guest suite with sitting area and three closets, flex room with glass doors, breakfast nook, and upgraded secondary bathrooms. This well built, meticulously kept, custom home has it all, including low energy costs! Located in a park-like setting, close to the clubhouse and access to all Tidewater has to offer, including an oceanfront cabana, many pools and hot tubs, tennis courts, pickleball court, bocce ball court and fitness center. The community is fully gated with 24-hour security. An exceptional home in a special location, within one of the premier communities of the Grand Strand.

Discover the perfect blend of coastal relaxation and championship golf living in the prestigious, gated community of Tidewater Plantation—specifically within the highly sought-after...THE BLUFFS, one of the most exclusive enclaves in the neighborhood. The Bluffs offers its own private gate, pool, and bocce courts, creating a quieter, more intimate setting while still enjoying full access to Tidewater’s world-class amenities. Nestled between the Intracoastal Waterway and Cherry Grove Beach, this beautifully maintained and move-in-ready 3-bedroom, 3-bath residence delivers an exceptional lifestyle just minutes from the coast. Fresh professional interior paint provides a crisp, modern feel throughout. The thoughtfully designed split-bedroom floor plan features a spacious primary suite on the main level, along with a guest bedroom, full bath, and a versatile study/den ideal for a home office or flex space. Vaulted and cathedral ceilings highlight the open living area, anchored by abundant natural light and a seamless flow between living, dining, and kitchen spaces—perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen is both functional and inviting with stainless steel appliances, work island, breakfast bar, pantry, and generous cabinetry. A combination of casual and formal dining areas allows flexibility for both intimate meals and larger gatherings. Upstairs, a private third bedroom with its own full bath and creates an ideal retreat for guests or extended stays. Enjoy peaceful marsh views of Cherry Grove from the front porch and upstairs bedroom. The backyard backs to a scenic Tidewater common area, providing additional privacy and the comfort of knowing no homes can be built behind you. You’re also just a short walk to the Bluffside pool. Major updates include roof (2021), HVAC (2022), refrigerator (2025), microwave (2023), oven (2020), dishwasher (2019), plus a transferable gutter warranty—offering excellent peace of mind. Additional highlights include a screened porch, front and rear porches, side-load two-car garage, lawn sprinkler system, and ample storage. Tidewater Plantation residents enjoy resort-style living with a championship golf course, multiple pools, fitness center and amenity center, tennis and pickleball courts, walking trails, on-site club house dining, 24-hour guarded security, boat and RV storage, and exclusive private oceanfront beach cabana access in Cherry Grove—a rare and highly coveted perk. Whether you’re seeking a primary residence, second home, or long-term investment, this exceptional property delivers comfort, privacy, and unmatched lifestyle in one of North Myrtle Beach’s most desirable communities. Schedule your private showing today and experience The Bluffs at Tidewater.

Located within the gates of The Bluffs at Tidewater Plantation, this beautifully maintained and thoughtfully staged home offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of North Myrtle Beach’s most sought after lifestyle communities. Surrounded by mature trees and set along the golf course, the setting feels private and serene while still being moments from the coast. Offered fully furnished, this home is truly move in ready and ideal for a primary residence, second home, or refined coastal retreat. Inside, the layout is open and inviting with tall ceilings, abundant natural light, and a seamless flow between living, dining, and kitchen spaces. The main living area is anchored by a gas fireplace and framed by windows that capture peaceful golf course views, creating a comfortable yet elegant atmosphere for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen is both functional and attractive with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, classic backsplash, under cabinet lighting, a walk in pantry, and a breakfast nook that feels bright and welcoming. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring generous proportions, a spa like bathroom, a large walk in closet, and a sun filled Carolina room that overlooks the golf course. This flexible space works beautifully as a sitting area, exercise room, or quiet home office, with direct access to the expansive deck. Additional bedrooms are well positioned for privacy and comfort, and the home offers excellent storage throughout including the attic. The bonus room is very large and is a flexible space that could be great for guests or hobbies. Outdoor living is a highlight, with an oversized deck designed for both relaxation and entertaining. Whether enjoying morning coffee, hosting friends, or unwinding in the evening, the golf course backdrop adds to the ambiance. Tidewater Plantation is a gated and guarded golf course community situated between the Intracoastal Waterway and Cherry Grove beach. Residents enjoy many amenities including outdoor pools, tennis courts, a fitness center, clubhouse, and a private oceanfront beach cabana for the community. The community offers optional golf memberships along with a public restaurant located within Tidewater Plantation separate from HOA fees. Information has been provided to the best of our ability. All information should be verified and approved by buyer. Current owner's tax rate reflects non-primary status. Buyer's rate may differ, buyer to verify. Square footage is approximate and not guaranteed.

descriptions.desc: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled home in the desirable Seaside Plantation community, where elegance, comfort, and thoughtful design come together. From the moment you arrive, brick paver steps and a striking black double front door with frosted glass create an inviting first impression. Inside, the spacious foyer with crown molding opens to an impressive open-concept living area. Luxury vinyl flooring flows throughout the main level, complemented by tile flooring in the bathrooms and powder room. The living room features a tray ceiling with crown molding, two large ceiling fans, and a stunning fireplace (propane) surrounded by beautiful marble and a crisp white mantel. The gorgeous white kitchen is truly the heart of the home, featuring a decorative backsplash, 42-inch cabinetry with crown molding extending to the ceiling, glass-front cabinet doors, and an oversized island with seating for three and a sink overlooking the living room. The kitchen is appointed with elevated Monogram appliances (stove is nature gas), gold hardware and fixtures, a built-in microwave, oven, and large wine refrigerator. A spacious walk-in pantry with a beautiful wood door provides exceptional storage. The adjacent eat-in area comfortably accommodates a table for six or more and features a bay window with plantation shutters overlooking the backyard. A conveniently located powder room on the main level is finished with crown molding, while the spacious laundry room offers abundant cabinetry, quartz countertops, a utility sink, crown molding, and built-in storage. The primary suite is a private retreat, featuring a tray ceiling with crown molding, ceiling fan, plantation shutters, and a spacious walk-in closet with custom shelving, plus two additional closets and built-in storage. The spa-inspired primary bath showcases beautiful tile flooring, a white double vanity, floor-to-ceiling tile, a large double shower with elegant gold finishes, and a private water closet. Also located on the main level is a second primary suite designed with accessibility in mind. This spacious bedroom features crown molding, a large bay window for abundant natural light, and plantation shutters. A barn door opens to the private en-suite bath, complete with tile flooring and a floor-to-ceiling tiled shower. Upstairs, you'll find a versatile office/den/loft area with a charming nook and window, along with a spacious full bathroom featuring a tub/shower combination, tile surround extending to the ceiling, and a white vanity. The large upstairs bedroom offers plenty of room for a TV area and workspace, along with a walk-in closet, additional storage, ceiling fan, and blinds. A second upstairs bedroom features its own private bathroom, generous living space, walk-in closet, ceiling fan, and blinds. The garage provides additional convenience with built-in wooden shelving for organized storage. Step outside to your own private backyard oasis. The large screened-in porch features two ceiling fans and provides the perfect space for relaxing or entertaining. A stamped-concrete patio and additional grilling patio extend the outdoor living space. Mature, beautifully manicured landscaping surrounds the property, adding privacy, charm, and an established feel. This thoughtfully remodeled home offers exceptional indoor and outdoor living spaces, multiple en-suite bedrooms, elegant finishes, abundant storage, and a flexible floor plan designed for both everyday living and entertaining.

Experience timeless Lowcountry elegance just three blocks from the Atlantic in the gated Seaside Plantation community of North Myrtle Beach's Tilghman Beach section. This distinctive four-story Charleston-style residence offers 5+ bedrooms, 5.5 baths, 4,372 heated square feet, and approximately 7,160 total square feet, with exceptional craftsmanship and historically inspired details throughout. From the Buckingham slate circular driveway and mature Southern landscaping to the sweeping porches with custom-milled railings, the exterior makes a memorable first impression. A grand Charleston entry leads through a beautifully appointed breezeway featuring slate flooring, oyster tabby stucco, wood ceilings, and custom hardware. The private courtyard includes a guest suite with a gas fireplace, reclaimed wood mantel, wet bar, and black walnut cabinetry. Multiple outdoor spaces overlook landscaped terraces, a basketball court, and the lake, while two climate-controlled garages and a second gated driveway provide added convenience. The interior showcases heart pine floors, 12-foot ceilings, stained glass, custom millwork, black walnut accents, and Charleston-style windows. The living and dining spaces connect to a custom library and sun-filled Carolina room with expansive lake views. The gourmet kitchen features terracotta tile, a Wolf natural gas range, double refrigerators, custom cabinetry, wine storage, and a butler's pantry. The private primary suite opens to a Charleston porch and features walk-in closets and a luxurious bath with an oversized clawfoot tub. Additional bedrooms and the expansive fourth-floor loft offer flexible space for family, guests, recreation, and work, including a game room, built-in daybeds, second laundry area, and windowed cupola. An elevator was intentionally NOT incorporated in order to preserve the authentic character and architectural integrity of its historically inspired Charleston-style design. Three climate-controlled zones, tankless natural gas water heaters, irrigation, and extensive landscape lighting add modern convenience. Seaside Plantation offers a pool, clubhouse, recreation areas, and a golf-cart-friendly setting near the beach, Main Street, dining, shopping, and golf. This extraordinary property delivers a rare combination of Charleston-inspired architecture, custom craftsmanship, and coastal living.

Experience luxury coastal living in the prestigious gated community of Seaside Plantation, located just two blocks from the Atlantic Ocean. This beautifully maintained 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath home features soaring 10 foot ceilings, elegant tray ceilings, hardwood oak flooring, plantation shutters, a natural gas fireplace, and a chef’s kitchen with natural gas cooking. Designed for comfort and efficiency, the home includes a Rinnai tankless water heater, dual HVAC systems, an additional zoned mini split system, and a new roof installed in 2020. The oversized epoxy finished two car garage offers room for two vehicles plus a golf cart. Enjoy outdoor living in the private, fenced backyard complete with elevated landscaping, a screened porch, pergola, and a bright Carolina room. Residents of Seaside Plantation enjoy resort style amenities including a clubhouse, pool, heated spa, and an unbeatable location just moments from Main Street, shopping, dining, entertainment, and the beach. This is a rare opportunity to own an exceptional home in one of North Myrtle Beach’s most desirable gated communities.

Fresh and newly updated for you. New price, new LVP flooring throughout, new heat pump and air handler, new lights and ceiling fans, new door and bath hardware, new porch Eze-breeze windows, new paint, new washer and dryer, new smart home-app controlled garage door system, and a new smart device to control the sprinkler system, new stainless steel kitchen appliances and ALL in beautiful and gated Seaside Plantation. Just two blocks from the beach access, this 3 bedroom, all brick property offers fresh breezes, open space and scenic fresh-water lake views. In addition, this home is just a golf cart ride away from major shopping and dining, as well as Main Street North Myrtle Beach and Highway 17. Recently appraised between 775K and 785K , this comfortable residence is move in ready for you to add your personal touches and design. Not included in the 2,019 square footage is a large (293 sf) three season rear porch, with floor to ceiling stacking vinyl windows. You can have additional living space that is either totally closed in with Eze-Breeze vinyl windows, or totally screened. The spacious living room separates the large master suite from the two guest bedrooms, offering privacy to the owners. The en-suite master bath includes a water closet, garden tub, double sink vanity, new fixtures, a new glass shower door, and a large closet/room. The two guest bedrooms will provide a welcome respite for others. The gated and fully fenced rear yard, with bulkhead, allows privacy and views of the community monitored, fresh-water lake, where nature abounds. The landscaped yard is maintained by a new, fully programmable, app controlled irrigation control system. Residents of this exclusive gated enclave enjoy easy access to a premier amenity center, with a swimming pool, hot tub, and golf cart parking. Get easy living, and the best of everything with this beautiful, livable and updated property.

Located in the desirable Seaside Plantation community, this home offers a great opportunity in a convenient coastal location close to the beach, shopping, dining, golf, and everyday necessities. The listed square footage includes a heated and cooled bonus room, adding valuable extra space and flexibility. Please note that the bonus room is not fully finished and still needs flooring, trim, and other completion items. A few additional items throughout the home may also need to be finished, giving the next owner the opportunity to complete the final details to their own taste. With its added heated and cooled square footage, convenient location, and proximity to the beach, this property offers excellent potential and value.

This immaculate 4-bedroom, 3-bath all-brick home is a must-see in North Myrtle Beach. Offering an ideal blend of space and functionality, the main level features four bedrooms and three full baths, while a spacious bonus room above the three-car garage provides endless possibilities for a media room, home office, or guest retreat. The living room impresses with 12-foot ceilings, a cozy natural gas fireplace, and extensive molding and trim work, creating a refined, yet welcoming atmosphere. The kitchen is well-appointed with granite countertops, abundant cabinetry, and updated stainless steel appliances (2024). The kitchen opens seamlessly into a bright Carolina room and deck overlooking a serene lake and natural area—which makes the back patio, back porch, and backyard feel like your own private retreat. The formal dining room showcases decorative columns and a 12-foot tray ceiling, adding elegance to your gatherings. Perched high above the lake, this home enjoys beautiful, peaceful views and a unique sense of privacy within this neighborhood. Each of the four main-level bedrooms are generously sized and offer spacious closet space for you and your loved ones. Recent updates and highlights include a new roof (2026) with attic fans and fresh interior and exterior paint, all new smoke and carbon dioxide detectors, and wiring for EV charging. All appliances convey with the home. Additional features include a whole-home generator and a mini-split system for a heated and cooled garage—perfect for enjoying summers just steps from the beach. Located in the highly desirable Seaside Plantation, residents enjoy a gated setting with extensive features such as an amenity center, an active calendar of neighborhood events, a saltwater pool and hot tub, sidewalks on both sides of the newly repaved road (2025), and walking paths. This home is walking distance from multiple public beach access points, highly rated public schools, ample and diverse shopping establishments, robust dining and entertainment, golf courses, and local attractions and events too many to name. Owned by full-time residents who have poured a lot of energy and love into this property, 511 Seafarer Way is a unique opportunity to live east of Highway 17 in a truly memorable home.

Welcome to 517 Sea Island Way, a captivating residence nestled in the heart of North Myrtle Beach. This meticulously designed four-bedroom, three and one half bathroom home is a testament to modern elegance and functionality, offering a unique blend of comfort and luxury. Step inside to find a spacious layout featuring luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout, harmoniously paired with crown molding and trendy lighting fixtures. The heart of the home, the kitchen, boasts chef-grade appliances, generous cabinetry, and charming shiplap accents, creating a delightful space for culinary adventures. Each of the four oversized bedrooms offers a relaxing retreat, three of the oversized bedrooms are on the first floor… with the primary bedroom boasting updates to its en-suite bath. Upstairs, a guest room with a private full bath provides additional accommodation, ensuring comfort for all. Step outside to your personal oasis featuring a large porch overlooking a scenic lake. An outdoor kitchen with new appliances awaits your al fresco dining experiences, all set amidst premium landscaping that adds a touch of nature's beauty to this stunning property. Located within a gated community, this home offers access to an outdoor community pool, clubhouse, and hot tub, providing ample opportunities for relaxation and socializing. And the best part? You're just a few steps away from the Atlantic Ocean, offering endless possibilities for beachside activities or a quick golf cart ride to grocery stores and Main Street North Myrtle Beach famous for great food and home of The Shag dance! 517 Sea Island Way is more than just a home; it's a lifestyle. This property offers a perfect blend of tranquility and convenience, welcoming anyone who values quality living. Come and experience this remarkable residence for yourself.

Located just two short blocks from the beach, this beautiful luxury home in the quiet gated community of Seaside Plantation represents the best of life at the beach. This community boasts beautiful on-site amenities and outstanding social opportunities. It is also just a short walk or golf cart ride to the heart of main street, amazing local restaurants, grocery and nationally known stores, and shopping galore!! The home itself is a custom 3 bedroom/2.5 bath home with a lovely sunroom and spacious backyard. With entrances on both sides of the home, lots of parking space is available. Split floor plan provides fantastic spaces for guests, and backyard space is perfect for entertaining. Call or email for an appointment to view this home today, as it certainly will not last long!!! Also, be sure to check out the virtual tour online!!

Introducing this upscale 3 bedroom 2.5 bath home located in the popular & gated Seaside Plantation community. As you enter this captivating home you take notice of the elegance of this bright open floor plan that features wood look tile & carpet flooring, plantation blinds, smooth flat ceilings with crown moulding, a guest powder room, a graceful formal dining area with a single step tray ceiling & wainscoting, a comfortable living room with a coffered ceiling along a cozy gas log fireplace, showcases a 3 panel patio door that opens up to the enchanting screened-in back porch. The modern kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliance package with a gas range, granite counter tops, cabinets topped with crown moulding, tile back splash, a breakfast bar, a kitchen pantry, and a sunlit breakfast nook. The primary bedroom offers a single step tray veiling with a fan, a large walk-in closet, private access to the primary bath hosting vanity with dual sinks, a water closet, and a deluxe step-in shower. This delightful home is completed with two additional bedrooms, a full guest bath, a laundry room, and a two car side load attached garage. This home affords you easy access to the beach and golfing along with all of the other activities and happenings in North Myrtle Beach & Myrtle Beach including fun eateries, award winning off-Broadway shows, public fishing piers, and intriguing shopping adventures along the Grand Strand. Conveniently located to your everyday needs, including grocery stores, banks, post offices, medical centers, doctors’ offices, and pharmacies. Check out our state of the art 3-D Virtual Tour. Some photos have been virtually staged.

Great opportunity to purchase the lowest priced home in Seaside Plantation. Located just two short blocks from the Atlantic Ocean, residents of this prestigious gated North Myrtle Beach community also enjoy the convenience of being close to shopping, churches, restaurants, and world-class entertainment. Outstanding on-site amenities include an elegant community Amenity Center, swimming pool, heated spa, cornhole court, and golf cart parking

Welcome to 702 Compass Pointe Drive, a stunning all-brick residence located in the highly desirable, gated community of Seaside Plantation- just a short stroll (two blocks!) from the sparkling shores of the Atlantic Ocean. This elegant home boasts exceptional craftsmanship and upscale details throughout, including soaring 14-foot ceilings, rich hardwood flooring, crown molding, and classic plantation shutters. The spacious and light-filled living area features a cozy gas fireplace and ceiling fans for year-round comfort. The gourmet kitchen is designed for both functionality and style, complete with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinetry. The adjoining laundry room includes a utility sink and custom storage for added convenience. The first-floor primary suite is a true retreat, highlighted by a tray ceiling, generous walk-in closet, and a luxurious en-suite bath featuring a double vanity, jetted soaking tub, and a large walk-in shower. Two additional bedrooms are on the main level, while a fourth bedroom with a private bath is tucked above the garage, ideal for guests or a home office. Outside, enjoy the professionally designed paver driveway and patio, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The garage also includes a dedicated workshop/storage area. Seaside Plantation offers a gated entrance, beautiful amenities, and is within city limits, providing both tranquility and easy access to all the attractions, shopping, and dining North Myrtle Beach has to offer. Don't miss your chance to live in this coastal paradise and schedule your showing today!

Coastal living at its finest! Welcome to your dream home in one of North Myrtle Beach's most sought after gated communities! Just a short stroll (2 blocks!) from the beach! This beautifully maintained 3 bedroom, 2 bath all brick home blends coastal charm with modern comfort, offering both elegance and functionality. Step inside to find an open and inviting floor plan perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The Carolina room is filled with natural light and offers the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee or unwind after a day at the beach. Need more space? The bonus room is perfect for a home office, media room or just for guests. You will love the peace of mind that comes with living in a secure, gated community, and the unbeatable location near restaurants, shopping, golf courses, and of course...the beach!

Discover the perfect blend of elegance and comfort in this stunning Mediterranean-style home, nestled on a lake in the premiere gated community of Seaside Plantation in North Myrtle Beach. Featuring meticulously landscaped gardens, palm trees and brick pavers, this stately waterfront residence creates a serene and inviting atmosphere. As you step into the grand foyer, you are greeted with architecture and elegance. The primary suite with its own private wing, includes a luxurious bathroom, custom walk in closet and enclosed spa retreat overlooking the water. The main level is spacious and includes an additional bedroom with en-suite and a dedicated office. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring updated quartzite counter tops and modern appliances, ideal for cooking and entertaining. A seamless flow carries you through the dining area and living room with soaring cathedral ceilings, gas fireplace and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the home with natural light and spectacular water views. The second-floor features two bedrooms, a full bathroom and additional living space complete with a wet bar. The inviting second floor balcony provides an ideal retreat for guests seeking privacy and relaxation. For outdoor living, enjoy the screened porch retreat or step out to the private courtyard oasis that offers tranquility, making it ideal spot for entertaining or alfresco dining. This harmonious blend of indoor and outdoor living spaces ensures you can enjoy the serene surroundings year-round. Seaside Plantation is a premiere neighborhood that offers gated luxury living with amenities including a community center, swimming pool, heated spa and more. With just a short walk or golf cart ride to the beach, you're also minutes from local dining, shopping, golf and entertainment. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this stunning coastal home. Call today to schedule your private showing!

Check out this beautifully updated all-brick residence in the highly sought-after, gated community of Seaside Plantation in North Myrtle Beach! Perfectly located east of Highway 17 and less than a mile to the beach via 8th Avenue North, this home blends coastal convenience with timeless comfort. Offering 2,632 heated square feet on a single level, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home has been REFRESHED WITH NEUTRAL PAINT THROUGHOUT, REPAIRED FLOORING, NEW APPLIANCES, AND A NEW ROOF—making it truly move-in ready. Step inside to find a spacious living room with a vaulted ceiling and cozy fireplace, seamlessly flowing into the bright Carolina Room, where natural light and backyard views create the perfect space for relaxing or entertaining. The formal dining room, enhanced with wainscoting, provides a classic setting for special gatherings. The kitchen features granite countertops, new stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, a breakfast nook, and pantry, combining style and function for everyday living. A split-bedroom layout ensures privacy, with the expansive primary suite offering two walk-in closets plus a luxurious en suite bath with dual vanities, a jetted soaking tub, and separate shower. The primary bedroom also has direct access to the Carolina Room, extending the retreat feel. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed hall bath, while a convenient powder room serves guests. Outside, a large patio invites grilling, dining, and entertaining in a private setting. Practical features include a side-load garage with a mop sink, space for a workbench, and pull-down stairs to a floored attic—perfect for extra storage. Living in Seaside Plantation means enjoying exclusive amenities such as a clubhouse and swimming pool, all while being just moments from shopping, dining, golf courses, entertainment, and everyday conveniences. With easy golf cart access to Tilghman Estates and the beach, this property offers the perfect combination of coastal lifestyle and community living.

descriptions.desc: Welcome to exclusive gated community of Leatherleaf- located inside of Barefoot - this executive home features many many upgrades - All Brick home with 4 bedrooms and an office - formal dining room - family room- formal living room- The primary suite features a luxurious bath and one of the guest rooms has its own private full bath - A spacious heated and cooled sunroom with hot tub - and a large area for entertaining - This home sits on a lake with views of The Love Golf Course- enjoy all that Barefoot has to offer- BAREFOOT AMENITIES INCLUDE 4 NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP GOLF COURSES- A PRIVATE BEACH CABANA FOR OWNERS TO USE- A 5 MILE WALKING AND BIKING TRAIL - THE LARGEST POOL ON THE INTRACOASTAL- COMMUNITY POOL - MARINA - THE BEST SHOPPING AND DINING IN BAREFOOT LANDING - ALL OF THIS AND JUST A SHORT GOLF CART RIDE TO THE BEACH!!

This all-brick Bluffton floor plan is one of the most sought-after layouts in the gated community of Leatherleaf at Barefoot Resort & Golf, offering a bonus room that easily serves as a non-conforming fifth bedroom for added flexibility. Inside, the spacious primary suite features its own fireplace and an elegant en-suite bath, while formal living and dining rooms, a dedicated office, and a family room with a second fireplace surround a large gourmet kitchen built for entertaining. Set on a private .53-acre homesite, the beautifully landscaped lot provides exceptional privacy and opens to a screened lanai overlooking an oversized brick patio, ideal for outdoor gatherings or quiet relaxation. Recent updates include a new roof in 2020 and HVAC systems replaced in 2018, giving buyers added peace of mind. Leatherleaf's gated enclave is wrapped around a Fazio-designed golf course and center lake, and sits within Barefoot Resort & Golf, a 2,300-acre master-planned community just a mile and a half from the Atlantic Ocean along the Intracoastal Waterway. Residents enjoy access to four championship golf courses, a deep-water marina, miles of walking and biking paths, multiple community pools, on-site dining, a conference facility, and a private oceanfront cabana. Whether you're looking for a primary residence, a golf getaway, or an investment property, this Leatherleaf home delivers space, privacy, and resort-style living in one of the Grand Strand's premier gated communities.

BUY THE LOCATION. BUY THE SETTING. BUY THE SPACE. MAKE IT YOURS. Welcome to 5407 Phesant Drive, a custom brick home nestled within the exclusive, gated Leatherleaf community of Barefoot Resort and Golf. BONUS: Includes a highly valuable, transferable golf membership to the world-class Love, Norman, and Fazio courses! Overlooking the 17th fairway/tee box of the Davis Love course, this 5BR/4.5BA home boast unparalleled views and premium finishes, central vacuum, and alarm system. Open family room features coffered ceilings, custom moldings, fireplace, and built in audio flowing into a gourmet kitchen with cherry cabinets, granite, SS appliances, and a portable island. Formal dining room is perfect for entertaining. Desirable main-level living features 4 bedrooms on the 1st floor, including the primary suite, 2 bedrooms with a Jack and Jill bath and another bedroom/office with an ensuite bath. The second floor offers a private guest/mother-in-law suite with a full bath. Car lovers will thrive in the oversized 3-car garage complete with central vaccumn outlets and a large stone-paver driveway. End you day on the scenic back patio enjoying peaceful pond and golf course views. SELLER IS OFFERING A SUBSTANTIAL BUYER INCENTIVE CREDIT AT CLOSING! THIS CREDIT CAN BE APPLIED DIRECTLY TOWARD PROPERTY UPGRADES, CUSTOM HOME MODIFICATIONS, INSPECTION REPAIRS, OR THE BUYER'S NON-RECURRING CLOSING COSTS, PREPAIDS, AND LOAN FEES. SUBJECT TO BUYER'S LENDER APPROVAL. Contact the listing agent for the specific and full details. Owners enjoy unmatched world-class amenities: exclusive access to the private oceanfront Beach Cabana with gated parking and a seasonal shuttle, the massive saltwater North Tower Pool on the Intracoastal Waterway, and the state-of-the-art Residents' Club (fitness, tennis, pickleball). Unbeatable location just minutes to the beach and directly across from Barefoot Landing, shopping, dining and live entertainment. Barefoot Resort offers a lifestyle second to none - schedule your private tour today and start living your best life!

Welcome to 5507 Pheasant Drive, ideally located in the highly desirable community of Leatherleaf of North Myrtle Beach! This beautiful property offers the perfect combination of coastal living, privacy, and resort-style amenities, all just minutes from the beach, shopping, dining, entertainment, and everything the Grand Strand has to offer. Situated on a spacious homesite in an established neighborhood, this home provides an incredible opportunity to enjoy the relaxed North Myrtle Beach lifestyle while being surrounded by some of the area's premier golf courses and amenities. Whether you're searching for a primary residence, second home, or your own coastal retreat, this property offers an exceptional location with convenient access to the Intracoastal Waterway, Barefoot Landing, restaurants, entertainment, and the Atlantic Ocean. Barefoot Resort is known for its beautiful surroundings, championship golf, and impressive array of recreational opportunities. Enjoy peaceful neighborhood streets while still being only a short drive from the excitement of North Myrtle Beach. 5507 Pheasant Drive is your opportunity to own a piece of one of North Myrtle Beach's most sought-after resort communities. Schedule your private showing today and experience the Barefoot Resort lifestyle for yourself!

Luxury golf course living awaits in this stunning Mediterranean-inspired residence overlooking the Fazio Course within the exclusive gated community of Leatherleaf at Barefoot Resort. Nestled within the prestigious gated community of Leatherleaf at Barefoot Resort, this elegant Mediterranean-style stucco home offers luxury living overlooking the renowned Fazio Golf Course. Situated on a beautifully landscaped 0.30-acre golf course homesite, this spacious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence features approximately 3,250 heated square feet of thoughtfully designed living space and a desirable side-load two-car garage. The popular Bluffton floor plan offers an ideal blend of formal and casual living areas, including a grand formal living room, elegant dining room, private office, and an inviting Carolina/family room highlighted by a cozy fireplace and surround sound for entertaining. The spacious kitchen opens seamlessly to the main living areas, creating an excellent setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The luxurious owner's suite serves as a private retreat, complete with a large bedroom, dual vanities, a relaxing soaking tub, and a separate walk-in shower. Three additional bedrooms provide ample space for family and guests. Outdoor living is equally impressive with a screened lanai with outdoor speakers and expansive paver patio overlooking the picturesque golf course, offering the perfect place to enjoy morning coffee or evening gatherings while taking in the serene views. Additional features include a new hot water heater in 2026, appliances replaced in last 2 years, a newer roof installed in 2019, HVAC installed in 2017, mature landscaping, and the exceptional amenities and lifestyle that Barefoot Resort is known for. Residents enjoy convenient access to championship golf, oceanfront beach cabana, dining, shopping, entertainment, and the beautiful beaches of North Myrtle Beach. Experience resort-style living in one of Barefoot Resort's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Discover the perfect blend of elegance and comfort in this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom single-story home nestled within the gated Leatherleaf community of Barefoot Resort. Overlooking the lush fairways, this property offers peaceful golf course views and a thoughtfully designed floor plan ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. In the heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen, which flows into a sunny breakfast nook and a welcoming den anchored by a gas fireplace. A formal dining room and a separate living room provide versatile spaces for gatherings, while a dedicated office - easily convertible into a fourth bedroom - adds flexibility for your lifestyle. The spacious primary suite has tray ceilings, an ensuite bath, and a walk-in closet. The split floor plan gives guests plenty of space and privacy! Enjoy the heated and cooled lanai year-round, perfect for unwinding. The oversized two-car garage offers abundant storage and golf cart parking. As a homeowner, you'll enjoy access to the private Residence clubhouse and the oceanfront beach cabana, complete with three gated parking areas, making beach days effortless. Barefoot Resort also offers a 15,000-square-foot pool on the Intracoastal Waterway, a marina, four renowned golf courses, a golf practice facility, and a golf clubhouse. An option to purchase a golf membership at a discounted rate is available. This home delivers the best of resort-style living just minutes from the beach, shopping, and dining.

Welcome to this stunning 5 bedroom, 4.5 bath home with massive garage located in the prestigious gated community of Leatherleaf within Barefoot Resort with a full golf membership. Perfectly positioned on a fountain-view pond, this property offers both privacy and picturesque scenery. Inside, you'll find a spacious living area with a cozy gas fireplace, a gourmet eat-in kitchen featuring wall ovens, and a formal dining room ideal for entertaining. The oversized screen room overlooks the water, creating the perfect spot to relax. This home boasts two luxurious owner suites, offering flexibility for guests or multi-generational living both with fountain views. Step outside to enjoy the hot tub with serene pond views, or take advantage of the extended garage for additional storage and convenience. A newer roof with a transferable warranty adds peace of mind. This exceptional home has many upgrades including a bay window for extra light and space in the kitchen, newer appliances, extended bonus room with full bath/separate climate control, storm panels for every window possibly bringing you an insurance discount, extended garage with 8 foot door, hard wired security system monitoring fee is including HOA and so much more. This magnificent home combines comfort, elegance, and resort-style living in one beautiful package. Barefoot Resort and Golf is home to 4 famous golf courses, marina, several restaurants, walking trails, private beach cabana with a seasonal shuttle. It truly has it all with too much to list.

Welcome to this stunning two-story home situated on a premium golf course lot in the exclusive gated community of Leatherleaf, within the prestigious Barefoot Resort. This beautiful home offers the perfect blend of space, comfort and resort-style living. This home features 4 bedrooms / 3.5 bathrooms, den/office, formal dining room with tray ceiling, large eat-in kitchen with breakfast bar and work island that is open to the family room, plus your very own backyard oasis, with private inground pool, hot tub and covered Liani. Retreat to your first-floor primary bedroom with its own en-suite and walk-in closet. Your family and guests will enjoy their privacy on the 2nd floor where bedrooms two and three share a convenient Jack and Jill bathroom, while bedroom four enjoys the luxury of its own ensuite. There is also an oversized bonus room on the second level, perfect for a game room, home theater or additional living space. Plenty of storage is provided in the oversized side load garage. A TRANSFERABLE GOLF MEMBERSHIP is attached to the property for a small fee. Barefoot HOA fees are among the best on the Grand Strand. They include access to the Residence Club with a full-time activities director as well as an exercise facility, large outdoor swimming pool, tennis/pickleball, basketball courts and playground for kids. The HOA dues also cover basic cable, wireless internet and the best part is Barefoot's very own Private Beach Cabana for owners only with gated parking and seasonal shuttle service, and much more. Barefoot is located just minutes from the ocean and close to all that North Myrtle Beach and the surrounding area has to offer. Here you will find endless choices of activities, including golf, restaurants, shopping and entertainment for the whole family!

Stunning All-Brick Home in Highly Sought-After Leatherleaf at Barefoot Resort Welcome to this exquisite one-level home in the prestigious Leatherleaf community of Barefoot Resort. Offering breathtaking golf course views, this beautifully updated residence boasts wood-look tile flooring throughout and a massive heated and cooled sunroom complete with a hot tub, perfect for year-round enjoyment. Inside, you'll find a formal living room, a spacious family room, a formal dining room, and a dedicated home office. The primary suite features a luxurious en-suite bath, while an additional guest suite offers its own private bath for ultimate comfort. Step into your backyard oasis, where you can take in the scenic views of the fairway of the Love Course or even fish from your own backyard. Unmatched Barefoot Resort amenities include: - Two resort-style pools - Clubhouse with fitness center - Hot tub, basketball, tennis, and pickleball courts - Extra-wide sidewalks for walking and running - Seasonal beach shuttle - Exclusive access to the private beach cabana with private parking Don't miss this incredible opportunity to own a home in one of the most desirable communities in the area. Schedule your private showing today.
Lovely Wilmington floor plan with modifications in Barefoot Resort in the prestigious gated Leatherleaf section.

This stunning home in Leatherleaf, Barefoot Resort’s premier gated community, offers an incredible lifestyle with a transferable Golf Membership, granting access to four championship courses. From the moment you enter, you’ll appreciate the seamless flow of natural light and beautiful sight lines that connect the front and back of the home, showcasing a serene water feature. Featuring elegant hardwood flooring throughout and tile in the bathrooms, the spacious master suite boasts a double trey ceiling, a cozy picture window seating area, and direct access to the screened-in back porch. The luxurious master bath includes double vanities, his and her walk-in closets, a pedestal tub, and a separate walk-in shower. The open living area, complete with a fireplace, leads to a gourmet kitchen equipped with solid surface countertops, double ovens, 42” cabinets, and stainless steel appliances. A generous bonus room provides ample space for entertaining or can serve as additional guest accommodation. Step outside to relax on the back porch overlooking the tranquil pond, or take advantage of the Barefoot Resident's Club amenities, including private oceanfront beach access with gated parking and complimentary shuttle service. Enjoy the Marina on the Intracoastal Waterway and indulge in the luxury of two multi-million clubhouses featuring restaurants, bars, and a pro shop. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and entertainment, with easy access to Highways 17 and 31, this home is just a golf cart ride from the beach. Schedule a viewing to experience this exceptional property for yourself!

Welcome to your dream home in the sought after gated community of Leatherleaf! This stunning 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath Stucco home boasts a spacious open floor plan with an amazing kitchen perfect for entertaining guests. Enjoy the luxury of a transferable golf membership and access to all the amenities the Barefoot community has to offer! Don't miss out on this beautifully maintained property that is sure to impress any buyer!

**Stunning 5 Bedroom, 4.5 Bath All-Brick Home in Leatherleaf, Barefoot Resort** Welcome to your dream home in the highly sought-after community of Leatherleaf in Barefoot Resort! This beautifully maintained 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath all-brick residence is perfectly situated on a serene pond, offering tranquil water views and a sense of peacefulness. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by the spacious and inviting split floorplan layout, designed for both comfort and elegance. The home features three en-suite bedrooms, providing privacy and convenience for family and guests. The expansive outdoor kitchen is perfect for entertaining, while the four-seasons room allows you to enjoy the beauty of the outdoors all year round. This property comes with a transferable golf membership, giving you access to Barefoot Resort's four world-class golf courses. Additionally, you'll enjoy all the amazing amenities the resort has to offer, including: - A residence club with a fully-equipped gym - Multiple pools for relaxation and recreation - A private beach cabana with exclusive beach access Don't miss the opportunity to own this exceptional home in a community known for its luxury and lifestyle. Schedule your private tour today and experience the best of Barefoot Resort living!

This beautiful home is located in Barefoot Resort in the prestigious gated Leatherleaf subdivision. The home is turn key with several upgrades ready for the new owner. The floor plan is the Cumberland model and it is one of the most desirable floor plans in the community. The home is located on the 17th hole with fantastic views from the large screened in Lanai. The home offers a tankless gas water heater, double ovens, custom cabinetry, and so much more. Home owners have a membership in the Barefoot Residence Club offering a full time activities director, clubhouse, olympic swimming pool, library, fitness center, tennis courts, basketball court, picnic area, Barefoot Beach Cabana an oceanfront private facility and gated parking. In addition, owners have use of a 15,000 square foot salt water swimming pool that sits directly on the intracoastal waterway with available food and beverage service during certain times of the year. Barefoot Resort has four championship golf courses, 2 clubhouses, four onsite restaurants, and a full service marina with Jet Ski and boat rentals and some available boat slips for rent.

This all brick home is located in the gated Leatherleaf community of Barefoot Resort. The open floor plan has 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms and tranquil views of #12 on the Love golf course. The updated kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, corian countertops and a large work island. The traditional living area has a gas fireplace and built in bookshelves. The large master suit exhibits beautiful tray ceilings and his and her bathrooms with ample closet space! The peaceful screened in back porch was recently expanded and has an Eze breeze system in place to use the room all four seasons! The property has a TRANSFERRABLE GOLF MEMBERSHIP to Barefoot Resort! The home sits on a beautiful lot with mature landscaping and a fenced in back yard. Barefoot Resort has four championship golf courses, a large practice area, access to the Barefoot Marina on the Intracoastal Waterway, onsite restaurants, and a private oceanfront beach cabana with gated parking for residents. Homeowners will also be able to use the Residents' Club that boats a spacious pool, weight room, library, tennis/pickleball courts, a basketball court, picnic area and playground. Under the direction of the Residents’ Club Lifestyle Director, you will enjoy activities and special events that will make you feel like you are on vacation every day! Schedule your showing and start living the Barefoot Life!
