descriptions.desc: Welcome to 396 Posada Drive, an impressive Mediterranean-style residence located within the gated Calais neighborhood of Grande Dunes, approximately a five-minute walk from the beach. Recently refreshed with new interior paint, all-new lighting, and newly epoxied garage floors, this 3-bedroom, 3-bath home offers approximately 3,497 heated square feet of beautifully appointed living space on a .36-acre homesite. From the moment you enter, soaring ceilings, detailed architectural elements, abundant natural light, and a fresh, neutral palette create a bright and sophisticated atmosphere. The expansive living areas are designed for both everyday comfort and entertaining, with a fireplace, wet bar, formal dining room, and an open flow connecting the home's primary gathering spaces. The well-appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances, solid-surface countertops, a large work island, breakfast bar, pantry, and breakfast area. The first-floor primary suite provides a spacious private retreat with a sitting area, tray ceiling, and walk-in closet. The ensuite bath features dual vanities, a whirlpool tub, and separate shower. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms and a full bath provide comfortable separation from the main-level primary suite. A dedicated study adds further flexibility to the thoughtfully designed floor plan. Outdoor living is equally inviting, with multiple courtyard and patio areas surrounded by mature landscaping and a private spa, creating a relaxing extension of the home's living spaces. An attached side-load two-car garage with a separate golf cart garage provides ample room for vehicles and additional storage, while the newly epoxied garage floors add a polished finishing touch. Grande Dunes spans more than 2,200 acres from the Intracoastal Waterway to the Atlantic Ocean, offering an exceptional collection of amenities and recreational opportunities. Residents enjoy exclusive access to the private Ocean Club, featuring oceanfront pools, dining, private beach access, and additional social amenities. The community features two 18-hole golf courses, including the Resort Course, which is open to the public, and the Nick Price-designed Members Club, which requires a separate membership. Grande Dunes is also home to a 126-slip deep-water marina capable of accommodating vessels up to 120 feet. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, recreation, entertainment, and Grand Strand Medical Center, this residence offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy the Grande Dunes lifestyle. Contact the listing agent for additional information or to schedule your private showing.

Behind the private gates of Calais, an intimate custom enclave within Myrtle Beach’s prestigious Grande Dunes, this fully reimagined Mediterranean estate offers a rare blend of privacy, craftsmanship, and coastal resort living, with the beach just an easy five-minute walk away. With only 29 residences, Calais offers a level of privacy and exclusivity rarely found this close to the ocean. Full Ocean Club access is included through the HOA, placing oceanfront pools, dining, and private beach amenities just a short golf cart ride or drive away. Comprehensively renovated in 2025, the home has been transformed with newly installed finishes, fixtures, cabinetry, appliances, lighting, and stonework throughout. New marble flooring flows throughout the main living spaces, creating an elegant foundation for interiors defined by volume, craftsmanship, and architectural character. Coffered ceilings and tray ceilings rising up to 15 feet add a sense of scale and refinement, while Ionic columns, custom millwork, and new Restoration Hardware lighting complete the setting. Built with insulated concrete form construction, the residence offers both enduring strength and elevated comfort. At the center of the home, the newly renovated kitchen is as elegant as it is functional. Custom Wood-Mode inset cabinetry, finished with a softly glazed exterior and walnut interior, is paired with Calacatta Viola marble countertops, a matching full-height marble backsplash, and a striking oversized island. The new appliance suite includes Sub-Zero refrigeration, a 48-inch Wolf rangetop with integrated griddle, Wolf convection and convection-steam wall ovens, Wolf drawer microwave, and Fisher & Paykel double-drawer dishwasher. A new Shaws of England fireclay sink, dedicated reverse-osmosis tap, and California Faucets fixtures complete the main kitchen, while the custom cabinetry continues into the pantry, where a new walnut countertop adds warmth and refinement. The home’s living and entertaining spaces balance warmth with refinement, from the formal and family living rooms — each anchored by a gas fireplace with a custom-carved mantel — to the newly finished butler’s bar set behind wrought-iron arched doors. There, custom Wood-Mode cabinetry continues with antiqued-mirror accents, Calacatta Viola counters, a Wolf built-in coffee system, Sub-Zero beverage refrigeration, and a second Shaws fireclay sink, all introduced as part of the renovation. The split-bedroom layout gives the primary suite its own private wing, complete with a sitting room overlooking the pool and dual walk-in closets. The primary bath pairs travertine with dramatic black marble, creating a richly finished spa-like retreat with new California Faucets fixtures, a rain head, body sprays, and a Toto jetted soaking tub. The same custom Wood-Mode inset cabinetry with walnut interiors continues into the baths, giving the home a cohesive, carefully considered finish. Two ensuite guest rooms and a dedicated office add comfort and flexibility for hosting, working from home, or quiet retreat. Outdoors, the home continues its resort-like feel with a heated pool, raised spa, in-pool tanning shelf, and summer kitchen designed for relaxed coastal living. The pool terrace offers a private, polished setting for quiet mornings, afternoon swims, and evenings with guests. Additional recent upgrades include a new Rinnai tankless water heater and new LeafGuard gutter system, while a separate golf cart bay adds everyday convenience for beach and Ocean Club living. Fully renovated, exceptionally appointed, and set within one of the Carolinas’ most desirable resort communities, this private coastal estate offers a rare blend of craftsmanship, privacy, and coastal convenience — with the beach just an easy five-minute walk from home. Listing Agent is Owner.

Located within Grande Dunes, one of Myrtle Beach’s most prestigious gated communities, this beautifully updated coastal estate offers a rare blend of privacy, elegance, and effortless indoor-outdoor living—just moments from the Atlantic shoreline. Set on an expansive one-third-acre homesite framed by mature palms, this 3-bedroom, 3-bath luxury residence is thoughtfully designed around a private courtyard, creating a true resort-style retreat. At the heart of the home, a spacious covered courtyard porch and sparkling in-ground pool set the stage for refined entertaining, quiet relaxation, and year-round coastal enjoyment. A highly desirable private casita adds exceptional versatility—perfect for hosting guests, creating a private home office, or accommodating multigenerational living—while maintaining seamless connection to the main residence. Recent renovations elevate the home throughout. The gourmet, chef-inspired kitchen features high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, elegant hard-surface countertops, and inviting bar-height seating—ideal for both casual mornings and sophisticated gatherings. The owner’s suite is a true sanctuary, enhanced by a spa-like bath with an oversized walk-in shower, soaking tub, custom double vanity, and a professionally designed walk-in closet. Additional upgrades include fresh exterior paint, a beautifully refinished pool with new tile, and a mini-split heating and cooling system in the garage for added comfort and functionality. Inside, refined tile flooring, a cozy fireplace, and timeless architectural details create an atmosphere that is both luxurious and welcoming. A spacious two-car garage offers ample storage for beach gear, golf clubs, and more. Residents enjoy close proximity to the exclusive Ocean Club Cabana, featuring oceanfront dining and bar service, a resort-style pool, and gated beach access—bringing the coastal lifestyle right to your doorstep. Just minutes from world-class dining, shopping, championship golf, boating, fishing, and all the best of Myrtle Beach, this exceptional property delivers a rare opportunity to own a private, luxury retreat in one of the area’s most coveted communities.

Discover the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal living in this beautifully updated spacious six bedroom, three- and one-half bath home just a short walk to the beach. Set in one of the most desired Grand Dunes gated communities, this residence offers privacy, convenience, and resort-style amenities today’s buyers crave. This home welcomes you with a long private driveway that sets the tone for peaceful living. Enjoy year-round outdoor relaxation on the spacious screened porch, complete with outdoor kitchen, large screen TV-perfect for entertaining or quiet evenings at home. With no homes behind the property, you’ll experience rate privacy and serene views. Creating a truly tranquil backyard retreat. Step inside the elegant formal living room and dining room into a fully renovated kitchen that makes both everyday cooking and entertaining a joy, complemented by brand new flooring and stylish new lighting that creates a warm, modern feel throughout. Fresh new window treatments add a designer touch while enhancing natural light in every room. The large master suite is your personal retreat, featuring a spa-like bathroom designed for relaxation at the end of a long day. Outside, your private backyard and screened porch provide the perfect space for morning coffee, evening gatherings, or simply unwinding in your own peaceful haven. Pet lovers will appreciate the built-in dog-washing station-no more trips to the groomer-and the communities amenities complete the lifestyle: a sparkling swim pool beautifully maintained grounds, and the security and serenity of a gated neighborhood plus membership to the Grand Dunes Ocean Club. This home isn’t just updated-it’s elevated. Move-in ready, close to the ocean, and designed for easy, breezy coastal living.

Thoughtfully renovated one story home in the most loved neighborhood Calais. IFC construction! Courtyard home with 3bedrooms, 3 1/2 bath with office and large outdoor covered patio overlooking the pool. Take advantage of this opportunity to enjoy an in-law efficiency suite, across from the main entrance, there is a separate structure, housing a bedroom, bathroom, walk in closet and mini kitchen. Solar Panels! Master bath and closet remodel. Whole house Paint, lighting upgraded. Two Car garage with mini split heat and cooling plus room for a golf cart. All irrigation and landscape lighting repaired. 5 min walk to the beach.

Thoughtfully renovated ICF (Insulated Concrete Forms) Mediterranean home! Three Bedroom, four bathrooms on one level with office in the exclusive Grand Dunes Gated community of Calais, which is a 5-minute walk to the most sought-after section of Myrtle Beach. This section of the beach is naturally guarded by two spillways coming from inland out to the Atlantic Ocean. Because of this natural phenomenon, this section of beach is lightly occupied. This elegant home was built by the original owner with luxury designer lighting, over the top finishing touches including gorgeous, vaulted cathedral ceilings throughout the house, two gas fireplaces, oversized base boards and crown molding. The large open kitchen has beautiful custom cabinets, breakfast room, pantry, granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances. This home is equipped with integrated audio throughout the interior and exterior. Plenty of space for entertainment both inside and outside on the large, covered lanai with outdoor kitchen, heated pool and spa. Mature private landscaping creates a perfect backyard retreat. The oversized primary bedroom suite overlooks the premium backyard oasis, two large walk-in closets with custom closet shelving, elegant large shower and new jacuzzi tub with heated floors in the bathroom! Two car garages with additional golf cart garage and major cabinet storage throughout the garages. Only 29 custom homes in this elite gated community just steps away from the sandy beach!

Back on the market through no fault of the owner. Discover your dream home, perfectly situated east of Highway 17 and just minutes from the beach and the prestigious Dunes Golf & Beach Club. This stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath property blends elegance and modern comfort, offering an ideal coastal lifestyle. Step into the gourmet kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, gleaming granite countertops, and ample space for culinary creativity. Tray ceilings throughout add a touch of sophistication, while the expansive indoor/outdoor room provides seamless entertaining options. The master suite is a true sanctuary, boasting marble countertops in the en-suite bathroom. Practical touches include a spacious laundry room with built-in cabinets and a heated and air-conditioned garage. Recent updates include resealed windows, a new sauna, and energy-efficient solar panels. Enjoy resort-style outdoor living with a resurfaced pool, complete with a state-of-the-art heating and cooling system. As a resident, you’ll enjoy exclusive membership in the Ocean Club through the HOA. Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to own a piece of paradise! Schedule your private showing today.

Location, location, location!! A Rare find and currently the only home available EAST of 17 Business in Grande Dunes Resort. Situated in the gated community of Calais, this home is ready and waiting for you to experience Beach Life to the fullest. Just a short stroll away from the beach and Ocean Club, this beautiful 4 bedroom plus office, plus gameroom offers an open floor plan with custom upgrades and elegant touches throughout. Features include impressive steel framed doors, 10 inch baseboards, vaulted ceilings, detailed trim work, stainless steel appliances, cast stone fireplace, plenty of storage and so much more. Built with steel framed construction, superior to todays builds, this splendid property has plenty of privacy and space on almost 0.45 acre. Outside offers unlimited potential along with a swimmers pool for those who love to get their laps in before the day gets started. Don't miss this one!! This property is located in South Carolina’s premier coastal community in Myrtle Beach; Grande Dunes. Stretching from the Ocean to the Carolina Bays Preserve, this 2200 acre development is amenity-rich and filled with lifestyle opportunities unrivaled in the market. Owners at Grande Dunes enjoy a 25,000 square foot Ocean Club that boasts exquisite dining, oceanfront pools with food & beverage service, along with meeting rooms and fun activities. Additionally, the community has two 18-hole golf courses along with several on-site restaurants, deep water marina, Har-tru tennis facility and miles or biking/walking trails! Please visit our sales gallery located in Grande Dunes Marketplace to learn more about this amazing community you can call home.

Nestled within the prestigious Grande Dunes Calais development in Myrtle Beach, this furnished Mediterranean-style haven stands as an epitome of luxury living. Set on an expansive nearly half-acre lot, the residence encompasses 4 bedrooms and 5.5 baths. East of 17, Gated Calais is the hidden diamond the smaller community of Grande Dunes, Gated and a walk to the Beach... This Home offers a Very Eclectic approach to Grande Dunes... Open Floor plan, which makes the stage the beautiful Private Back yard. A grand foyer welcomes you with a dramatic wall of windows, offering breathtaking views of the outdoor pool. To the left, a captivating library/office beckons with towering custom bookshelves, while to the right, a formal dining room awaits. The gourmet kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, featuring custom cabinets, extensive granite countertops, a generous work island with a warming drawer, top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances including a Wolf range, and a built-in Miele cappuccino maker plus a dinette area. The great room is a perfect blend of comfort and sophistication, showcasing a gas fireplace and expansive windows offering panoramic views of the meticulously landscaped backyard, patio, and pool areas. Two exquisite bedroom suites grace the main floor, including the master suite with direct patio access. The master ensuite is a spa-like retreat, complete with a jetted tub and a walk-in shower. Ascend to the second floor to discover two additional thoughtfully designed bedroom suites. The property is replete with luxurious features such as a Lebleu water filtration system, central vacuum, and travertine floors. The integration of a Sonos Smart Home system adds modern convenience, while the outdoor amenities include an inviting outdoor kitchen with Wolf gas grill, a full bath in the patio area, and a 2-car garage with ample storage space. A full laundry room on the main floor adds to the practicality of this exquisite abode. What sets this residence apart is the Location and also part of the HOA is the exclusive membership to the Grande Dunes Ocean Club, elevating the living experience to unparalleled heights. Residents enjoy privileged access to a private oceanfront retreat, with pools and a hot tub providing a resort-like ambiance. Culinary enthusiasts can relish a variety of dining experiences, and entertainment opportunities abound, making this property not just a home but a complete lifestyle package that defines luxury in every aspect.

descriptions.desc: Located at 1677 Malaga Circle in the prestigious Palermo neighborhood of Grande Dunes, this exceptional to-be-built custom home by AR Homes presents a rare opportunity to create a new luxury residence in one of Myrtle Beach's premier coastal communities. The sophisticated Aruba design combines contemporary coastal architecture, high-end finishes, expansive indoor-outdoor living, and resort-style amenities in a thoughtfully designed custom residence. Offering approximately 4,175 square feet of luxury living space, the open-concept floor plan features a spacious primary suite, additional guest accommodations, a private den, an impressive great room, and beautifully designed living and entertaining spaces. Expansive windows and sliding glass doors create a seamless connection between the interior and the home's private outdoor retreat. At the heart of the residence, the gourmet chef's kitchen is designed for both entertaining and everyday living. Premium features include a professional Café appliance package, Monogram integrated dishwasher, 36-inch gas rangetop, built-in convection oven, wine center, custom hood, quartz countertops, an oversized center island, and custom cabinetry. descriptions.desc: Experience coastal luxury in this thoughtfully designed new construction home in Waterway Palms Plantation. Offering approximately 3,800 heated square feet, the floor plan features five bedrooms, a dedicated office, and an upstairs bonus room. The main level brings together a spacious kitchen with an island and walk-in pantry, a dining area, and a family room that opens to a screened patio. The primary suite is also on the main level, with a walk-in closet and a spacious bath. A covered front porch and two-car garage complete the home.

Space, flexibility, and an exceptional lifestyle come together in this impressive Waterway Palms home! With 7 bedrooms, 4 full baths, three levels of living, and an abundance of thoughtfully designed spaces, this home offers room for everyone—and plenty of options for how you live, work, entertain, and relax. Whether you're looking for multigenerational living, dedicated home offices, guest space, or room for hobbies and collections, this versatile floor plan delivers. The first floor welcomes you with a spacious living room featuring a soaring ceiling, fireplace, and abundant windows that fill the space with natural light. The large kitchen is perfect for gathering, with a grand island, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and extensive cabinet storage. The main level also includes a spacious family room, formal dining room, Carolina room, bedroom/office, full bath, and inviting all-season screened porch featuring EZ Breeze-style windows, providing added comfort and flexibility. Upstairs, the second level features 4 bedrooms and 2 full baths, while the third level offers 2 additional bedrooms plus a loft—creating tremendous flexibility for family, guests, a home office, or recreational space. Storage is a standout feature, with generous storage throughout the home plus a unique hidden storage area that's perfect for treasured possessions, or those items you want safely tucked away. Additionally there are security, smart-home and convenience features throughout, a 2-car garage, and a beautiful pond view. Enjoy the resort-style lifestyle of Waterway Palms, a gated community offering swimming pools, tennis and pickleball courts, clubhouse, playground, waterway boat ramp, and boat storage. With its impressive size, versatile three-level floor plan, abundant storage, and exceptional amenities, this is a home designed to grow with you and accommodate the way you live today—and tomorrow.

This Gorgeous New Construction 4 Bedrooms, 4 baths, office, and private 2 car garage home is located in the gated community of Waterway Palms Plantation under 5 miles to the Ocean and direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway! This custom home gives avery open welcome from the moment you walk through the front door with the open floor plan, luxury floors throughout, updated kitchen, and natural light! Split bedroom floor plan with all onsuite bathrooms allows for complete privacy between primary and guest rooms. Homeowners can sit back and relax on the front patio overlooking the water or the private rear patio. The homes upgrades include; custom closet & bedroom built ins, crown moldings, 7' baseboards, stainless steel appliances, soft close cabinets, tiled bathroom showers, and more! HOA includes; gated community; private boat dock and access to the Intracoastal Waterway, tennis, pool table, gym, world class pool, and common area maintenance. Boat storage available inside the community. The home is located minutes away from dining, shopping, walking trails, theschools ,grocery stores, golf courses , Airport, Intracoastal waterway, Hospitals, and more!

CUSTOM UPGRADES, SPACIOUS LIVING & RESORT-STYLE AMENITIES! Welcome to this beautifully appointed 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath custom home in the gated community of Waterway Palms Plantation. Situated on a corner lot, this home offers approximately 3,378 sq. ft. with an oversized 2-car garage and an expansive front porch. Enjoy new laminate flooring throughout the ground floor, offering water and scratch resistant durability, plus Pergo laminate flooring upstairs with the same water and scratch resistant features. The gourmet kitchen showcases stainless steel appliances, Samsung Family Hub refrigerator, farmhouse sink, prep sink, pot filler, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, walk-in pantry, and large island. The first-floor primary suite features screened porch access, double-tray ceiling, large walk-in closet, and spa-like bath with dual sinks, custom cabinetry, shower, and freestanding soaking tub. A flexible first-floor room with French doors is ideal for an office or guest space. Upstairs offers three additional bedrooms, three full baths, and a spacious loft/media/rec room. Enjoy the screened back porch, fenced backyard, and pergola. Waterway Palms Plantation amenities include a clubhouse, multiple pools, fitness center, tennis/pickleball, basketball court, playground, day dock, private boat ramp, and boat storage. Conveniently located near International Drive, shopping, dining, beaches, golf, and all that Myrtle Beach has to offer.

Experience refined coastal living in this custom-designed home in Waterway Palms Plantation, one of Carolina Forest’s premier gated communities. Every inch of this residence showcases thoughtful craftsmanship — grand ceilings, two story stone fireplace, upgraded custom trim, designer closets, and a spacious three-car garage. Step outside to your private oasis: a custom pool with spillover hot tub, that creates a serene, resort-like atmosphere. The community enhances the lifestyle with tennis courts, pickleball, basketball, a beautiful pool, playground, and scenic sidewalks throughout.

Custom Built Lowcountry Living at Its Finest! This stunning 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath Lowcountry-style home sits on a large corner lot with a fenced backyard and an incredible private pool, offering an exceptional blend of elegance, comfort, and thoughtful design. All four bedrooms feature private ensuite bathrooms, creating the perfect combination of privacy and luxury for family and guests. From the moment you enter, the quality is evident with an impressive high-end trim package, 8-foot doors, plantation shutters throughout, beautiful tile flooring, custom cabinetry, and exquisite granite finishes. The home's exterior is beautifully finished with durable Hardie board siding, adding timeless Lowcountry character and lasting appeal. The gourmet kitchen is designed to impress, featuring Bosch appliances, a wine cooler, custom cabinetry, beautiful granite countertops, a large pantry, and instant hot water at the kitchen sink. Two tankless water heaters provide an additional level of convenience and efficiency throughout the home. The open and beautifully appointed space is ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Each ensuite bathroom showcases custom-tiled showers and upscale finishes, while custom closets throughout the home provide exceptional organization and storage. The spacious primary suite offers an added touch of luxury with two walk-in closets, providing abundant storage and convenience. Beyond the beautifully appointed living spaces, this home offers an impressive array of extras, including a spacious library, three fireplaces, custom luxury lighting throughout the interior, premium exterior accent lighting, and thoughtfully designed indoor and outdoor living spaces that provide the perfect setting for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. The front and rear covered patios extend the living space, while the rear porch features retractable electric shades installed in August 2024, allowing you to enjoy the outdoor space comfortably in any season. The backyard is truly an entertainer's dream. The 12,000-gallon heated saltwater fiberglass pool, measuring approximately 16' x 34' with a deep end of 5'9", was installed in July 2024 and includes a 50-year warranty. The beautifully fenced and landscaped yard also features a custom outdoor kitchen, perfect for poolside entertaining. Adding a special touch to the backyard is a Meyer lemon tree loaded with lemons, bringing a little extra charm to this exceptional outdoor space. For the dog lover, this home is truly one of a kind! The oversized garage features a dedicated dog-washing shower, a thoughtful and unique feature for your four-legged family members. Additional peace of mind comes with a security system featuring audible alerts on all doors and windows with direct pool access. Every detail of this exceptional home has been thoughtfully designed to provide a luxurious yet comfortable Lowcountry lifestyle. Ideally located close to everything Myrtle Beach has to offer, including restaurants, world-class golf, shopping, entertainment, and the beautiful Grand Strand beaches. This is a rare opportunity to own a truly distinctive home where luxury, functionality, and exceptional craftsmanship come together. Schedule your showing today!

Waterway Palms means more than just owning a beautiful home, t's embracing a coastal lifestyle along the Intracoastal Waterway with exclusive access to a sparkling resort-style pool, tennis and basketball courts, a fitness center, private boat dock and ramp for waterway adventures, charming sidewalk-lined streets perfect for evening strolls, and timeless Charleston-inspired architecture throughout. This is your moment to claim a brand-new, move-in-ready sanctuary in one of the area's most coveted waterfront communities, where every detail has been perfected and every day feels like a retreat. Luxury Lowcountry living meets thoughtful design at 9073 Belvidere Drive, located on a large corner lot in the gated Intracoastal Waterway community of Waterway Palms Plantation. Beautifully maintained, extensively upgraded and truly move-in ready, this 4-bedroom, 3-bath home offers nearly 2,800 heated square feet, an oversized three-car garage and exceptional indoor and outdoor spaces designed for entertaining, relaxing and everyday life. Inside, soaring vaulted ceilings and an abundance of natural light immediately create an open and impressive sense of space. At the heart of the home, the kitchen combines style and functionality with an expansive quartz-topped island, apron-front farmhouse sink, gas cooktop with pot filler, built-in wall oven and microwave, generous cabinetry and a dedicated pantry. An additional built-in serving and storage area adds even more functionality for entertaining, while the open-concept design keeps the kitchen connected to the main living spaces. The first-floor primary suite provides a private retreat with a tray ceiling, walk-in closet and spacious ensuite bath featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub and separate shower. Also on the main level, a beautifully designed home office offers much more than a dedicated workspace. Custom built-ins discreetly conceal a Murphy bed, allowing the room to quickly transform into comfortable guest accommodations when needed. Upstairs, a spacious loft creates an additional living and entertaining area complete with a mini refrigerator, making it an ideal play room, media space or relaxed hangout. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the upper level, giving family and guests their own comfortable space while maintaining separation from the primary living areas below. The outdoor living space is one of the home's true highlights. Thoughtfully improved with both entertaining and family life in mind, the backyard extends the living experience beyond the walls of the home and provides plenty of room to gather, unwind and enjoy the coastal Carolina lifestyle. The generous corner homesite adds to the feeling of openness, while the oversized three-car garage offers exceptional space for vehicles, a golf cart, recreational gear and storage. Waterway Palms Plantation delivers a lifestyle to match the home. This sought-after gated Carolina Forest community is situated along the Intracoastal Waterway and is known for its distinctive Lowcountry architecture and resort-style amenities. Residents enjoy an impressive two-story clubhouse, swimming pool, tennis courts, playground, gathering spaces, verandas and gazebos, as well as boat storage and a private community boat launch with direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway. With extensive upgrades, versatile living spaces, an incredible outdoor setting and a location convenient to Myrtle Beach dining, shopping, golf, entertainment and the beaches of the Grand Strand, 9073 Belvidere Drive offers the space and functionality of a family home with the elevated finishes and lifestyle of Waterway Palms Plantation.

Welcome to 1163 East Isle of Palms, in the highly sought after gated community of Waterway Palms Plantation, this newly built 4-bedroom,3.5-bath residence delivers the kind of polish that makes everyday living feel just a little more dressed up. White brick and Hardie accents set a refined first impression, while inside, wide-plank 10-inch oak floors and custom white oak cabinetry bring warmth, texture, and a very convincing argument for never leaving home. The main level is designed with equal parts elegance and practicality. A standout primary bedroom suite offers a spacious private bath and an impressively generous closet, creating a retreat that understands the value of both luxury and breathing room. The Great Room opens beautifully to an entertainer’s kitchen appointed with commercial-grade ZLINE appliances, a large island, walk-in pantry, mudroom, laundry, and a conveniently placed powder room. In short, this floor works hard so you do not have to. Upstairs, three additional bedrooms, two full baths, a private office, and a bonus room provide flexibility for guests, work, play, or all three at once. There is also a built in indoor and outdoor WIIM home stereo system with surround sound and an elevator shaft in place shall you wish to install later down the road. Outside, the good life continues with an in-ground pool and summer kitchen crafted for effortless hosting, celebratory dinners, and the occasional excuse to take a dip on those hot Summer days. Residents of Waterway Palms Plantation enjoy resort-style amenities including a clubhouse, community pool, pickleball courts, tennis courts, boat launch, and boat storage. With certificate of occupancy expected August1, now is the perfect time to secure your place in one of Myrtle Beach’s most sought-after communities. Arrange your private tour today.

Welcome to this stunning 4 bedroom, 3 bath custom ranch style home on a 1/3-acre cul-de-sac lot in the highly sought after intracoastal community of Waterway Palms Plantation. This home is now officially on the market and one you don’t want to miss! This home offers 2,517 heated sq ft (3,286 sq ft under roof) with upscale finishes, an open concept layout and split bedroom floor plan with master and two additional bedrooms on the main floor with an additional bedroom and bath over the garage. Step inside to discover a bright, open layout filled with natural light and thoughtfully designed living spaces. The inviting living area features a vaulted ceiling and a beautiful fireplace wrapped in rustic shiplap, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen is both stylish and functional, ideal for everyday living and hosting guests. Offering a gas range and built in microwave oven with ample cabinet storage. Matching granite countertops in kitchen and baths. This home also features spacious covered porches, a fenced in large, private back yard with irrigation and a whole home generator for peace of mind. The upscale door, window and crown moldings; along with the plantation shutters add to the luxurious craftsmanship this beautiful home has to offer. Located inside Waterway Palms Plantation, a gated ICW community, offering newly renovated resort style amenities including; tennis and pickleball courts, large resort style pool and amenity center. The community also offers boat storage and direct intracoastal access with a private boat ramp and the largest day docks of any of the neighboring direct access communities. This community offers close access to shopping, dining, golf, and the beach as well as a highly desired school district.

Welcome to Waterway Palms Plantation, one of Myrtle Beach's most sought after gated communities! This beautifully crafted new construction home offers 4 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, and an attached garage, featuring exceptional attention to detail and custom design throughout. Enjoy an elite trim package, appliances, custom closets and shelving, beautiful tile work, and abundant natural light that fills every space. Residents enjoy resort style amenities including a beautiful Southern style clubhouse, olympic size pool, brand new pickleball, tennis and basketball courts, plus private Intracoastal Waterway access with boat ramp. Combining luxury living, outstanding amenities, and an unbeatable location, this home is an incredible value. Don't miss your opportunity to own in one of Myrtle Beach's premier waterfront communities!

Welcome to one of Waterway Palms Plantation's most thoughtfully upgraded homes. This stunning five bedroom custom residence offers an exceptional blend of everyday comfort and resort style living in one of the Grand Strand's most coveted gated ICW communities. Three bedrooms on the main floor, including the primary suite, make single level living a breeze, while two additional bedrooms upstairs provide the perfect retreat for family and guests. Soaring coffered ceilings, a custom fireplace, and an arched passageway set the tone for the architectural details found throughout. The gourmet kitchen flows seamlessly into the main living area, ideal for entertaining. A fully enclosed sunroom with its own mini split system extends your living space year round, offering a bright and comfortable spot to unwind in any season. Outside, a sparkling private pool is framed by a fully fenced backyard and surrounded by mature trees for exceptional privacy. A rare find in Waterway Palms, this outdoor retreat is truly made for enjoying the Lowcountry lifestyle at its finest. Coastal colors, palm lined streets, double sidewalks, a resort style community pool, and direct ICW access complete the picture. This is not just a home, it is a lifestyle. Schedule your private showing today.

Located in the prestigious gated community of Waterway Palms Plantation in Carolina Forest, this stunning Charleston-style home offers five bedrooms, four full baths, a two-car side-load garage, and a fully fenced backyard overlooking a peaceful pond. A large covered front porch welcomes you into the home, where elegant wood flooring flows throughout the main living areas, complemented by tile in the wet areas, and plush carpet in the bedrooms. The foyer showcases beautiful shadow box trim and opens to a versatile flex space perfect for a home office, formal dining room, or sitting area. The spacious kitchen is designed for both functionality and style, featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, tile backsplash, a large work island, a pantry, and a bright breakfast nook. A first-floor bedroom with ceiling fan has an ensuite bathroom making it ideal for guests. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with a ceiling fan, walk-in closet, private access to a large balcony, and a luxurious bath complete with double vanity, linen closet, garden tub, tiled walk-in shower, and private water closet. Two additional bedrooms share a full hallway bath, with one featuring a ceiling fan and the other accented by a decorative chandelier. The spacious fifth bedroom or bonus room boasts vaulted ceilings, a ceiling fan, breathtaking pond views, and a private bath with vanity and tub/shower combo. An upstairs laundry room with washer and dryer included adds everyday convenience. Step outside to enjoy the screened-in back porch and beautifully fenced backyard overlooking the tranquil pond, creating the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. Waterway Palms Plantation offers resort-style amenities and a prime Carolina Forest location close to shopping, dining, golf, entertainment, award-winning schools, and just a short drive to the beach. Square footage is approximate and not guaranteed. Buyer responsible for verification.

Welcome to 5020 Middleton View Drive, a stunning 5-bedroom (or 4 bedroom + bonus), 3.5-bath custom home in Waterway Palms Plantation, one of Carolina Forest’s premier gated Intracoastal Waterway communities. Perfectly positioned on one of the community’s standout lots with peaceful lake/pond views, fountains and beautiful greenery surrounding the clubhouse peninsula, this home offers an exceptional blend of luxury interior finishes, thoughtful storage, smart-home features, and resort-style outdoor living. From the gorgeous mahogany front door and large front porch to the the backyard which was completely transformed in 2025, this home has it all! The backyard paradise is truly the showpiece of the property, featuring a saltwater concrete pool, 3 barstools with marble tops inside the pool, tanning ledge with bubbler, heater/chiller, raised feature wall with three waterfalls, oversized 8x8 hot tub, fire pit with built in bench, putting green/game area/tanning space, fresh professional landscaping, tons of landscape and pool lighting (controllable by app) and a huge outdoor island with quartzite countertops and built-in gas grill. The outdoor aluminum fencing with two gates finishes off the space. Plus enjoy the screened porch that overlooks the pool and water view and includes built-in speakers, creating the perfect setting for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying Carolina sunsets. Inside, the home is equally impressive with hardwood flooring, beautiful trim details, beam accents, gas fireplace, built in bookcases, formal dining, and spacious open concept living. The kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining with a large work island, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, pantry, 36-inch gas range, custom-built/stained wood hood, refrigerator, and beverage cooler. The primary suite is located on the main level and offers a tray ceiling, spa-style bath with double sinks, garden tub, oversized walk-in shower with two shower heads plus an additional slide bar with handheld sprayer, linen closet, and an incredible walk-in closet with an additional dedicated closet for shoes, purses, and accessories. Go up the hardwood staircase to the upstairs where the home continues with spacious bedrooms, a large bonus room, and excellent walk-in storage options, including a huge pull-down attic plus an additional attic space off the bonus room that is ideal for holiday decorations and seasonal storage. Additional upgrades include two separate HVAC systems for upstairs and downstairs comfort, irrigation system, smart thermostats, video doorbell, select smart switches, Sonos surround sound system with i-pad docking station, built-in speakers in the great room, screened porch, and primary bathroom, plus video cameras in the screened porch, bonus room, and living room. The garage has also been upgraded with overhead storage racks, slat wall storage, workbench, and storage cabinet. The home has been gently used, well maintained and there has never been dogs/cats. Waterway Palms Plantation offers one of the best amenity packages in Carolina Forest, including a stunning clubhouse, fitness room, pool table, gazebos, pools, hot tub, playground, tennis, pickleball, basketball, boat storage area, and boat ramp access to the Intracoastal Waterway. This is not just a home; it is a private resort-style retreat in one of Myrtle Beach’s most desirable waterway communities. Be sure to check out the virtual tour and schedule your showing today!

descriptions.desc: Experience elegant Mediterranean-inspired living in this exceptional ranch-style residence nestled within the prestigious gated community of The Bluffs on the Waterway. Offering 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, this beautifully maintained home showcases sophisticated architectural details, inviting interiors, and a picturesque pond setting. A welcoming foyer introduces the thoughtfully designed interior, where the living room features a striking fireplace and coffered ceiling, complemented by a formal dining room suited for intimate gatherings and elegant entertaining. The sunlit dining room provides a tranquil retreat, overlooking the private swimming pool and serene pond beyond. The first-floor primary suite offers a spacious sitting area, elegant tray ceiling, and walk-in closet, while the luxurious en-suite bath features dual vanities, a separate shower, and a soothing whirlpool tub. Designed with both style and functionality in mind, the kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, solid surface countertops, a center island, breakfast bar, and generous workspace. Outdoor living is equally impressive, with a private swimming pool, rear porch, patio, and fenced yard creating a secluded setting for relaxation and entertaining. A stucco exterior, irrigation system, and side-entry two-car garage add to the home's appeal. Residents of The Bluffs enjoy an impressive collection of community amenities, including a clubhouse, outdoor pool, tennis and pickleball courts, playground, gated entrance, boat house on the waterway, day dock, boat ramp, and boat storage. Combining refined interiors, inviting outdoor spaces, and a desirable Intracoastal Waterway location, this distinctive residence offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy upscale living in a sought-after waterfront community. Schedule your showing today!

A truly exceptional, both inside and out, 4 bed 4 bath home awaits in the prestigious Bluffs on the Waterway community! Meticulously maintained, this stunning contemporary home is beautifully landscaped with four palm trees framing the front of the home, rock garden beds, an additional ten palm trees in the backyard and sixteen cypress trees lining the fence and there is an irrigation system as well. Inside, the home is enhanced with striking architectural details, double entrance door with transom, wood flooring, plantation shutters, and upgraded lighting and ceiling fans throughout and the home is wired for security. Versatile floor plan provides functionality and style and includes a spacious living room with beamed ceilings, an electric fireplace, built in cabinetry, and triple sliders leading to the porch, a nice sized dining area with beamed tray ceiling and a spectacular chef's kitchen with marble counters and backsplash, stainless appliances, abundant cabinets and wine rack, Zline gas range/double oven, a pot filler, work island and breakfast bar, and a pantry. An office with French doors and custom tray ceiling is located just off the foyer. The luxurious first floor primary suite features a beamed tray ceiling, fabulous walk-in closet with custom shelving and storage and bath with double sink vanity, marble counters, and large tiled walk-in shower. There are two additional bedrooms and two full baths with vanities, one with shower and one with tub/shower combo on the first floor and a laundry room with cabinets, a sink and folding counter. Upstairs, a fourth bedroom and fourth full bath with vanity and tub/shower is ideal for guests or could also be used as a bonus or game room. There is also walk in attic storage with tons of space on the second floor. The outdoor living space is a veritable paradise and boasts an expansive porch with tile floors and wood beadboard ceiling, remote control floor to ceiling shades, a Sunsetter TV and an outdoor kitchen with Lion premium grill and leather granite countertop and the extended patio just off the porch is the perfect spot to relax with cocktails or dine al fresco. In addition, the oversized 2 car side load garage has epoxy coated floors and the expanded driveway is coated and provides ample guest parking. The Bluffs on the Waterway is a gated community on the ICW that offers superb amenities including two clubhouses, a resort-style pool, tennis and pickleball courts, playgrounds, scenic walking paths, private boat storage, day docks and a community boat launch. Situated in a wonderful central location, this home is convenient to shopping, diverse dining options in Carolina Forest, golf courses, and medical facilities and with easy access to Highway 501, 17 Bypass, 17 Business, and Highway 31. Plus, you will be just minutes away from the beach and all that the Grand Strand has to offer! If you're looking for your dream home, your search ends here! Schedule your private showing today and discover everything this impressive home has to offer!

Welcome to a home that feels special from the moment you pull into the driveway. Set behind classic double front porches and beautiful landscaping, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath custom home in The Bluffs blends timeless Southern charm with thoughtful updates, elegant finishes, and the relaxed lifestyle you've been looking for. Inside, beautiful hardwood floors, tray ceilings, custom wainscoting, and chair rails add warmth and character throughout. Freshly painted interiors create a bright, welcoming feel, while the spacious floor plan offers plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining. The inviting living room features a cozy fireplace with custom built-in bookshelves, creating a comfortable place to gather or unwind. A private study and formal dining room add flexibility and make hosting family and friends a breeze. The kitchen features solid wood custom cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a gas stove. Just off the kitchen, a separate wine bar with a wine cooler makes entertaining easy. Renovated bathrooms and upgraded lighting add a fresh, modern touch while preserving the home's timeless character. A finished bonus room above the garage can become a home office, workout room, playroom, or additional bedroom. Additional storage helps keep everything organized, while the three-car garage provides plenty of room for vehicles, golf carts, a workshop, and coastal-living essentials. Step outside and enjoy one of the home's most charming features---the beautiful double front porches. With both upper and lower levels, there's plenty of space to sit back, catch the breeze, enjoy your morning coffee, or relax in the evening. The backyard offers a charming playhouse complete with electricity and cable. A whole-home water filtration system adds everyday comfort. Located in The Bluffs, a sought-after gated Intracoastal Waterway community, residents enjoy private access to a boat ramp, day docks, and convenient on-site boat storage. Spend the morning on the water, enjoy the community pool, play tennis, explore the playground, or walk the scenic neighborhood trails. Just minutes from the beach, fine dining, championship golf, shopping, and Grand Strand attractions, this home offers the best of both worlds---a beautifully appointed Southern-style home in a peaceful gated community, with the coast right outside your door. This is more than a house; it's a place to slow down, entertain, enjoy the outdoors, and make lasting memories.

Perfectly positioned on .42 acre this custom-built estate offers one floor living with an exceptional opportunity for those who appreciate luxury without compromise. Situated on 2 lots, this is one of the most unique properties in the community! This gorgeous outdoor living area is spectacular! Discover your own private resort with a stunning 18x36 heated swimming pool and spa with tanning ledge that is surrounded by an expansive travertine pool deck, outdoor shower, flagstone garden and grassy lawn area creating a setting that feels more like an exclusive retreat than a private residence. A fully equipped outdoor kitchen with gas grill and plenty of seating will transform every gathering into an unforgettable experience. Relax in the tranquil courtyard listening to the fountain providing you the perfect backdrop for peaceful moments. The main residence offers 3 spacious bedrooms, plus a home office that could be used as a 4th bedroom, along with 2-and-a-half bathrooms all on 1 floor with no stairs. The primary bedroom has tray ceilings, a custom stone gas fireplace with recessed TV and double doors leading to your outdoor courtyard. From the moment you enter to stepping outside in your private retreat, this home will invite you in. The effortless open floor plan has plenty of details to impress. At the heart of the home, the grand great room is anchored by a dramatic custom stone gas fireplace, abundance of windows allowing natural light in, and coffered ceilings creating a warm yet sophisticated gathering place where elegant entertaining and everyday living come together seamlessly. Connected by a covered breezeway you will find 1024 square feet of additional living space featuring a kitchenette and pantry, spacious recreation room with coffered ceilings, recessed 85" TV with built in cabinetry, full bathroom with a tiled shower, and oversized closet storage. Endless possibilities for entertaining as a pool house, private guest residence, elegant mother-in-law suite, or exceptional multigenerational living area. A generous three-car garage with abundant shelving leads to yet another private finished suite above, complete with its own exterior entrance, and full bathroom. An ideal space for overnight guests, a home office, fitness studio, media room, or secluded retreat. Additional storage attic space as well. Step outside and this estate truly comes to life. The Bluffs on the Waterway is an Intracoastal Waterway gated community with direct access to the waterway, boat storage, community pool, tennis courts, playground, 2 clubhouses with 1 situated on the waterway. If you are searching for a unique property with endless opportunities, you will not want to miss this amazing property. Some photos have been virtually staged.

Luxurious custom-built Mediterranean-style two-story stucco home offering 5 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and stunning pond views within the prestigious gated community of The Bluffs on the Waterway, an Intracoastal Waterway (ICW) community. A grand entrance welcomes you with custom cast iron front doors, a handcrafted metal and stone staircase, elegant travertine flooring, soaring ceilings, and a beautiful chandelier. The impressive living room features a coffered ceiling with fan, an open view of the second-floor staircase, cast stone fireplace, built-in cabinetry, wet bar, and custom accent walls. The gourmet chef’s kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, showcasing stainless steel appliances, a gas range, ornate range hood, dual sinks, granite countertops, stone backsplash, custom cabinetry, and a spacious pantry. The adjoining breakfast nook is highlighted by a coffered ceiling and chandelier. The luxurious primary suite offers a ceiling fan, double-sided fireplace, and a spa-inspired bath featuring dual vanities with quartzite countertops, travertine tile, copper accents, a custom walk-in shower with dual shower heads and rain shower, freestanding hammered copper soaking tub, and an extraordinary custom walk-in closet complete with built-ins, center island with seating, and a copper medallion ceiling accented by a chandelier. Additional first-floor features include a private office or formal dining room with coffered ceiling and chandelier, a custom wine cellar beneath the staircase, a half bath, and a spacious laundry room with custom cabinetry, utility sink, and a convenient second-floor laundry chute. The oversized side-load garage includes heavy-duty overhead storage racks and is large enough to accommodate three cars. Upstairs, you'll find four generously sized bedrooms and a large bonus room, all featuring ceiling fans and carpet flooring. Two bedrooms share a full hallway bath, while the other two are connected by a Jack-and-Jill bath, both offering vanities and tub/shower combinations. Sliding glass doors from the living room lead to a large covered and screened lanai with all-season panels, paver tile flooring, a comfortable sitting area, propane grill hookup, and picturesque views of the fully fenced backyard and pond. Additional upgrades include an oversized brick paver driveway, two Rinnai tankless water heaters, industrial ice maker, extensive crown molding, wired security cameras, illuminated front and rear landscaping, irrigation system, electric vehicle charging station, carpeted attic storage, custom remote-controlled blinds, Nest thermostats, security system, and numerous other high-end features throughout. The Bluffs on the Waterway is an Intracoastal Waterway (ICW) community and residents enjoy premier amenities including two clubhouses, resort-style pool, tennis courts, pickleball courts, boat storage, boat ramps, day docks, playground, and gated access. Square footage is approximate; buyers are encouraged to verify.

Custom built Mediterranean style home located in the gated community of The Bluffs on the Waterway, situated on a corner lot with serene pond and fountain views. This well designed home features hardwood floors, high ceilings, crown molding, and a flexible office or optional fourth bedroom on the main level. The open floor plan includes a bar, propane fireplace, abundant natural light, and a spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, pantry, and island. The first floor owner’s suite offers beautiful water views, private outdoor access, and a luxurious bath with dual vanities, jetted tub, tile shower, and walk-in closet. Upstairs features a sitting area, large bonus room, and guest suite with walk-in closet and bath. Recent updates include a Trane HVAC system and Rheem water heater. Fresh paint, professional cleaning, and refreshed landscaping make this home move in ready. Enjoy the inviting veranda, oversized garage, and irrigation system. Community amenities include clubhouses, boat ramp and dock, resort-style pool, tennis and pickleball courts, and close proximity to beaches, golf, dining, and shopping. Located in the Carolina Forest school district. Square footage approximate; buyer to verify.

Built in 2023, this stunning custom home in The Bluffs on the Waterway offers over 3,200 heated square feet with a highly desirable floor plan featuring the primary suite plus two additional bedrooms on the main level and a private guest suite upstairs. Set on a spacious corner homesite with a circular driveway and side-load garage, 950 Bluffview Drive combines newer construction, exceptional craftsmanship, and incredible indoor-outdoor living in one of Carolina Forest's premier gated Intracoastal Waterway communities. Step inside to soaring ceilings, extensive crown molding and custom trim work, designer lighting, beautiful wood and tile flooring, and impressive ceiling details throughout. The open living area is anchored by a striking fireplace with custom built-ins and warm wood accents, creating an inviting space that feels both elegant and comfortable. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen is designed for entertaining with white quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, gas cooking, an ornate range hood, tile backsplash, walk-in pantry, wet bar, breakfast area, and an oversized waterfall-edge island overlooking the main living space. The primary suite is privately positioned on the main level and offers dual walk-in closets and a spa-inspired bath with double vanities, soaking tub, basketweave mosaic tile, and an oversized walk-in shower with dual shower heads. Two additional bedrooms are located on the opposite side of the home, while a dedicated office with glass French doors and a dramatic coffered ceiling provides the perfect work-from-home space. Upstairs, a private fourth bedroom with its own full bath and separate thermostat is ideal for guests or a bonus retreat. A walk-in attic provides convenient additional storage. One of the home's standout features is the expansive screened porch. Large sliding glass doors create a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor living spaces, while a wood-accent ceiling, dual fans, recessed lighting, and built-in BBQ area make this an exceptional space for entertaining or relaxing year-round. Additional features include a custom mudroom/drop zone with built-in lockers, bench seating and storage, separate laundry room, tankless water heater, irrigation system, and abundant storage throughout. Living in The Bluffs on the Waterway means enjoying much more than a beautiful home. This gated Intracoastal Waterway community offers two clubhouses, a resort-style pool, tennis and pickleball courts, playground, boat storage, boat ramps, and day docks. If you're looking for newer construction without the wait to build, a thoughtfully designed floor plan with most living spaces on the main level, exceptional outdoor entertaining space, and the Intracoastal Waterway lifestyle, 950 Bluffview Drive deserves to be seen. Square footage is approximate and not guaranteed. Buyer is responsible for verification.

Mediterranean-style luxury estate offering four bedrooms, four full bathrooms, and a half bath, perfectly situated on a scenic pond lot in the prestigious Bluffs on the Waterway, Intracoastal Waterway community. This stunning stucco residence features a clay tile roof, tile flooring throughout the main living areas, luxury vinyl plank flooring in the primary suite, and carpet in the secondary bedrooms. Enter through elegant iron front doors into a private courtyard designed for entertaining, complete with a saltwater pool, grilling area (with propane stub), outdoor gathering space with TV that conveys, and a detached "mother-in-law" style guest suite ideal for extended family, guests, or a private office. A second set of iron doors welcomes you into the grand foyer featuring a tray ceiling, chandelier, decorative columns, crown molding, and impressive architectural details throughout. The living room showcases a tray ceiling with chandelier, fireplace, two floor outlets for convenience, and sliding glass doors leading to the covered rear porch overlooking the fully fenced backyard and tranquil pond. The formal dining room is enhanced with a tray ceiling and chandelier, creating an elegant setting for gatherings. The Gourmet Chef's kitchen is beautifully appointed with granite countertops, a breakfast bar, custom cabinetry, a decorative tile backsplash with custom inlay beneath the ornate range hood, tray ceiling with ceiling fan, deep copper farmhouse sink, separate copper prep sink with pot filler in the work island, wine refrigerator, and stainless-steel appliances including a six-burner gas range with slide out spice racks on either side. Adjacent to the kitchen, the spacious family room features a double tray ceiling, built-in surround sound speakers, two floor outlets, and large chandelier, providing additional space for relaxation and entertaining. The sofa, loveseat, and credenza with the sound system electronics all convey. The luxurious primary suite offers double-door entry, LVP flooring, double tray ceiling with fan, sitting area, two custom walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired ensuite bath with dual vanities, jetted garden tub, and a tiled glass shower featuring dual heads and a rain shower. descriptions.desc: Summer afternoons by your own in-ground pool, viewed from a vaulted screened porch, set the tone for this all-brick two-story in the gated Covington Lakes East community of Carolina Forest, Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. With five bedrooms, four and a half baths, and 4,054 heated square feet on a fenced lot, the home offers two primary suites on the main level and room for everyone to spread out. A two-story foyer opens to a formal dining room with a tray ceiling and a living room anchored by a granite-surround fireplace. The kitchen is built for gathering, with an oversized granite island and breakfast bar, tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, double wall ovens, a gas range with vent hood, a pantry, and a sunlit breakfast nook. The main-level primary suite features a tray ceiling, sitting area, dual walk-in closets, and an en-suite bath with a garden tub, tiled shower, and double vanity. A second main-level suite has its own full bath, and two more first-floor bedrooms share a full bath, ready for guests or a home office. Upstairs, a fifth bedroom with an en-suite bath joins a large bonus room. Hardwood, tile, and carpet flooring, a tankless gas water heater, a laundry room with drop zone, and an attached two-car garage with parking for six complete the interior. Out back, the Carolina room opens to the screened porch overlooking the pool, finished with a cool-touch rubberized surround, and a fully fenced yard backing to tall trees. Covington Lakes East offers a gated entrance, outdoor community pool, and clubhouse, with Carolina Forest Boulevard, Highway 501, Coastal Carolina University, and Myrtle Beach shopping, dining, and beaches minutes away. Two main-level primary suites, an in-ground pool, and all-brick construction come together in Covington Lakes East, Carolina Forest, Myrtle Beach, SC 29579. Listing agent is related to the sellers. descriptions.desc: Discover your own private oasis in the beautiful, sought-after community of Prestwick! This well-appointed home offers an inviting open floor plan, hardwood, carpet and tile flooring, a charming Lincoln-log gas fireplace, plantation shutters throughout, and flat ceilings with LED lighting. The spacious kitchen features stainless steel appliances and a walk-in pantry, while the primary suite boasts two walk-in closets and an additional linen closet. Enjoy the comfort and convenience of a large walk-in laundry room with farm sink and cabinetry, central vacuum, intercom system, and a floored walk-in attic for extra storage. A Trane HVAC system and stainless steel gutters with leaf guards. Step outside to a beautifully landscaped backyard or relax on the tiled, screened porch overlooking your private retreat. Additional features include a 10-zone Rain Bird irrigation system, and ceiling fans throughout. Adjacent to the driving range, with an HOA-maintained hedge providing added privacy, this home is also just a short walk to the clubhouse. Prestwick is ideally located less than a mile from the Atlantic Ocean and offers an award-winning 18-hole golf course, community pool and clay tennis courts. Experience the exceptional lifestyle, privacy and convenience that make Prestwick such a special place to call home!

The comfortable floor plan is ideal for everyday living as well as entertaining family and friends. Prestwick is known for it's beautiful, gated entrance and convenient location. All residents enjoy the full size pool, tennis/pickleball courts. Whether you are looking for a full time residence, vacation getaway ot investment opportunity 2012 Ladybank Drive is property worth seeing. Come discover the relaxed lifestyle and excellent location this Prestwick home has to offer.

Welcome to this stunning, move-in ready, fully updated home in Prestwick Country Club in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. Prestwick is a gated and guarded community with a golf course, driving range, pool complex, and tennis and pickle ball club. This 5 bedroom, 3.5 bath home sits on a large and maturely landscaped .33 acre corner lot! The landscaping has been well thought out and has an irrigation system and French drains around the perimeter. The curb appeal is stunning with a side load garage, half wrap around porch and plenty of space to sit outside. The concrete fiber exterior, shutters, and trim has been recently painted as well as the whole interior. Walk through the front door and be greeted with extremely high ceilings and the formal dining room that opens to the kitchen and living room.There are engineered SPC floors throughout the first floor and tile. The living room has a gas fireplace, built in cabinets surrounding theTV and an extra living space that enlarges the living room or could be a nice sitting room or sunroom with a view of the backyard. The kitchen boasts plenty of cabinets, granite countertops and a new granite island with single bowl sink. The range is a brand new JennAir gas 6-burner with exhaust. There is the option of dining at the breakfast bar, dining nook, or formal dining room. The spacious owners' suite is designed to impress, featuring a walk-in closet and French doors that lead to a luxurious bathroom. The bathroom is equipped with double sinks, a separate soaking tub, a frameless tile shower with dual shower heads (including a rain head), and additional discreet pull-out storage along with a laundry bin. The laundry room, conveniently situated on the first floor near the owners' suite, boasts extra cabinets, a tile backsplash, and a dedicated folding area, highlighting its practicality and style. The garage is a true two-car space complete with a new hot water heater, a recently installed garage motor, and a whole-house surge protector for added convenience and safety. Up the hardwood stairs you'll find two bedrooms that share a remodeled jack and jill bathroom. This updated space features custom cabinetry, a subway tile backsplash, a tub/shower combination, and tasteful, fresh updates throughout. The other guest bedroom shares a bathroom with the largest room upstairs, which is currently configured as an office but can also serve as a bedroom. There is plenty of storage in this home and two attic entrances with one having pull down stairs. At the rear of the house, the painted concrete and landscaping lights create a peaceful and private atmosphere, perfect for enjoying the outdoors and yard. The quality of this home is evident—you won't want to miss out on this opportunity. The HOA includes use of the large pool and facilities, trash and recycling pickup, 24/7 gated access and a physical guard. Golf, tennis and social memberships are available for purchase as a separate fee from the monthly HOA dues. Prestwick is centrally located to everything that the Grand Strand has to offer, multiple beaches, shopping, dining,State Parks, and the Myrtle Beach International Airport. Schedule your showing today!

Whether you're searching for a primary residence, vacation getaway, or investment opportunity, 1827 Windmere Way delivers a wonderful coastal lifestyle in one of Myrtle Beach's most desirable locations.

Introducing this beautiful all brick home in the prestigious gated community of Prestwick. This single level three bedroom two and a half bathroom home has everything you have been looking for. Located on a premium golf course lot, enjoy gorgeous views of holes 6, 7, and 8, while you relax in the oversized sun room. Upon entering the front door, you will be greeted by a charming foyer. The large living room features vaulted ceilings with skylights and is open to the dining room and kitchen. In this beautiful kitchen you will notice ample cabinet space, counter space, and a large pantry. Another added feature in the kitchen include an instant hot water spigot. Enjoy the space for barstools at the kitchen counter or sit in the dining room with a large bay window for your meals. The primary bedroom includes a large ensuite bathroom with jetted tub, walk in shower, and double vanity as well as a walk in closet. The larger secondary bedroom has a connecting bathroom with a walk in shower that also opens to the hallway for access to the third bedroom. The laundry room is located near all three bedrooms and has great cabinet storage as well as a fold out ironing board. My favorite feature of this home includes a fully heated and cooled space directly off the garage to work on all your projects in a comfortable environment. This room is a handymans dream and it includes a utility sink for any messy projects. The backyard has a large concrete slab perfect for grilling or relaxing and enjoying your beautiful surroundings. Prestwick has an olympic sized swimming pool, tennis, and pickle ball courts. The golf course and tennis are a separate membership. Premium cable & internet and trash pickup with recycling are included in the HOA. Prestwick is located just a few short minutes from Myrtle Beach State Park, Market Common, and tons of restaurants, shopping, and more. Call today to schedule your showing!

On a quiet cul-de-sac in gated Bellwood Landing at Prince Creek, this custom home pairs everyday livability with big-ticket peace of mind. A two-story great room anchors the main level, centered on a stacked-stone fireplace with wood beam mantle and flanked by custom built-ins. Hickory hardwood floors run throughout. The kitchen delivers double wall ovens, stainless appliances, and deep cabinetry with room to gather. The primary suite offers a garden tub, dual vanities, and his and her closets including a generous walk-in, and a large bonus room upstairs flexes as media room, gym, or home office. Out back, a screened porch overlooks a private wooded yard with paver pathways, stone-edged garden beds, and fencing. At 0.44 acres with mature pines behind it, the privacy here is the kind you cannot renovate into a lot later. The heavy lifting is already done: roof (2022), gutters, newer heat pumps, electric water heater, updated lighting and electrical, replaced windows, custom blinds throughout, and new door hardware. Nothing on the five-year maintenance list is waiting on the next owner. Inside the gates, The Park at Prince Creek offers two pools with a children’s splash area, lighted tennis and pickleball courts, basketball, a playground, and a covered pavilion with grills and picnic seating. Outside them is the reason people move to Murrells Inlet in the first place. The MarshWalk is minutes away, a half-mile boardwalk of waterfront restaurants, live music, and boats coming in at sunset. Huntington Beach State Park and Brookgreen Gardens sit just down Highway 17, pairing three miles of undeveloped shoreline and some of the best birding on the East Coast with the oldest public sculpture garden in the country. Garden City Beach is close enough for an after-dinner walk. Golfers are spoiled for choice, with championship courses throughout the area and TPC Myrtle Beach inside Prince Creek itself. Add the marinas, the fishing charters, and the shops and restaurants of nearby Pawleys Island, and most of what you would drive an hour for somewhere else is just a few minutes from this driveway. See it in the late afternoon, when the light comes through the pines behind the porch. That is the version of this house the photographs cannot quite hold. Some photos in this listing have been virtually staged.
