Features include: • Located in a natural gas community • Gas fireplace • Dedicated gas line for outdoor cooking • High-end appliances • Hard surface countertops • Custom cabinetry • Hardwood flooring throughout (no carpet) The spacious second level offers a large bonus room, fourth bedroom, and full bath — ideal for a private guest suite or in-law retreat. The primary suite is equipped with a walk-in jacuzzi tub, and a full-house generator provides peace of mind during power outages. Custom plantation shutters complete the home’s timeless appeal. Bellwood Landing residents enjoy access to a clubhouse, multiple pools, and pickleball courts ;all within a secure, gated setting. This is Lowcountry living at its finest — charm, function, and location all in one.

Welcome to 308 West End Ct., a custom home located in the gated community of Bellwood Landing at Prince Creek in Murrells Inlet. Low Country in style with a floor plan suitable for any stage of life. Private lot tucked away in the back of a cul de sac with easy access to area shopping, golf courses, amenity center,.....the marsh walk in Murrells Inlet is approximately 5 minutes away! Offering over 4,000 square feet consisting of 2 living areas, a private home office/study - primary/owners suite, 2 additional bedrooms, 2.5 more baths, spacious eat-in kitchen, laundry room, formal dining, entry way, 2-car garage & upstairs you'll find a bonus room, bedroom & full bath. Upgrades like trey ceilings, ornate moldings, plantation shutters, custom range hood, 2 gas fireplaces,.....In the backyard you'll enjoy the in ground, heated -salt water pool! Don't miss out on this opportunity!

Stately Custom Brick Home in Bellwood Landing | St. James School District: Built by a respected custom home builder as his personal residence, this timeless brick estate is a standout in both design and quality. Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in the gated, natural gas community of Bellwood Landing in Prince Creek West, the home offers exceptional privacy and craftsmanship, all within the sought-after St. James school district—just in time to be settled before the school year begins! A stately façade with arched brickwork, tall columns, and manicured landscaping welcomes you into light-filled interiors featuring soaring ceilings, rich millwork, and a layout that was thoughtfully designed for today’s modern family. From the spacious great room with coffered ceilings and a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, to the formal dining room and nearby home office with a dramatic two-story window wall, every space feels purposeful and inviting. Function and Style in Every Detail: The gourmet kitchen offers custom cabinetry, granite countertops, a gas range with custom hood, classic subway tile, and a showstopping accent wall behind the cooktop. A large breakfast bar and adjoining dining nook make it ideal for both entertaining and everyday life. The first-floor owner’s suite is a true retreat, featuring tray ceilings, dual walk-in closets, and French doors leading to the covered back porch. The ensuite bath includes a freestanding soaking tub set on a river rock base, a walk-in tiled shower, dual vanities, and warm maple cabinetry. Flexible Upstairs Living: Two generously sized guest bedrooms upstairs each have oversized closets and access to two full bathrooms. A large bonus room with dormer windows, built-in wet bar, and extra storage provides flexibility for a playroom, media room, or creative space. Superior Construction & Hidden Perks: Constructed with 6” insulated concrete foam for durability, energy efficiency, and soundproofing, this home also includes R50 attic insulation, a whole-house Generac generator, and central vacuum system. And yes—there’s even a “secret” feature worth asking about! A Lifestyle You’ll Love: Bellwood Landing offers residents access to The Park at Prince Creek West—featuring a pool, tennis courts, playground, picnic pavilion, and scenic nature trail. Just minutes from the Murrells Inlet Marsh Walk, local restaurants, golf courses, and shopping, this location provides a quiet coastal lifestyle without sacrificing convenience.

Welcome to 644 Whispering Pines Ct in the gated neighborhood of Bellwood Landing in Prince Creek West, Murrells Inlet, SC. This stunning 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Southern Mission-style home boasts exquisite upgrades at every turn. As you step inside, you’ll be immediately captivated by the attention to detail. The chef-inspired kitchen features Thermador appliances, a spacious quartz island, a double oven, and a walk-in pantry. A whole-house water filter ensures pristine water throughout the home. The oversized family room offers a cozy retreat with a coffered ceiling and a gas fireplace. With surround sound speakers and 16-foot accordion doors opening to the back porch, you’ll enjoy the perfect blend of indoor-outdoor living. The back porch features another gas fireplace and retractable screen, creating a comfortable space to relax year-round. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the Bocchi court and putting green, beautifully lit for evening enjoyment and family fun. Whether hosting gatherings or enjoying some quiet time, this home offers the ideal balance of luxury and comfort. The oversized garage includes ample space for vehicles and storage, with the added convenience of an oversized closet and a car charging station for modern living. Don’t miss the opportunity to experience the ultimate in luxury living at 644 Whispering Pines Ct.

Discover unparalleled privacy and luxury in this stunning new construction home, in the Gated Bellwood Landing section of Prince Creek, designed to impress with high-end finishes and thoughtful upgrades throughout. Boasting 4 spacious bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and an oversized 3-car garage, this home offers both comfort and style in every corner. Tucked away on a lot that backs up to a tranquil pond, the peaceful setting is matched by the home's charming curb appeal. Inside, you'll find soaring ceilings and an abundance of natural light, highlighted by 12-foot tray ceilings and elegant Luxury Vinyl Plank flooring that flow seamlessly through the open-concept living areas. The great room, complete with a cozy fireplace, flows effortlessly into the dining area and gourmet kitchen, where the chef of the home will appreciate the gas cooktop, upgraded granite countertops, soft-close wood cabinetry, and a spacious walk-in pantry. Large sliding doors lead to the back porch-perfect for relaxing or entertaining as you take in the serene backyard views. Two of the bedrooms feature private en-suite bathrooms, including a luxurious owner's suite with a tray ceiling, walk-in closet, double vanity, soaking garden tub, and a beautifully tiled shower. The additional bedrooms are equally impressive with custom wood-shelved closets. A well-appointed laundry room and a third full bath complete the interior layout, while the oversized 3-car garage provides ample storage for tools and would likely fit 4 cars. If you're seeking refined living with plenty of space to unwind-both inside and out-this exceptional property is one you won't want to miss! Bellwood Landing is just a quick drive to the beach, and you have Grocery Stores, Restaurants, and Coffee Shops just one stoplight away. Photos in this listing are of another home, same floor plan built by this builder in a different neighborhood. Construction on this home to begin early April and anticipated completion date is late october early november.

descriptions.desc: Welcome to 4333 Hunters Wood Dr, an exceptional 6-bedroom, 6.5-bath residence offering space, privacy & amenities for truly elevated Lowcountry living. Designed with everyday comfort & effortless entertaining in mind, this impressive home features generous living spaces and an incredible outdoor retreat overlooking the 2nd hole of the Wachesaw Plantation golf course. An amazing large private saltwater pool with a large outdoor living area defines the outdoor space, while a charming gazebo, an outdoor kitchen and full bath complete the outdoor space. Whether you're hosting friends and family, enjoying a quiet afternoon by the pool, or gathering for an evening cookout, this beautifully designed space makes outdoor living a true extension of the home. Inside the home you will find a large foyer, with a formal dining room off the gourmet kitchen with oversized pantry. The sunken living room has a gas fireplace and built-ins, coffered ceiling, and leads to a den with French doors overlooking the pool. The primary suite on the main level features a wonderful ensuite with double vanities, tile shower and separate soaking tub. A large walk-in closet and large flex space overlooking the pool complete the owners' suite. Formal dining room, gourmet kitchen with large pantry, and a powder room complete the main floor. Four additional bedrooms and 3 baths upstairs provide exceptional flexibility for family and guests. The separate in-law/nanny suite with private entrance, accessible from the upstairs as well, offers additional privacy and independence. Attached 2 car garage and large circular driveway provide ample space for parking. Located in desirable Murrells Inlet, this property puts you close to beautiful beaches, boating, golf, waterfront dining, shopping, and all the coastal amenities that make this area such a sought-after place to live. Wachesaw Plantation offers many amenities in addition to those included in the monthly POA fees. With its expansive floor plan, private pool, outdoor kitchen, gazebo, and versatile guest suite, this home offers the perfect blend of luxury, functionality, and relaxed coastal living. Don't miss out -- call now to schedule your showing!

The rear terrace curves around live oaks that were already standing when this home was designed. The same attention to how the home would live carries through this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath brick home offering approximately 3,429 heated square feet in Wachesaw Plantation, Murrells Inlet. Designed by local architect Steve Goggans, the home overlooks the 15th hole of Wachesaw Plantation Club's Tom Fazio-designed golf course. Inside, the two-story great room establishes the scale of the home, with Brazilian cherry floors, substantial millwork and French doors opening outside. The fireplace features a propane-burning replica of an English coal basket reminiscent of one in the owner's grandmother's home. The library was built for books, with custom cherry built-ins behind mahogany doors, while wall space throughout the home was deliberately preserved for a fine-art collection. The kitchen pairs a well-planned workspace with storage that goes beyond the expected. Quartz countertops, a two-level island, induction cooktop, double wall ovens and warming drawer support the cooking, while an accordion-style pantry, walk-in larder beneath the stairs and cabinetry for serving pieces provide storage. A bay-window breakfast area offers plenty of room for everyday dining. The adjoining Carolina room, with wet bar, wine chiller and ice maker, extends the entertaining space and opens directly to the terrace. A main-level guest suite has a private bath and terrace access and could serve as the starting point for a future first-floor primary. Upstairs, the primary suite has a bay-window sitting area overlooking the grounds and course, plus a separate home office that complements the main-level library for two dedicated workspaces. The walk-in dressing room is almost a suite unto itself, making use of spaces beneath the eaves for luggage and seasonal storage. Two additional bedrooms share a Jack-and-Jill bath, and a gallery overlooks the great room. Wachesaw Plantation is gated with 24-hour security at the front entry and amenities including a park, dog park, playground, basketball and pickleball courts. Membership in the private Wachesaw Plantation Club is separate and optional, offering Tom Fazio-designed golf, tennis, a pool complex and riverfront dining at Kimbels. Just outside the gates, Wacca Wache Marina sits on the Waccamaw River/Intracoastal Waterway. Tidelands Waccamaw Community Hospital is approximately 2.9 miles away, Huntington Beach State Park 5.2 miles, and Brookgreen Gardens 5.7 miles. Across the back of the house, the great room, Carolina room and guest suite open onto the elevated terrace, creating an easy connection between indoors and out. Stone pavers, brick pillars and a sweeping brick staircase lead into grounds framed by palms, ferns, roses and native plantings beneath moss-draped live oaks. With the 15th hole beyond, this is a setting made for throwing open the doors, entertaining outside and enjoying the Lowcountry landscape, whether golf is part of your life or not.

Move-in ready and furnished! 4404 Hitching Post Lane is located in the highly sought after Wachesaw Plantation which features 24-hour guard gated entrance, beautifully maintained common areas, moss-draped oak trees and membership opportunities to join a private club with access to Tom Fazio designed private golf course, private dining, and tennis facilities. The Carriage Run Cottages offer owners the opportunity to enjoy luxury living without the maintenance. Exterior Insurance, landscaping, irrigation, pest control, exterior painting, and all exterior maintenance are included in the association fees. This 2 bedroom 2 Bath unit features open floorplan on one level. Built-in cabinets and fireplace creates an intimate and cozy living area which, together with the large back porch and private back yard, makes an ideal place for entertaining. The property is being offered furnished at the current listing price. Reach out today to schedule a showing. Listing agent related to seller.

Elegantly positioned along the 8th fairway of the private Tom Fazio designed golf course within prestigious Wachesaw Plantation, this exceptional custom estate offers timeless Lowcountry architecture, refined luxury, and thoughtfully designed living across three spacious levels all serviced by a private elevator. Nestled on a beautifully wooded and private 0.70 acre homesite on one of the community’s most desirable streets, the property offers approximately 5,970 heated square feet and over 8,080 total square feet. A large circular driveway and expansive parking area provide impressive curb appeal and ample parking for family and guests. As you arrive on the main living level, the home truly begins to impress. A grand foyer with custom built-ins immediately introduces the elegant scale and craftsmanship carried throughout the residence. The foyer transitions seamlessly into a gracious formal dining room and an elegant piano sitting room featuring a wine bar and wine fridge. Beyond, the expansive great room with fireplace serves as the heart of the home with soaring proportions, exceptional natural light, and seamless flow into the recently completed professional grade kitchen renovation. Designed with both luxury and functionality in mind, the kitchen features custom cabinetry, high end appliances including a Wolf range and warming drawer, and a beautifully appointed butler’s pantry complete with prep sink, icemaker, additional prep space, and large walk-in pantry. The main level primary suite offers a luxurious private retreat with dual walk-in closets and a fully renovated spa inspired bathroom featuring separate vanities with dedicated sit-down makeup area, soaking tub, oversized custom tiled shower, and generous linen storage. Just off the great room, the elevated covered porch and recently added sun deck create exceptional outdoor living and entertaining spaces overlooking the peaceful golf course setting and mature wooded surroundings. Designed for both entertaining and everyday comfort, the lower level features three spacious bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a large laundry room, and an expansive secondary living/playroom enhanced by a recent 250 square foot addition. This inviting space opens directly onto the backyard patio overlooking the picturesque par five fairway and tranquil natural surroundings. One bedroom features a private ensuite bath while the additional bedrooms share a split bathroom layout with separate vanities and a private shower and toilet area. The home also offers an attached two car garage in addition to a separate single car garage, abundant closet space throughout, and expansive climate controlled storage space. The upper level provides an incredible private retreat ideal for guests, extended family, or multigenerational living. Easily accessible by elevator yet tucked away from the primary living areas, this level features an additional bedroom, recently added full bathroom, a private office or den space, and expansive climate controlled walk-in storage rarely found in today’s homes. Extensive improvements during ownership include a full kitchen renovation with removal of walls to create an open living design, updated bathrooms including the primary suite and powder bath, new flooring throughout the lower level, replacement gutters, upgraded water heaters, garage door systems, and expanded lower level living space. Additional highlights include dual geothermal HVAC systems for improved energy efficiency, solid core doors throughout, electric dog fencing, all new upstairs carpet, and a reconfigured laundry room. This is a rare opportunity to own a truly exceptional custom estate where timeless design, quality craftsmanship, modern updates, and one of Wachesaw Plantation’s most peaceful golf course settings come together to create an extraordinary lifestyle property. Call the listing agent, or your Realtor, to schedule a private viewing or to learn more about this exquisite Lowcountry property.

Located on one of the premier homesites in Wachesaw Plantation, 2073 Turnberry Lane is a custom built, never previously sold Lowcountry three story home set on an expansive .68 acre lot offering over 6,200 heated square feet and more than 9,200 total square feet, designed around outdoor living, entertaining, and capturing some of the most desirable views along the South Strand. Positioned along the 17th green and 18th tee box of the privately designed Tom Fazio golf course, the home overlooks a pond system naturally fed by the Intracoastal Waterway, creating dynamic, ever changing water views. The thoughtfully designed floor plan maximizes these scenic views throughout, allowing golf and water views from just about every room. The main level features 10 foot ceilings with tray ceiling details, enlarged bedrooms, custom designed closets, and abundant storage. The chef’s kitchen includes custom cabinetry, granite countertops, a large island, gas range, and walk in butler’s pantry, flowing into the main living areas. A wet bar with wine fridge and ice maker adds to the entertaining experience. Outdoor living is a true highlight, with a main level covered porch spanning over 1,200 square feet and a ground level covered patio exceeding 1,100 square feet, both with brick fireplaces. The ground level is designed for entertaining with a full outdoor kitchen, bar seating, and covered lounge area with fireplace and television, all overlooking the backyard, golf course, and water. A conveniently located half bath provides easy access from this space. The primary suite offers serene backyard views of the golf course and pond and features dual walk in closets, two linen closets, dual vanities, soaking tub, and a large walk in shower with multiple shower heads and rainmaker, along with a conveniently located laundry area. The ground level includes two additional bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms and large walk in closets, a separate living area, and a mudroom and second laundry room just off the garage with a pet and mudroom shower. Upstairs offers a spacious bonus room, two additional bedrooms both with ensuite bathrooms, creating a private retreat for guests or extended family. Additional features include two tankless water heaters, irrigation supported by a private well with optional main water connection, and multiple fireplaces including a ground level wood burning and main level gas fireplace convertible to wood. Appliances convey, along with both sets of washers and dryers, as well as the trampoline and swing set. Residents enjoy access to a playground, dog park, and basketball and pickleball courts. A pre-listing home inspection, mold, and radon testing are available. This is a rare opportunity to own a custom home on one of the most desirable homesites in Wachesaw Plantation where outdoor living, entertaining, and exceptional golf and water views define the lifestyle. Please contact the listing agent, or your Realtor, for additional information or to schedule a private showing.

Sold before listed. Exceptional custom-built home in the heart of Wachesaw Plantation. This meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers timeless Lowcountry architecture, outstanding craftsmanship, and numerous upgrades throughout. Features include an updated kitchen with custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, gas range, hardwood flooring, extensive moldings, plantation shutters, formal dining room with tray ceiling, spacious great room with fireplace and built-ins, and a bright Carolina room overlooking the beautifully landscaped backyard. The oversized primary suite features a luxurious bath with dual vanities, whirlpool tub, and walk-in shower. Additional highlights include a large laundry room, detached two-car garage, whole-house generator, inviting front porch, expansive rear patio, and professionally maintained grounds. Located within one of Murrells Inlet's premier gated communities, this home exemplifies the quality, character, and lifestyle that make Wachesaw Plantation so desirable.

Located in the desirable Carriage Run Cottage section of Wachesaw Plantation, this charming 2-bedroom, 2-bath Lowcountry cottage offers timeless appeal, peaceful surroundings, and an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of the area’s most sought-after gated communities at an attractive price point. Surrounded by mature trees and beautifully maintained landscaping, the home features a durable metal roof along with inviting front and rear porches ideal for relaxing and enjoying the tranquil setting. Inside, the light-filled floor plan showcases hardwood flooring throughout the main living areas and bedrooms, with all wood floors replaced approximately 4-5 years ago. Interior paint was also updated during the seller’s ownership, complementing the bright and welcoming feel throughout the home. The spacious living room features a fireplace, custom built-ins, crown molding, and an open flow into the dining area, creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere for everyday living or entertaining. The kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, generous counter space, and updated appliances, with the washer, dryer, and dishwasher all replaced in 2024-2025. Additional updates during the seller’s ownership include replacement of the rear doors, water heater replacement in 2024-2025, and the addition of Trex decking on the front porch and rear stairs for low-maintenance outdoor living. A small refrigerator located in the hallway closet will also convey with the property. Both bedrooms are generously sized and offer abundant natural light. The spacious primary suite features a private Carolina Room overlooking the peaceful setting, creating the perfect space for a sitting room, reading nook, office, or private retreat. The home includes a private driveway but does not currently have a garage or carport, though there may be potential for future addition with ARB approval. The Carriage Run Cottage HOA provides exceptional exterior maintenance and community services including roof coverage, siding and trim maintenance, hazard insurance, termite bond, pest control, irrigation, landscaping, road and walkway maintenance, decorative fencing, and more, allowing for easy Lowcountry living. Residents also enjoy access to the neighborhood park within the gated community featuring pickleball courts, playground, and dog park areas, further enhancing the lifestyle and sense of community Wachesaw Plantation is known for. Golf, pool, and dining amenities are available separately through optional club membership. Enjoy the privacy and beauty of Wachesaw Plantation while being conveniently located just minutes from the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, shopping, dining, and area beaches. Contact the listing agent, or your Realtor, to learn more about this property or to schedule a private viewing.

Beautifully updated custom home located in the gated Wachesaw Plantation community. This single-level 3BR/2BA home features vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, plantation shutters, abundant natural light, and a spacious open layout ideal for entertaining. The renovated kitchen offers updated cabinetry, granite countertops, designer finishes, upgraded appliances, and a stunning wood-plank ceiling. The spacious primary suite includes walk-in closets and a beautifully updated bath. Additional highlights include a formal office with French doors, screened porch, oversized garage/workshop space, and mature wooded landscaping for added privacy. Wachesaw Plantation offers 24-hour gated security with optional golf, pool, tennis, and clubhouse memberships, all conveniently located near Murrells Inlet dining, shopping, the MarshWalk, and the beach.

Timeless Southern elegance with curated, character rich interiors defines this exceptional residence at 4338 Hunters Wood Drive in the private, gated community of Wachesaw Plantation. Showcasing classic Lowcountry design with custom millwork and traditional detailing, this home offers a level of warmth, craftsmanship, and architectural character rarely found in newer construction. From the moment you arrive, a thoughtfully designed approach welcomes you into a Charleston inspired setting. The backyard has been extensively enhanced to create a series of private garden rooms, highlighted by a custom Charleston style brick courtyard with a fountain feature, mature landscaping, and expanded outdoor living spaces. Bluestone hardscaping surrounds the pool, complemented by landscape lighting, integrated sound, and drip irrigation, creating a truly immersive and functional outdoor environment. The backyard is a true showpiece, centered around a beautifully updated saltwater pool with a dark blue aggregate Diamondbrite finish and full width entry steps, offering both visual impact and ease of use. A covered pergola with climbing greenery creates a relaxed, resort style setting, while the fully equipped outdoor kitchen makes entertaining effortless. A conveniently located bathroom just off the pergola serves the pool area, enhancing both comfort and functionality. Inside, the home offers a versatile and well designed layout featuring three bedrooms, a designated office, and a Carolina Room filled with natural light. Two bedrooms are located on the main level, one of which could easily function as a primary suite if desired, offering flexibility for a variety of living arrangements. The main living area features a sunken living room with a gas fireplace, creating a warm and inviting focal point. Just off the living room is a bright and airy Carolina Room, while the breakfast and dining area flows seamlessly into the spacious kitchen. The kitchen has been updated with oak stained flooring and is complemented by a wet bar with direct access to the outdoor living spaces, enhancing the home’s indoor outdoor lifestyle. The upstairs primary suite serves as a private retreat, complete with a screened porch offering views of the 8th fairway of the Tom Fazio private golf course. The expansive primary bathroom features dual vanities, a soaking tub, and separate shower, all complemented by abundant natural light. Multiple closets and generous storage spaces are thoughtfully integrated off the primary suite, providing both functionality and organization. Extensive capital improvements further elevate the home, including all new Pella Architect Series windows with oak stained sashes, new skylights that enhance natural light, an architectural shingle roof, and black gutter system, all contributing to both aesthetic appeal and long term peace of mind. Additional features include plantation shutters, rich woodwork, and custom built-ins throughout, along with a new condenser installed in 2025, a gas powered generator, and a garage freezer, all of which will convey. Perfectly positioned within one of the area’s most sought after communities, this home offers established surroundings, mature landscaping, and close proximity to the golf course, all within the prestigious setting of Wachesaw Plantation. Please contact the listing agent, or your Realtor, to schedule a private showing or learn more about this exceptional property.

Located within the private, gated community of Wachesaw Plantation, 4415 Paddock Run Drive offers classic Lowcountry charm in one of Murrells Inlet’s most highly sought after Intracoastal Waterway view neighborhoods. This professionally decorated Carriage Run Cottage features three bedrooms, three and one half bathrooms, and a detached two car garage, all overlooking the peaceful waters of Lake Lachicotte. Heart pine floors anchor the main living level and extend throughout the primary living spaces, creating a warm and inviting feel. The home has been tastefully renovated with a thoughtful balance of coastal style and timeless finishes. The kitchen and bathrooms have been updated with quality materials, tile flooring in the baths, and finishes that complement the character of the home without feeling trendy. The primary suite is located on the main level and includes an updated ensuite bathroom with custom tile work and generous storage. Upstairs, two guest bedrooms each feature private ensuite bathrooms, offering excellent separation and privacy for family and guests. Heart pine flooring continues throughout both upstairs bedrooms. A covered front porch provides a welcoming space to relax, read, or unwind, while the rear of the home enjoys tranquil water views across Lake Lachicotte, perfect for morning coffee or quiet evenings. The detached two car garage offers convenient parking and additional storage while maintaining the traditional cottage streetscape. Wachesaw Plantation offers optional membership to its private country club, featuring a Tom Fazio designed golf course, clubhouse, pool, tennis courts, and Kimbels, the club’s waterfront dining venue known for panoramic Intracoastal Waterway views. The Wachesaw community also features a three acre park with pickleball courts, playground, and dog park, available to all property owners. Conveniently located near area beaches, the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, dining, shopping, and nearby medical facilities, this move in ready home presents an exceptional opportunity to enjoy Lowcountry living in one of the Grand Strand’s most established gated communities.

Welcome to 4955 Fulton Place in the highly sought after Wachesaw Plantation community of Murrells Inlet. This beautifully maintained single level home offers approximately 2,200 heated square feet and 2,765 total square feet with three bedrooms and two bathrooms, all situated on a spacious .47 acre lot. Inside, the home features an open and airy floor plan with vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, hardwood flooring in the main living areas, and custom built in cabinetry surrounding the fireplace. The recently updated kitchen includes all new appliances installed in 2024 along with updated fixtures and finishes that complement the open living and dining areas. Just off the kitchen is a custom built in desk and cabinetry area that provides additional storage and a convenient workspace for organization and everyday efficiency. The primary suite features a spacious walk in closet along with a renovated master bathroom that includes a large tiled walk in shower and jetted tub, creating a comfortable and inviting retreat. Additional improvements completed in 2024 include new lighting fixtures throughout the living, dining, kitchen, and primary bath areas, along with a new water heater and garbage disposal. A Carolina Room provides additional living space overlooking the backyard and leads out to the large rear deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining while enjoying the private and quiet backyard setting. The .47 acre lot offers exceptional outdoor space and privacy, while the side load two car garage enhances both curb appeal and functionality. With a single level layout and thoughtful updates throughout, this home offers comfortable coastal living in one of Murrells Inlet’s most desirable neighborhoods. Residents of Wachesaw enjoy access to a community three acre park featuring a playground, dog park, and pickleball courts. The Wachesaw Plantation Club is also located within the community and offers optional private memberships for the Tom Fazio designed golf course, Kimbel’s restaurant, pool, and tennis facilities. Please contact the listing agent, or your Realtor, to schedule a private showing or learn more about this wonderful property.

Now featuring a true oversized heated and cooled two-car garage! Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in the renowned Richmond Hill section of Wachesaw Plantation, this all-brick home offers timeless design, thoughtful updates, and a prime setting overlooking the 11th tee of Wachesaw Plantation Golf Course. It's a rare opportunity to own in one of the area's most desirable gated communities. Inside, you'll find heart pine floors, high ceilings with crown molding, and fully renovated bathrooms. The main level features a spacious primary suite with a walk-in closet and a spa-like bath complete with a walk-in shower and standalone tub. You'll also find an inviting living room, formal dining room, and a versatile flex room with custom built-ins- perfect for an office, playroom, or additional bedroom. The kitchen, finished with high-end details and generous workspace, is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, with a breakfast area that opens to the screened porch. Just off the kitchen is a spacious laundry room with a pantry and storage closet- ideal for bulk groceries, cleaning supplies, and everyday organization. The oversized two-car garage has been restored from previously finished living space. This garage is heated and cooled, offering a comfortable, climate-controlled area for vehicles, storage, a workshop, or hobby use. Existing flooring remains in place and can be extended for a seamless finish or removed based on buyer preference. Upstairs features three large walk-in attic areas providing exceptional storage. Also upstairs is an expansive private suite with its own en suite bath-ideal as a second primary suite, guest retreat, or multigenerational living space. An additional versatile room across the hall can serve as a bedroom, media room, or bonus space. Outdoor living is equally inviting, with a screened porch and large slate patio overlooking the beautifully landscaped backyard, complete with a fountain and fish pond. Whether enjoying morning coffee or hosting friends, it's a peaceful outdoor retreat. All of this is set within Wachesaw Plantation, a gated community known for its historic live oaks, championship golf course, and exceptional amenities. This unique home combines location, space, and quality- making it a true standout and a place you'll love to call home. Schedule your showing today!

Welcome to 4504 Riverside Ln, Murrells Inlet, SC. Nestled beneath a canopy of majestic live oaks in the coveted Richmond Hill section of historic Wachesaw Plantation, this stunning 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath home captures timeless Low-country elegance from the moment you arrive. Step inside to a welcoming foyer highlighted by a striking staircase, flanked by a formal dining room ideal for hosting and a spacious office or study perfect for working from home. Beautiful hardwood flooring flow throughout, while the open floor plan seamlessly connects the large kitchen and sunny breakfast nook—making this home a dream for entertaining. The kitchen offers white cabinetry, granite countertops, and a spacious work island perfect for meal prep or casual dining. Equipped with stainless steel appliances and a built-in cooktop. The cathedral ceilings and abundance of windows flood the expansive family room with natural light from the Carolina room. The home offers two spacious primary suites, thoughtfully designed for flexibility—one located on the main level and another on the second level, ideal for multigenerational living. The main-level primary suite is an oversized room, featuring his-and-her closets and overlooks the private backyard, with direct access to the inviting Carolina room. The primary bathroom is equally impressive, complete with a soaking tub, double vanity, water closet, and a separate shower. One upstairs room has been converted into a media/recording room with sound-dampening features, ideal for music, podcasting, or home entertainment. On the bottom level you will find a two-car garage and basement area with plenty of storage space. A portion of the basement has been thoughtfully converted into a fitness room, while the remaining space is ideal for a workshop, storage, or future customization. The entire interior has been freshly painted, new hardwood flooring, a GAF Camelot designer shingle roof crowns the residence with the Best warranty you can get for a roof-Golden Pledge, 50 year on materials 25 year on Workmanship, accented by a custom copper chimney shroud and all-new gutters. Energy efficiency was prioritized with the addition of shingle-style solar panels paired with spray foam insulation, resulting in exceptionally low power bills. The backyard has been completely transformed into a private outdoor retreat. The grounds were professionally leveled and enhanced with brick retaining walls and custom brickwork. Additional features include a metal fencing system, new metal doors, a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, fireplace, outdoor shower, and a professionally installed lighting system—ideal for entertaining day or night. With plenty of room to add a pool, this outdoor space offers endless possibilities. The property backs to serene, natural wetlands. Wachesaw Plantation features 24-hour gated security and access to various membership options with a private golf and tennis club, pool, and Kimbels Restaurant. Ideally located just minutes from the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, Wacca-Wache Marina, renowned restaurants, shopping, and historic landmarks.

Tucked away on a private cul-de-sac of just five homes, 1406 Jasmin Lane offers timeless Lowcountry charm within the highly desirable Wachesaw Plantation community. This well-maintained brick home is framed by mature landscaping and welcoming outdoor spaces, beginning with a classic covered front porch—an ideal place to relax and enjoy peaceful pond views where egrets, herons, ducks, and turtles are often seen. Inside, a gracious foyer opens to a formal dining room and a spacious great room featuring vaulted ceilings, custom built-in bookcases, and a gas fireplace, creating a warm and inviting central gathering space. The kitchen is conveniently located just off the great room and offers quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, refinished cabinetry, and a center island suited for both entertaining and everyday living. The adjoining breakfast area flows naturally into the enclosed Carolina room, providing additional year-round living space with easy access to the rear patio. The outdoor living area is equally inviting, with a private patio ideal for entertaining or unwinding while enjoying the benefit of mature landscaping that creates a substantial buffer from the adjacent community park. A hot tub installed in 2024 is negotiable with an acceptable contract. The primary suite is located on the main level and features a triple tray ceiling, two separate walk-in closets, and a spacious en-suite bath with double vanities, a linen closet, a walk-in tiled shower, and a jacuzzi soaking tub. Two additional main-level bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned on the opposite side of the home and share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with updated fixtures. Upstairs, a large fourth bedroom offers flexibility as a bonus room, office, or guest suite and includes a full bath and an expansive walk-in attic with potential for future conversion to additional heated square footage. Additional features include a well-appointed laundry room with cabinetry and counter space, an attached two-car garage, and multiple storage areas throughout the home. Recent improvements include a new roof, updated HVAC system for the main level, new water heater, luxury vinyl flooring on the main level, enclosed Carolina room, quartz kitchen countertops, refinished cabinetry, renovated primary shower, updated bathroom fixtures, new propane tank, installed gutters, and more—reflecting pride of ownership throughout. The neighborhood park is conveniently located beside the home and offers access to pickleball and basketball courts, a playground, and dog park areas. Wachesaw Plantation Club is a private club offering outstanding amenities including a swimming pool, Magnolia’s Pool Bar & Grill, Kimbel’s Restaurant overlooking the Waccamaw River, clay tennis courts, clubhouse, pro shop, and a private Tom Fazio–designed golf course. Club amenities require a separate membership in addition to POA fees. This property presents a rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, privacy, and a refined lifestyle in one of the South Strand’s most established communities. Contact the listing agent or your Realtor to schedule a private showing or learn more.

This charming 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home provides a peaceful and private setting inside the gated community of Wachesaw Plantation, one of the premier neighborhoods along the Grand Strand. The split-bedroom layout features plantation shutters and crown molding throughout, hardwood floors, a formal dining room and a gas fireplace as well as a screened-in porch off the back and a large rear deck. Inside the front door, the formal dining room sits to your right while a former coat closet just off the living room has been transformed into a fun and useful bar area. Past the dining room and bar closet sits the large living room with the fireplace serving as a focal point on the back wall while the kitchen, with plenty of counter and cabinet space, is to the right and includes a breakfast bar and breakfast nook. A large master bedroom sits to the back right of the home and features an en suite with a double-sink vanity, garden tub, walk-in shower and walk-in closet while two guest bedrooms and a guest bath occupy the left side of the home. Situated on a tree-lined lot tucked into its own little corner, this all-brick home is a unique opportunity in Wachesaw Plantation, one of the most desirable communities in Murrells Inlet with meticulously landscaped common areas, live oaks draped in Spanish moss, 24-hour guard gate entrance, and a community area that includes a playground, dog park, and basketball / pickleball courts. The members-only Wachesaw Plantation Club, which requires additional fees for access, is also on site and offers varying levels of membership that can provide access to the golf course, community pool, the on-site restaurant of Kimbels and much more. Plus, Wacca Wache Marina, a full service marina with boat storage and a restaurant, provides direct access to the Waccamaw River and is just a mile away. The ocean, golf, Murrells Inlet Marshwalk, shopping and restaurants are also just minutes away. Don’t miss the opportunity to own this truly unique property inside the gates of Wachesaw Plantation. For more information or to schedule a showing, please contact the listing agent or call your Realtor before this one is gone. Square footage is approximate and not guaranteed. Tucked beneath a canopy of centuries-old live oaks, this single-story Lowcountry home has been owned and cherished by the same family since 1991. Set on just over a half-acre corner lot in the heart of Wachesaw Plantation, it blends privacy with the quiet charm this gated community is known for. The long, tree-framed drive, detached garage, and classic lines of the home create the feel of a small country estate without sacrificing everyday convenience. Inside, the layout is thoughtfully designed for easy living—three bedrooms, two-and-a-half baths, and comfortable gathering spaces anchored by a toasty fireplace. Natural light filters in from every side, giving each room a warm, settled-in character. Whether you keep the timeless feel or bring your own vision to the space, the home offers a rare, solid foundation in one of Murrells Inlet’s most prized neighborhoods. Wachesaw Plantation surrounds you with the kind of amenities that elevate daily life: the option to join its private Tom Fazio–designed golf course, tennis courts, pool, clubhouse, and Kimbels—an iconic waterfront dining spot with sweeping views of the Intracoastal Waterway. For those seeking a single-level home with genuine Lowcountry character, mature trees, and the calm of a gated community, this property brings together tranquility and country estate elegance. Be sure to arrange a tour today - don't delay!

Peaceful, private, and charming in a prime location! This all-brick home has a lot to love. Sitting on an extraordinary lot, this single-level, 3 bedroom and 2.5 bath property provides a secluded setting with beautiful views of a large pond to the back while the front is buffered by an abundance of Azaleas throughout the yard. The split-bedroom layout features a large and open living room space with sliding glass doors to the back that open to a large wood deck and frame a picturesque view across the backyard and pond with the tee box for hole No. 6 of the Wachesaw Plantation Club golf course beyond. The living room flows into a well-appointed kitchen that hosts ample counter space and a built-in desk / work area as well as a large breakfast nook that also provides more spectacular views to the back of the property. Just inside the front door and open to the living room is a large dining room space with a tray ceiling and plantation shutters on the windows that offer views to the front of the property. The master suite sits to the back right of the home and features more views of the backyard, a built-in desk, tray ceiling, plantation shutters, and a large en suite with a double-sink vanity, expansive counter space, walk-in closet and walk-in shower. The two secondary bedrooms combine with a full bath to create an ideal guest wing to the left of the home while the hall entrance from the garage holds the laundry area, a half bath and three separate closets including a pantry option just off the kitchen. Wachesaw Plantation is one of the most desirable communities in Murrells Inlet with meticulously landscaped common areas, live oaks draped in Spanish moss, 24-hour guard gate entrance, and a community area that includes a playground, dog park, and basketball / pickleball courts. The members-only Wachesaw Plantation Club, which requires additional fees for access, is also on site and offers varying levels of membership that can provide access to the golf course, community pool, the on-site restaurant of Kimbels and much more. Plus, Wacca Wache Marina, a full service marina with boat storage and a restaurant, provides direct access to the Waccamaw River and is just a mile away. The ocean, golf, Murrells Inlet Marshwalk, shopping and restaurants are also just minutes away. Don’t miss the opportunity to own this truly unique property inside the gates of Wachesaw Plantation. descriptions.desc: This stunning, one-level home is bright, spacious, and ideally located in one of Murrells Inlet's most sought-after communities! It's lot backs to the 15th fairway of Wachesaw Plantation East golf course. A split floor plan featuring soaring 12 ft ceilings, a formal dining room & generous room sizes, including a huge kitchen, makes this home an entertainer's dream! Impressive foyer flows into lovely living room with double crown moulding, tray ceiling, two-sided fireplace, and pretty French doors leading out to a relaxing screened porch. Step out back onto the paver patio complete with a built-in, gas fire pit. Back inside, the gourmet, eat-in kitchen will please the most discerning chef with an under-counter wine fridge, drawer microwave and plenty of room around the island for guests to congregate! Large master suite with tray ceiling, fresh LVP flooring, newly renovated master bath with marble dbl vanity, tile shower, step-in tub & shower, plus a generous walk-in closet. Currently used as an office, the front room can serve as a bedroom, if desired. A renovated full bath off the hallway has a step-in, corner shower. On the other side of the home find two additional guest rooms w/ Jack & Jill full bath. Laundry room off the kitchen and side-entry garage with 3 bays (2 +one for golf cart or small car). Wachesaw Plantation East is a gated, established community offering SO much for such a LOW HOA fee: 24-7 uniformed security, surrounded by a beautiful, affordable golf course, walking/fitness trails throughout, large swimming pool, tennis courts, and workout room. PRIME Location:1 mile to the famous Murrell's Inlet Marshwalk, or 1mi. out the back gate to the marina on the Intercoastal Waterway with public boat landings. Close to the pristine beaches of Huntington State Park, & N Litchfield, Brookgreen Gardens, Hospital and shopping. Don't wait to see this one. Your Lowcountry lifestyle is beckoning!

Fairway views from a screened porch set the pace at this three-bedroom, two-bath ranch on the golf course in The Cottages at Planters Point, a section of the gated Wachesaw East community in Murrells Inlet, South Carolina. Built in 2002 with 1,534 heated square feet on a 0.19-acre homesite, the single-level, split-bedroom plan opens from a covered front porch into bright living spaces with tile flooring. The great room rises to a cathedral ceiling, where triple sliding glass doors open to the screened porch and rear patio, bringing the outdoors in. The kitchen pairs custom cherry cabinetry with solid surface countertops, a custom wood vent hood, recessed lighting, a breakfast bar, a pantry, and stainless steel appliances. A formal dining room and a separate sitting room add flexible space for entertaining, a home office, or hobbies. The primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, ceiling fan, walk-in closet, linen closet, and en-suite bath with a double-sink vanity, garden tub, and separate shower. Two more bedrooms share a second full bath on the opposite side, and all three bedrooms have brand-new plank flooring. A laundry room with washer and dryer connections keeps everything on one level. Out back, the level, low-maintenance yard has a lawn sprinkler system, and an attached two-car garage, storm doors, and a standing-seam metal roof accent over the front porch complete the exterior. Wachesaw East residents enjoy an outdoor community pool, tennis courts, and a clubhouse inside the gated entry. Owner motorcycles are permitted, and long-term rentals are allowed. Wacca Wache Marina and the Intracoastal Waterway, the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, Brookgreen Gardens, Huntington Beach State Park, and South Strand beaches are all minutes away. Golf course living on one level comes together at The Cottages at Planters Point, Wachesaw East, Murrells Inlet, SC 29576. Measurements are not guaranteed; buyer is responsible for verifying.

Open House Saturday 08/22/2026 from 1-3 pm. Beautifully maintained and filled with Lowcountry charm, this spacious 5-bedroom, 4-full-bath home offers an open, airy floor plan with 11' ceilings in common areas, and beautiful golf course & pond views. Ideally situated along the 16th hole of Wachesaw Plantation East Golf Course, the home features wonderful curb appeal and a private backyard where the tree line has been thoughtfully cleared to preserve privacy while opening beautiful views of the picturesque pond, including the early-morning mist rising from the water. The seller has made a lot of recent improvements, including fresh interior paint with a list Colonial Red for a pop of color and elegance, new LVP flooring in the primary bedroom and living/dining/office areas, and new carpet in the three remaining first-floor bedrooms. The bookcases flanking the gas fireplace have been freshly painted and new knobs added, as have the cabinets in the separate laundry room. Enjoy warm granite countertops in the kitchen with like-new cabinetry that feature deep drawers & pull-out shelving. All kitchen appliances were purchased in 2025, and the front storm door, entryway light, foyer light, and dining room fixture were replaced in 2026. The screened porch features attractive parquet-style composite flooring, and new window treatments have been added in the kitchen and living room. The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers excellent flow and a wonderful sense of balance. The spacious primary suite features a tray ceiling, his-and-hers closets, two vanities, a walk-in shower, and relaxing garden tub. Three additional first-floor guest bedrooms are privately positioned on the opposite side of the home and share two full baths. Upstairs, the generous bonus room can double as a 5th bedroom and offers exceptional flexibility, with its own full bath, wet-bar and beautiful views. Additional features include an irrigation system, gutters, pull-down attic storage, and a deep, attached two-car garage. Washer, dryer, and all appliances convey. Located in the gated community of Wachesaw Plantation East, residents enjoy a premier golf course lifestyle with convenient access to the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, Huntington Beach State Park, Brookgreen Gardens, shopping, dining, medical facilities, marinas, and the beautiful beaches of the Grand Strand. Listing information is deemed reliable but not guaranteed. All measurements are approximate. Buyer is responsible for verifying all measurements, HOA information, insurance requirements, and other information important to the purchase prior to closing.

Exceptional Lake & Golf Course Views! Perfectly positioned on one of Wachesaw Plantation East's most desirable homesites, this beautifully appointed very special, executive home overlooks the sparkling lake, charming bridge, fountain, and the 17th fairway. From the moment you arrive, the elegant stamped concrete circular driveway and professionally landscaped grounds set the stage for the quality and craftsmanship found inside. Enjoy breathtaking views year-round from the sun-filled Carolina Room or the expansive covered deck—an ideal setting for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or evening gatherings with family and friends. Inside, timeless craftsmanship and thoughtful custom touches create an elegant yet comfortable atmosphere. High ceilings, crown moldings, decorative beadboard and custom wall trim, ceiling medallions, and engineered hardwood flooring throughout the main living areas and first-floor primary suite add warmth and character. The inviting living room features custom built-in shelving and a reclaimed antique mantel, while the spacious kitchen offers granite countertops, abundant cabinetry, additional recessed lighting, and generous workspace for cooking and entertaining. The first-floor primary suite offers engineered hardwood flooring, a walk-in closet, and a spacious bath with a walk-in shower and relaxing garden tub. Two additional guest bedrooms are thoughtfully situated on the opposite side of the home and share a full bath. Enjoy a huge bonus room on the 2nd floor large enough to double as an additional primary suite. Attached bathroom with storage is large enough to be converted into a kitchenette or laundry area. Carpets were just steam cleaned throughout. Step outside to the expansive covered deck featuring low-maintenance composite decking and a beautiful wood ceiling, all overlooking one of the community's most picturesque settings. Just inside, the bright Carolina Room is lined with windows that frame the tranquil lake and golf course views, creating a peaceful retreat you'll enjoy in every season. Additional features include a newer roof & newer HTP high-efficiency water heater (2020). Whole-home water filtration system, Remy Halo Indoor Air Quality Enhancement Device, seven-zone irrigation system, gutters, pull-down attic storage, and an attached two-car garage. The washer and dryer convey. Located within the gated community of Wachesaw Plantation East, residents enjoy outstanding amenities and a premier golf course lifestyle just minutes from the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, Huntington Beach State Park, Brookgreen Gardens, shopping, dining, healthcare, marinas, and the beautiful beaches of the Grand Strand. With timeless architectural details, exceptional curb appeal, quality upgrades, and breathtaking lake and golf course views, this is a home you'll be proud to own and delighted to share with family and friends. Listing information is deemed reliable but not guaranteed. All measurements are approximate. Buyer is responsible for verification of all measurements and HOA info prior to closing.

Located in the UPSCALE gated golf community of Wachesaw East. This home offers a split bedroom plan with 4 charming bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, an office/Den/Flex space, a formal Dining Room, Great Room with a vaulted ceiling and a gas fireplace, a spacious gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances-hard surface counter tops-center island-breakfast bar, Primary bedroom is elegant and large-trey ceiling-side French door leading to the screened in porch, Primary Bathroom offers a double vanity with dual sinks-garden tub with separate shower area-extended walk in closet, Laundry room with a slop sink, Screened in porch with golf course views, Garage with pull down stairs to the attic. You are not just buying a home your buying a lifestyle! This upscale community has it all-private gated entrances with 24 hr security-walking and fitness trails-amenity center with a gym-tennis courts-pickle ball courts-basketball courts-golf and much more!!

Imagine waking up each morning to peaceful pond views and the beauty of a golf course right outside your window. Located in the highly sought-after, gated Wachesaw East community in Murrells Inlet, this spacious 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and coastal living. One of the eleven homes available in Wachesaw East, offering a 3 car garage! Step inside and you'll immediately notice the soaring 12-foot ceilings, warm bamboo flooring, custom built-in bookcases, and abundant natural light that create an inviting atmosphere throughout the home. The beautifully designed kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring quartz countertops, a large island, double ovens, and plenty of space for gathering with family and friends. One of the home's standout features is the expanded first-floor primary suite. During construction, the owners extended the front bedroom suite by an additional six feet, creating an even more spacious and comfortable retreat. The master bedroom complete with tranquil pond views, tray ceiling, large walk-in closet, and a luxurious ensuite bath with dual granite vanities, garden tub, and walk-in shower, this private sanctuary offers the perfect place to relax and recharge. With five bedrooms and 3.5 baths, there is room for everyone, whether you need space for family, guests, a home office, or hobbies. The oversized three-car garage provides ample storage for vehicles, golf carts, and all your coastal lifestyle essentials. Outside, enjoy the best of Low-country living from the screened porch overlooking the pond, gather around the fire pit on the patio, or simply unwind while taking in the serene pond and golf course views. This home has been exceptionally maintained, with major updates already completed for the next owner, including a new roof, new oversized 6-inch gutters, and a brand-new hot water heater installed in June 2026---providing valuable peace of mind and reducing future maintenance concerns. Living in Wachesaw East means enjoying an exceptional lifestyle with access to a community pool, clubhouse, fitness center, tennis courts, walking paths, and 24-hour gated security. You'll also be minutes from the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, Huntington Beach State Park, Brookgreen Gardens, championship golf, waterfront dining, shopping, entertainment, and beautiful beaches. This is more than just a home---it's an opportunity to enjoy spacious living, stunning views, modern updates, and the relaxed coastal lifestyle that makes Wachesaw East one of the Grand Strand's most desirable communities.

Located within a private gated community Wachesaw East community located in the heart of Murrells Inlet, this beautiful ranch-style 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and scenic coastal living. Overlooking a beautifully maintained golf course, the home features a spacious screened Carolina Room, the ideal place to enjoy your morning coffee while taking in peaceful golf course views and relaxing outdoor living year-round. Thoughtfully maintained, the home also includes a brand-new roof installed in 2025 and a newer HVAC system, providing added value and peace of mind. Residents enjoy an impressive selection of community amenities including 24-hour gated security, a resort-style pool, fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, and scenic walking trails designed for both recreation and relaxation. Perfectly situated just minutes from the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, residents can experience waterfront dining, live entertainment, and some of the freshest seafood on the South Carolina coast in the area famously known as the “Seafood Capital of South Carolina.” Nearby attractions also include Huntington Beach State Park, Brookgreen Gardens, Wacca Wache Marina, Tidelands Waccamaw Hospital, grocery stores, shopping, and everyday conveniences. With low HOA dues, exceptional amenities, and an unbeatable location, this home offers the ultimate Murrells Inlet lifestyle. From peaceful golf course views to resort-style amenities and an unbeatable Murrells Inlet location, this home truly offers the best of comfortable coastal living.

Welcome to 4565 Firethorne Drive, tucked inside the established and much-loved Wachesaw East community in Murrells Inlet. This beautiful 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers a beautifully designed layout, designated study/office, updated appliances, new water heater, bamboo flooring, & two propane fireplaces, blending elegance with functionality. The Carolina Room is truly a favorite spot, filled with natural light and a spectacular view of the 14th hole. Step outside and take in the peaceful setting with mature trees and the golf course as your backdrop. It’s a serene space to unwind, entertain, or simply enjoy the beauty that surrounds you. You’ll also appreciate the added peace of mind of being on the hospital power grid, offering extra reliability when it matters most. Wachesaw East is more than just a neighborhood, it’s a lifestyle. With its gated entrance with 24-hour security, community pool, tennis & pickleball courts, walking & biking trails, and beautifully maintained grounds, it’s easy to see why so many love calling it home. And with the MarshWalk, Brookgreen Garden, Huntington State Park, beaches, dining, shopping, and hospital just minutes away, you’re perfectly positioned to enjoy all that Murrells Inlet has to offer. Come experience the warmth and charm of this wonderful home!

Welcome home to Southern Charm at the beach! This immaculate SINGLE-LEVEL ranch-style residence offers an inviting open-concept floor plan with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, beautifully enhanced by an array of thoughtful upgrades. Major improvements include a NEW HVAC and Roof (2022), NEW WiFi irrigation system, WiFi thermostat, NEW interior light fixtures—including the front entry—NEW LED can lighting, NEW fireplace lighting, and freshly painted interiors. The home features NO carpet, elegant crown molding, chair railing and wainscoting throughout, a stainless-steel kitchen farm sink, NEW wall sconces and added wainscoting in the primary bedroom, NEW interior doorknobs and hinges, and a NEW wine fridge. Additional enhancements include a remodeled and freshly painted exterior front entry with NEW glass, a sealed garage door, Closetmaid adjustable garage shelving, and 5 NEW hardwired 10-year battery-backup KIDDE smoke detectors (2026). Outdoors, enjoy your private oasis with an expanded patio, firepit, updated landscaping, tree removal, and fresh sod along the side yard. A NEST camera doorbell system adds peace of mind. ALL furniture is available for purchase separately for those seeking a turnkey option. Located in the desirable, gated community of Wachesaw East—staffed with 24/7 security—this home places you in the heart of Murrells Inlet, just minutes from Tidelands Waccamaw Hospital, Brookgreen Gardens, Huntington Beach State Park, grocery stores, boutique shopping, and the famous Marsh Walk offering you some of the FRESHEST seafood around, which is why Murrells Inlet is known as the “Seafood Capital of South Carolina”. With low HOA dues and an AMAZING amenity center featuring walking trails with exercise stations along the way, a fitness room, swimming pool, and tennis/pickleball court, this property truly is the WHOLE PACKAGE! Don’t let this beautiful home slip away.

Welcome to the sought-after Wachesaw Plantation East community in beautiful Murrells Inlet—where comfort, quality, and golf-course living come together in this well-maintained home. This property offers 4 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and a Carolina room at the back of the house with a view. Perfectly positioned on a stunning natural lake lot, this property delivers peaceful views and a backyard retreat you’ll never want to leave. The outdoor space is truly special, featuring a natural-stone paver patio with a firepit—ideal for relaxing evenings or entertaining guests—along with added riprap along the shoreline for long-term stability and beauty. Inside, the home boasts a true chef’s kitchen designed to impress, complete with a 6-burner Viking gas cooktop, stainless range hood, GE Café wall oven, and all stainless steel appliances. Thoughtful upgrades include soft-close cabinetry, pull-out shelving, a solar tube for natural light, and a generously sized pantry. The spacious primary suite offers a tray ceiling and a massive walk-in closet, while the upgraded primary bath features a walk-in tile shower with seat, granite countertops and new tile flooring installed in 2022. Both bathrooms include comfort-height toilets for added convenience. Additional highlights include: HVAC replaced in 2022 with an annual service plan, Refrigerator replaced in 2023, 2-sided gas fireplace, On-demand water heater (flushed annually), Roof replaced in 2015, security film on all windows, NO POPCORN CEILINGS, oversized garage with attic storage, utility sink, and garage door opener replaced in 2023, Gutters with Gutter Helmets, and 5-zone WiFi-enabled irrigation system controllable from your phone. This home combines thoughtful upgrades, solid maintenance, and an unbeatable setting—making it a standout opportunity in one of the area’s most desirable communities. Listing information is deemed reliable but not guaranteed. All measurements are approximate. Buyer is responsible for verification of all measurements and HOA info prior to closing.

Located in coveted, Wachesaw Plantation East, a gated community in Murrells Inlet, this gorgeous home is perched on a generous sized lot, offering serene privacy as well as golf course views. Inside, the double doors welcome you to a generous foyer and the open flow of this stunning floorplan. The oversized kitchen is a cook's dream with an abundance of prep area, granite countertops, center island and tons of cabinet space w/ pullouts all around! Find newer stainless steel appliances, pantry and a delightful, sunny breakfast nook! The oversized great room features new LVP flooring extending into the dining area plus a gas fireplace. Off of the main living & dining area French doors lead to an office with triple windows. Step out onto your screened porch complete with EZ Breeze vinyl windows, where you can relax and watch the golfers on the 16th fairway. This lot is very deep and only a third of the rear yard is cleared. Keep it this way for ease of maintenance, or develop it into your backyard oasis while still maintaining privacy as the side yard is a wooded, natural buffer. This home has an easy living layout and a great vibe. Book your tour today to feel it for yourself! HVAC new 2024, H2O heater new 2023, Roof replaced Dec. 2012 Wachesaw East community features: 24-7 uniformed security, HTC Fiber Optics installed offering High speed cable & Internet. Surrounded by a beautiful, affordable golf course, walking /fitness trails throughout, 2 pools, tennis courts and workout room. PRIME Location:1 mile to the famous Murrell's Inlet Marshwalk, or 1 mi. out the back gate to the marina on the Intercoastal waterway with public boat landings. Close to the pristine beaches of Huntington State Park, Brookgreen Gardens, Hospital and shopping.

This Gorgeous fully remodeled 3 Bedrooms, 2 baths, and 2 car attached garage is located under 5 miles to the ocean in the Guard Gated Wachesaw East Community! The home gives a very open welcome from the moment you walk through the front door with the open floor plan, vaulted ceilings, and natural light. Split bedroom floor plan which allows for complete privacy between primary and guest bedrooms. Homeowners can sit back and relax in their private backyard overlooking the golf course! Upgrades include; new Sod, new paint, light fixtures, LVP floors, appliances, and more! Amenity center includes clubhouse, fitness center, walking trails, pool, and tennis courts.. The home is located minutes away from the Marshwalk, schools, shopping ,grocery stores,dining, golf courses, Intracoastal waterway, and more!

MOVE-IN-READY WITH TONS OF UPGRADES!!! 3 Bedroom/2 Full Bath house ON GOLF COURSE in very desirable Wachesaw Plantation East!!! This home boasts an open floor plan and a single story. It includes a beautifully converted back porch (2018)/Carolina Room with tasteful white-washed paneling, tons of windows, new French doors (2024) and a great view of the 6th fairway. The kitchen has a newer GAS range, upgraded cabinetry with LED under cabinet lighting, stainless steel appliances, tile backsplash and granite countertops. Newer LVP flooring throughout (2019), NO CARPETING in this house!!! Walk-in closet in primary just went through a gorgeous custom-closet installation!!! BOTH bathrooms have been renovated (2022) and new frameless shower glass installed (2024), solar tubes added in the living room (2017) & kitchen for more natural light, 4 additional cold air returns installed, freshly painted, new designer light fixtures and fans have been added, and the list goes on including an additional office space which could easily be used as another guest bedroom when you need it or an office. Outside the sellers just removed the old landscaping and updated it with new mulch and boarder. New retractable garage screen with one-way privacy screening allows you to maximize your space and enjoy your garage. 5-zone irrigation system. HVAC replaced 2022. Roof replaced 2013, Water heater replaced 2016. Gated community with community pool, pickleball/tennis courts, fitness trail and exercise room close to everything including the Marsh Walk, hospital, restaurants & Wacca Wache Marina. Don't let this one get away...schedule your showing today!!! Listing information and square footage are deemed reliable, but not guaranteed. Buyer and buyer's agent are responsible for verification of measurements and HOA/POA info prior to closing.
