descriptions.desc: 285 Brickwell Lane — A truly exceptional Lowcountry estate nestled within the private enclave of Island Estates, behind the gates of The Reserve at Litchfield. Set on 1.94 acres, this Southern Colonial-inspired residence offers approximately 6,500 heated square feet of timeless architecture, refined interiors & extraordinary outdoor living. Custom built with 5 bedrooms, 5½ baths, a private mother-in-law suite above the three-car garage, basement and saltwater pool, this remarkable property was designed for both elegant entertaining & relaxed Lowcountry living. From the moment you arrive, the home makes an unforgettable first impression. A stately two-story columned porch, broad brick steps, dark shutters & mature landscaping create a classic Southern welcome. Inside, vaulted ceilings, a free-floating spiral staircase, extensive custom millwork, & designer finishes reflect the exceptional craftsmanship found throughout the residence. At the heart of the home is the beautifully renovated kitchen, completed by Prodigy Kitchens & Baths and thoughtfully designed for both the gourmet cook & entertaining. Custom cabinetry is paired with 2.25-inch Cambria countertops & an expansive island, while the appliance package includes two Sub-Zero refrigeration units, a 48-inch Wolf professional range top, Wolf wall & steam ovens, a Miele built-in coffee system & two Cove dishwashers. Two sinks provide functionality, including a dedicated food-preparation station featuring a walnut chef’s block integrated into the sink. The main living room features soaring vaulted ceilings, a gas fireplace & seamless access to a sophisticated entertaining room known as the Men’s Club. With coffered ceilings, Sonos surround sound & a wet bar complete with wine refrigerator and ice maker, this space is perfectly suited for entertaining or relaxing with family and friends. The main-level study provides a quiet and beautifully appointed workspace, with extensive built-ins & a chandelier. The home also offers an elegant dining room, a spacious laundry room & a second office/flex space ideal for homework or crafts. The spacious primary suite is a private retreat with its own fireplace & claw foot tub. Three additional bedrooms in the main residence each feature private en-suite baths. Upstairs, a beautiful library with built-ins provides another gathering or reading space. Above the garage, a separate private suite includes the fifth bedroom and full bath with its own entrance, offering an ideal space for guests, extended family or an in-law suite. The home also features a generous mudroom & entry area adjacent to the three-car garage. An elevator shaft, currently utilized for storage, offers flexibility for the future. A dedicated “Costco Closet” provides exceptional storage. The outdoor living spaces are truly extraordinary. A 20’ x 40’ saltwater pool is surrounded by an expansive terrace with pool decking, while the beautifully landscaped grounds extend to a private stocked pond complete with its own island, landscape lighting and fountain. The combination of mature landscaping, water views & expansive acreage creates a rare sense of privacy in Pawleys Island. The rear porch is designed for year-round enjoyment, featuring gas fireplace & a hot tub overlooking the pool and expansive grounds. The basement offers additional space that can be customized to suit a variety of needs. Recent improvements include updated HVAC systems, whole-house water filtration, enhanced outdoor lighting, pool decking, & upgraded security and whole-house audio systems. Located within The Reserve at Litchfield, residents enjoy a private setting with sidewalks ideal for walking & biking, along with HOA access to Litchfield By The Sea and neighborhood marina & boat-ramp amenities. The property is conveniently located near the beaches & restaurants of Pawleys Island. Owners also have the opportunity to join the Harbor Club for access to the on-site restaurant & pool.

Experience the pinnacle of coastal elegance in this stunning home located behind the gates of the prestigious community of The Reserve in Pawleys Island. From the moment you arrive, the Brazilian hardwood wraparound porch sets a sophisticated tone that continues throughout this meticulously designed residence. The heart of the home is a grand formal living room featuring soaring eighteen-foot windows that bathe the space in natural light. Adjacent, the formal dining room is a literal work of art, defined by stately, square-paneled columns and a ceiling adorned with a custom hand-painted mural and chandelier. For more casual gatherings, the family room offers a cozy gas-log fireplace, built-in bookshelves, and built in bar, all centered around breathtaking views of the lake and its lighted fountain. The kitchen is both a functional masterpiece and an aesthetic delight, anchored by a massive island with a five-burner gas cooktop. Sea-green granite countertops complement glazed, solid maple cabinetry equipped with pull-out drawers, an appliance garage, and glass-front display cases. Premium stainless steel appliances, including SubZero refrigeration, ensure a perfect cooking and dining experience. This home features an expansive layout with four bedrooms and four and a half baths, including two primary suites— one on each level. The downstairs primary suite is a true sanctuary, offering lake views from the bedroom and the Jacuzzi tub. A grand staircase leads upstairs to an open balcony and a versatile loft area, currently serving as a den and home office, overlooking the family room and out the massive windows to the lake beyond. The rear of the residence is designed for the ultimate Lowcountry lifestyle. Enjoy the screened-in pool area, complete with wood burning fireplace, an outdoor kitchen (featuring SubZero refrigeration) and a full bath. Adjacent to the screened area, a rear deck of Brazilian hardwood leads into the yard and a charming pergola with a swing—the perfect vantage point to enjoy the tranquil sounds of the lake's fountain. Premium Features: • Safety & Efficiency: Simonton Stormbreaker impact windows throughout. • Fine Finishes: Travertine tile in all bathrooms, extensive moldings and Brazilian hardwood decking. • Convenience: Whole-house vacuum system and a two-car garage. • Inclusions: All custom window treatments are included with the home. • Ownership grants full access to Litchfield by the Sea and the property owner’s beach club, just a golf cart ride away. • Memberships to both The Reserve golf club and the marina club available.

Whether you're enjoying a quiet evening or hosting a neighborhood cookout, the backyard at 681 Reserve Drive is designed for both. Situated along the 11th fairway in The Reserve, mature landscaping creates a remarkably private outdoor setting with year-round color, a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, and inviting spaces to gather or simply unwind. Inside, this all-brick home combines classic architecture with the significant improvements today's buyers hope to find. Of its 5,613 heated square feet, approximately 2,907 are on the main level, allowing the home to live comfortably day to day without needing the upstairs. The primary suite, second bedroom, home office, kitchen, great room, Carolina Room, formal dining room, laundry, and principal living spaces are all downstairs. Upstairs, three additional bedrooms, two full baths, a den, and game room create a separate area for family and guests. A thoughtfully renovated kitchen anchors the main level with a full Thermador appliance suite centered around a six-burner gas range and direct access to the outdoor kitchen. Hickory engineered hardwood flooring and three-piece crown molding run throughout a main floor with 10- to 12-foot ceilings. The great room features an octagonal tray ceiling and gas fireplace and opens through French doors into a window-wrapped Carolina Room. The primary suite includes dual walk-in closets, a jetted tub, and tiled walk-in shower. The result is a five-bedroom home that lives comfortably on the main level day to day, with the upstairs available when family and guests arrive. The significant improvements have already been made, allowing the next owner to focus on enjoying life in The Reserve rather than planning renovations. QUESTIONS WE HEAR ABOUT THE RESERVE Is The Reserve gated? Yes. The Reserve is a gated community with controlled access. The Reserve gate is attended daily from 7 AM to 10 PM; properly registered overnight visitors are coordinated through the 24-hour Litchfield by the Sea gate. Do you have to join The Reserve Golf Club? No. Membership in the private Greg Norman-designed Reserve Golf Club is optional and separate from home ownership. What about Harbor Club Marina? Boat storage and Harbor Club Social Membership are separate choices and are not required with home ownership. Is beach access included? Yes. Owners enjoy deeded access through Litchfield by the Sea, including private beach access, an oceanfront clubhouse and sundeck, restrooms, tennis and pickleball courts, and walking trails. Registered golf carts can access Litchfield by the Sea, with dedicated golf-cart parking near the beach. FIVE THINGS YOU WILL LOVE 1. A three-car garage that's much more than a place to park. All three bays are climatized by a dedicated mini-split and finished with epoxy floors, custom storage, a workbench, utility sink, and half bath. 2. Significant investment has already been made. The renovated kitchen, 2020 roof, HVAC replacements in 2016, 2018, 2021 and 2022, whole-home Generac generator, Rinnai tankless water heater, and other improvements mean the work here goes well beyond what photographs well. 3. Outdoor living that would be difficult to recreate. The fenced half-acre homesite combines mature layered landscaping and exceptional privacy with an outdoor kitchen, brick paver patio, fire pit, landscape lighting, stone walkways, and open lawn that leaves room for the next owner's ideas. 4. Family and guests can have a space of their own. The second floor provides welcome separation when the house is full, while everyday life can remain comfortably on the main level. 5. The lifestyle extends well beyond your own backyard. Deeded Litchfield by the Sea access puts private beach access within a golf-cart ride from home, while private golf and marina options are available separately if and when they fit your lifestyle.

Welcome to an extraordinary waterfront residence in the Island Estates Section of the prestigious gated community The Reserve at Pawleys Island. A circular driveway and elegant courtyard entrance create an impressive arrival, setting the tone for the quality found throughout the home. Inside, you'll discover heart pine flooring, extensive crown molding, wainscoting, solid core doors, soaring ceilings, and an abundance of natural light that frames the spectacular waterfront views from nearly every main living space. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the open floor plan features a spacious living room with fireplace, formal dining area, and a beautifully appointed kitchen complete with a large island, Thermador gas cooktop, Thermador refrigerator, dual Thermador dishwashers, porcelain farmhouse sink, wet bar, and a sunny breakfast nook. Just beyond, a unique gathering room with wraparound windows, brick flooring, and a wood burning fireplace opens to the expansive rear patio overlooking the marina and waterway. The first floor primary suite is a true retreat, offering panoramic water views, French doors leading to the patio, heart pine flooring, generous closet space, and a luxurious bath with a freestanding soaking tub, custom tiled shower, and dual vanities. Each of the home's five bedrooms includes its own private bathroom, while the fifth bedroom also serves perfectly as a bonus room, media room, or game room. Outdoor living is every bit as impressive as the interior. The spacious waterfront patio is designed to take full advantage of the spectacular setting, while a paved walkway wraps around the home, seamlessly connecting the front courtyard to the backyard retreat. Additional features include an oversized four car garage and exceptional storage throughout. Residents of The Reserve enjoy one of the most exclusive lifestyles on the South Carolina coast, with a private gated entrance, an onsite full service marina with dry stack storage, and private beach access through Litchfield by the Sea. Located just minutes from championship golf, fine dining, boutique shopping, and the beaches of Pawleys Island, this home represents a rare opportunity to own one of the area's premier waterfront properties.

Rich with Pawleys Islands best amenities this offering in The Reserve is sure to please. Four bedroom, three and a half bath design, offers a parlor and dining combo at the entrance, open kitchen and den with vaulted ceiling, built-ins, and fireplace. Kitchen is complete with breakfast bar, pantry and butlers nook. First floor primary suite complete with full bath, dressing room, and connected laundry. Upstairs owners will benefit from from three additional rooms and two full baths. Currently one serves as a media/home theater, another as a guest room and the last is a full suite with separate living, bedroom, and private full bath. All season porch overlooks paver patio and fenced backyard. Take advantage of Litchfield By Thea Sea Resort Amenities, optional golf, marina, and central location is just a short days drive to Myrtle Beach or Charleston.

Experience the perfect blend of timeless craftsmanship, modern luxury, and effortless Lowcountry living in this exceptional custom-built residence located in the prestigious community of The Reserve. Thoughtfully designed with entertaining, comfort, and efficiency in mind, this versatile home offers the flexibility of 4 or even 5 bedrooms to suit a variety of lifestyles. Constructed with distinctive tumbled brick and enhanced by rich stained hickory flooring, extensive custom moldings, and built-ins throughout, every detail of this home was carefully curated. The open-concept design is anchored by a remarkable chef’s kitchen featuring a large hospitality-style island, Thermador gas range, KitchenAid double ovens, microwave, dishwasher, illuminated custom cabinetry, and a spacious walk-in pantry. Flowing seamlessly from the kitchen and breakfast area, the family room is highlighted by exposed cypress beams and one of two stunning Realstone fireplaces, creating a warm yet refined atmosphere. The dining room is filled with natural light from an elegant Palladian window and features a soaring 14-foot ceiling along with a custom built-in china cabinet. The owner’s suite serves as a true private retreat with a double-tray ceiling, a separate sitting area currently used as a home office, and a freshly renovated spa-inspired bathroom featuring all Kohler products, dual vanities, a luxurious soaking tub, a tiled walk-in shower, and an expansive dressing-room-style custom closet. The guest wing offers three spacious bedrooms, each with oversized closets and custom all-wood built ins. Upstairs, a generous bonus room currently serves as a secondary living area but could easily be converted into an additional guest suite, media room, or flex space. Outdoor living is elevated to another level with a covered lanai featuring a fireplace that overlooks a stunning private backyard oasis. The saltwater pool with heated and cooled functionality, separate hot tub, and fully equipped outdoor kitchen creates the ultimate setting for entertaining or relaxing year-round. Beyond the impressive visual features, the home also includes a whole-house Halo water-and-air filtration system, an oversized quick-return Rinnai gas water heater, a Nix mosquito system, and an irrigation system on a separate meter. Keep in mind, this home was built in 2019. This home offers exceptional quality with virtually nothing overlooked. Located in The Reserve, a premier private golf course and waterway community, residents enjoy access to one of the area’s finest beaches through Litchfield by the Sea. Optional memberships are available for the Harbor Club Marina, community pool, and the renowned Greg Norman golf course. This is a rare opportunity to experience luxury, privacy, and the very best of the Lowcountry lifestyle.

Located within the prestigious Reserve Golf Club Community, 99 Hunters Oak Court offers a rare opportunity to own a beautifully maintained custom home on an exceptional double-sized homesite just minutes from private ocean beach access by golf cart. Framed by majestic live oaks, tranquil pond views, and professionally illuminated landscaping, this remarkable property blends privacy, elegance, and timeless Lowcountry charm. Designed for comfortable coastal living, the home showcases classic Lowcountry architecture with a welcoming front porch, durable Hardie board siding, and a new roof installed in 2024. Inside, rich hardwood flooring, crown molding, plantation shutters, soaring ceilings, and abundant natural light highlight the home’s craftsmanship and inviting atmosphere throughout. The updated gourmet kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring premium GE Monogram stainless steel appliances, including a 6-burner gas range with griddle, double ovens, and professional-grade ventilation hood. Granite countertops, custom soft-close 42” cabinetry, tile backsplash, oversized center island, spacious pantry, new dishwasher, and a generous breakfast nook overlooking the landscaped grounds complete this impressive space. Flowing seamlessly from the kitchen, the inviting family room features a fully equipped wet bar with wine refrigerator, custom cabinetry, granite countertops, and tile backsplash. French doors open to the expansive patio and professionally landscaped backyard with fire pit, creating the perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. For formal gatherings, the elegant dining room showcases a tray ceiling, raised panel wainscoting, chair rail detailing, and refined architectural accents. The adjoining formal living room features a soaring cathedral ceiling, oversized remote-controlled accent windows, custom built-ins, and a gas log fireplace. French doors lead to one of the home’s most desirable features, the expansive screened porch complete with floor-to-ceiling Easy Breeze windows and retractable shades, offering year-round outdoor living with serene views of the impeccably manicured grounds. The spacious main-level primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with a tray ceiling, large walk-in closet, private screened porch access, and a spa-inspired bath featuring a whirlpool tub, tiled walk-in shower, double vanity, linen closet, and tile flooring. A versatile front room with coffered ceilings currently serves as a den/home office. Also on the main level are a half bath and a well-appointed laundry room with utility sink, cabinetry, tile flooring, and full-size washer and dryer that convey with the sale. Upstairs, a spacious 14’ x 18’ bonus/media room with wet bar and refrigerator provides an ideal gathering space for family and guests. Three generously sized bedrooms, all with walk-in closets, offer comfortable accommodations. Two bedrooms share a Jack-and-Jill bath, while the third enjoys a private bath. The oversized attached two-car garage offers ample space for vehicles, golf cart, beach equipment, and additional storage, along with attic storage, workbench, and hurricane-rated garage door for added peace of mind. Residents of The Reserve enjoy access to a private gated golf and marina community with exclusive beach access through Litchfield by the Sea, including parking, tennis courts, sun decks, fishing and crabbing docks, showers, restrooms, and an oceanfront clubhouse. Optional memberships are available for The Reserve Golf Club, featuring the acclaimed Greg Norman-designed course and access to the McConnell Golf network. The community also offers a private marina with access to the Waccamaw River and Intracoastal Waterway, along with optional social memberships featuring pool and dining amenities. Conveniently located near exceptional dining, shopping, entertainment, water sports and more, this extraordinary property captures the very best of luxury coastal living.

Updated 4-bedroom home in The Reserve with pond views, new roof (2026), quartz kitchen, and thoughtfully refreshed living spaces designed for everyday comfort and easy entertaining. Craftsmanship, character, and a private pondside setting define this custom-built home in The Reserve, offering 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, with a thoughtful interior refresh and a brand-new roof scheduled for April 2026. Located at 304 Hunters Oak Court, this property blends timeless architecture with updated finishes and meaningful improvements in one of Pawleys Island’s most sought-after gated communities with private beach access. Set among mature landscaping with peaceful pond views, the home makes a strong first impression with classic detailing, a welcoming front entry, and a sense of privacy and established charm. Inside, antique-like, rough-hewn walnut floors and solid core doors establish quality throughout, while extensive millwork—including crown molding, shiplap, beadboard, wainscoting, chair rail, recessed paneling, and substantial trim—adds rich architectural character. Just off the foyer, a formal dining room sits behind glass French doors and features detailed trim, built-in cabinetry with glass shelving, and a timeless, elevated design. The floorplan unfolds naturally around a two-story great room with exposed wood beams, a fireplace, and custom built-ins. Recently refreshed with a modern color palette and redesigned hearth, the space feels both updated and warm, while remaining true to its original character. The great room flows into a sunroom-style living area wrapped in windows, offering a quiet, light-filled retreat with easy access to the outdoors. The kitchen is designed for cooking and gathering, featuring floor-to-ceiling cabinetry, quartz countertops with matching backsplash, and a large center island with built-in storage. A generous breakfast bar provides ample seating, while pantry-style cabinetry, roll-out shelving, deep drawers, and hidden spice storage maximize functionality. Updates include a new oven and microwave plus refrigerators in both the kitchen and garage. The adjoining morning room offers casual dining filled with natural light and a built-in window bench seat. The main-level primary suite is privately located and offers a peaceful retreat with a bay window, dual walk-in closets, and an ensuite bath with shiplap accents, double vanities, a water closet, and a large tiled walk-in shower. A mudroom and laundry area with built-ins and a utility sink enhance everyday convenience, along with updated lighting and a new garage door motor. Upstairs, a gallery-style hallway overlooks the main living areas and leads to three additional bedrooms. One is a private guest suite complete with its own bath, vaulted ceilings, exposed beams, and a paneled accent wall. Two additional bedrooms share a full bath and feature vaulted ceilings and custom details, one of which includes a connected but separate office or flex space with a built-in desk and storage, offering privacy and versatility for work or extended stays. Out back, the terraced tabby patio with stacked stone planter accents creates a layered outdoor living space overlooking the private pond. A dedicated grilling pad adds functionality, while the setting is ideal for alfresco dining, relaxed evenings, and easy outdoor entertaining, all surrounded by mature landscaping and natural beauty. Located in The Reserve, residents enjoy access to Litchfield by the Sea with private beach amenities, Harbor Club Marina on the Intracoastal Waterway, and optional membership at The Reserve Golf Club, a Greg Norman-designed course. A home where craftsmanship, thoughtful updates, and timeless design come together in a move-in ready Lowcountry setting.

Welcome to 820 Preservation Circle! Tucked behind the gates of The Reserve in Pawleys Island, this property delivers an elevated lifestyle defined by comfort, quality, and understated sophistication. From the moment you arrive, the home makes an impression. A wide, welcoming front porch stretches across the façade, accented by gabled rooflines, stone detailing, and carriage-style garage doors that nod to classic craftsmanship. Step inside to discover airy 10-foot ceilings, substantial trim work, and architectural ceilings that add depth and dimension to the main living spaces. The entryway transitions seamlessly into an elegant dining room adorned with tray ceilings and plantation shutters, while the great room offers generous proportions, abundant sunlight, and calming water views. Recently refreshed with new hardwood flooring throughout the main level and fresh interior paint, the home feels crisp, current, and move-in ready. At the heart of the home, the kitchen is both functional and striking. Custom cabinetry extends to the ceiling and is complemented by updated hardware, gleaming granite surfaces, and two oversized islands designed for gathering. A Thermador six-burner gas cooktop with custom hood and double ovens anchors the space, while a bright breakfast area captures peaceful lake views. The walk-in butler’s pantry has been recently enhanced with custom built-ins and a butcher block workspace, offering exceptional organization. A Brizo touch-activated faucet adds a sleek, modern convenience. Just off the kitchen, sliding barn doors reveal a relaxed keeping room with a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace—an inviting retreat for casual evenings or morning coffee. The primary suite on the main level is a private haven. This space is highlighted by the beautifully renovated custom primary closet that offers boutique-style organization with extensive built-ins, double hanging sections, dedicated shoe shelving, and abundant drawer storage. A spacious center island with additional cabinetry, light wood flooring, and natural light create a bright, functional, and luxurious dressing space. Also, the recently added 2nd walk-in closet—along with custom closet systems—provides even more storage and organization. The spa-inspired bath boasts dual vanities, soaking tub, and a beautifully tiled walk-in shower. A quiet home office with bay-style windows sits just outside the primary suite and offers a refined and comfortable workspace. Two additional first-floor guest suites each include private baths, walk-in closets, and upgraded closet systems, making them ideal for extended family or visitors. The laundry and mudroom features distinctive checkerboard tile flooring, abundant cabinetry, and work surfaces that make daily routines effortless. Upstairs, a spacious flex room with a wet bar & wine refrigerator creates a perfect media or game space. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed bath with a tiled walk-in shower, and substantial attic storage—including a climate-controlled walk-in area—adds versatility. The outdoor living spaces are equally appealing. The outdoor patio overlooks a fenced backyard and tranquil lake setting, providing a scenic backdrop for entertaining or unwinding. The oversized garage includes a newly installed EV car charger, garage door keypad, and ample room for recreational gear. Above, a framed and floored workshop or storage area offers exciting possibilities for customization. Life in The Reserve offers access to a renowned Greg Norman-designed golf course, a private marina and waterfront dining at the Harbor Club, and exclusive beach access through Litchfield by the Sea, complete with tennis courts, clubhouse, and scenic walking trails. Optional memberships allow homeowners to tailor their experience. This is coastal Carolina living at its finest!

Stacking glass doors, a heated and cooled sunroom, and three fireplaces set the tone for how effortlessly this home lives—from poolside afternoons to relaxed evenings inside. Set within The Reserve and bordered by HOA-owned wooded land with peaceful pond views, 915 Preservation Circle blends classic Colonial Revival–inspired architecture with a lifestyle designed for entertaining, relaxed living, and everyday comfort. The home has been consistently maintained over time, with a freshly painted main level that creates a bright, neutral backdrop ready for your personal style. A welcoming front porch and circular driveway set the tone, offering ample space for guest parking and an easy arrival experience for gatherings both large and small. Inside, soaring ceilings and an open layout create a natural flow between spaces. The great room features a gas fireplace with custom built-ins and opens through expansive stacking glass doors into the heated-and-cooled sunroom, creating a dramatic glass-wall transition that seamlessly connects indoor living to the backyard, pool, and outdoor entertaining areas. The kitchen is designed for both gathering and everyday use, featuring granite countertops, a large center island with seating for six, commercial-grade Viking appliances, including an 8-burner gas range with hood, abundant cabinetry, and a convenient and ample pantry. A dedicated stemware and spirits bar with rack storage, wine chiller, and refrigerator keeps everything within reach for effortless entertaining. The adjacent keeping room offers a second fireplace and an additional comfortable space to relax, while the formal dining room provides a classic setting for hosting. The privately arranged primary suite serves as a quiet retreat, complete with a gas fireplace, tray ceiling, built-in window seat, and direct access to the sunroom. The en-suite bath includes double vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in glass shower, with a nearby office providing flexible space for work or study. A split bedroom design places two additional guest suites on the main level, each with its own private bath and fresh carpeting, offering comfort and privacy for family and guests. Upstairs, the fourth bedroom occupies the entire second level, functioning as a private guest or in-law suite with bamboo flooring, built-in cabinetry, a kitchenette, a full bath, and a private balcony. Out back, the highlight of the backyard is a heated saltwater pool with attached spa, complemented by a fire pit, outdoor shower, and poolhouse half bath. Surrounded by wooded HOA land and framed by pond views, the setting feels private, peaceful, and well-suited for both entertaining and unwinding. Living in The Reserve extends well beyond the home itself, with private beach access through Litchfield by the Sea, tennis and pickleball courts, scenic walking trails, and an oceanfront clubhouse. Harbor Club Marina, located in a protected cove just off the Intracoastal Waterway, offers a full-time dock master, dry stack and boat slip storage, and a marina pool. Golfers may also enjoy The Reserve Golf Club, a private Greg Norman–designed course and part of McConnell Golf, a collection of premier private clubs across the Southeast. A home designed to bring people together, offer space to unwind, and make everyday living feel just a little more like time well spent.

Sophisticated living with all the latest conveniences. Exceptional opportunity to own a truly amazing all-brick southern style 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath custom lakefront home in one of Pawleys Island’s most coveted neighborhoods, The Reserve. Elegance abounds with fine architectural details, including high ceilings with palatial crown molding, modern lighting (all LEDs), custom built-ins, numerous transom windows, gorgeous wood flooring throughout, and three fireplaces – each with a distinctive mantel piece. The first-floor common areas provide a formal dining and living room flanking the grand two-story foyer with gallery-style overlook from the second floor. Centrally located, the expansive great room shares a double-sided fireplace with the office, a beautiful lake view with the adjacent Carolina room, and open-concept access with the gourmet kitchen. Quality stainless steel appliances, granite counters, working center island, and breakfast bar are kitchen hallmarks further complemented with a cozy breakfast nook, walk-in pantry, and large laundry/work room. Also on the first floor are two bedroom-suites. The primary bedroom comes with bay window sitting area, dual walk-in closets, and spa-like bathroom. Three more en suite bedrooms are on the second floor. Smart home-management is integrated for air/water temperature, smoke/CO2 detection, and irrigation control. Additional features include side-loading 2-car garage, two tankless water heaters, fenced yard, and back deck with firepit and lake view. The Reserve homeowners enjoy access to the River Club pool and Litchfield by the Sea (LBTS) amenities as well as opportunities to join The Reserve Golf Club and Harbor Club Marina, the latter offering convenient access to the Waccamaw River. Walk, bike or golf cart to the beach via the oceanfront gated community of LBTS. Amenities include parking, restrooms, outdoor showers, and an extensive sundeck surrounding the oceanfront clubhouse. The Reserve is an easy commute to Myrtle Beach or Charleston and is convenient to medical facilities, schools, restaurants, and shops, while being a world away.

Experience the epitome of Lowcountry luxury living at 528 Preservation Circle, a stunning 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home located in the highly sought-after gated community of The Reserve in Pawleys Island, South Carolina. This meticulously maintained residence offers an exquisite blend of sophistication, comfort, and coastal charm-perfectly designed for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. As you arrive, beautifully manicured landscaping and an impressive entrance welcome you into an expansive foyer that immediately sets the tone for the home's grandeur. Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully designed floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A formal dining room adds a touch of traditional elegance, ideal for hosting gatherings or holiday meals. The heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen-complete with modern stainless-steel appliances, granite countertops, custom cabinetry, and a large center island that invites friends and family to gather. Gorgeous hardwood floors, crown molding, and tray ceilings add timeless character throughout the living spaces, while large windows bathe the home in natural light. The spacious primary suite serves as a private retreat, featuring direct access to the backyard oasis through sliding glass doors. The en-suite bathroom is a spa-like escape, offering double vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Additional bedrooms and an office provide flexibility and comfort for family or guests. Step outside to your fully enclosed lanai-a true outdoor sanctuary. Here, a sparkling in-ground pool overlooks a tranquil pond, creating a peaceful setting for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Entertain with ease thanks to the fully equipped outdoor kitchen, outdoor fireplace, and mounted TV, making this the ultimate space for enjoying South Carolina's mild coastal climate year-round. Residents of The Reserve enjoy an unmatched lifestyle surrounded by natural beauty and first-class amenities. The community is home to the renowned Greg Norman-designed Reserve Golf Course, offering a world-class experience for golf enthusiasts. Homeowners also enjoy private beach access through Litchfield by the Sea, where pristine sandy shores, an oceanfront clubhouse, tennis courts, walking trails, and fishing docks await. For those who love the water, The Harbor Club Marina provides boat access, a community pool, and optional memberships for an active coastal lifestyle. Located just minutes from Pawleys Island's charming shops, fine dining, and scenic waterways, this home offers the perfect blend of serenity and convenience. Whether you're relaxing by your private pool, entertaining guests outdoors, or taking a short drive to the beach, 528 Preservation Circle is the ultimate expression of refined coastal living. Schedule your private showing today and discover what makes life in The Reserve at Pawleys Island truly extraordinary.

descriptions.desc: 226 Oatland Lake Drive, a stately manor-inspired residence in Pawleys Island's Willbrook Plantation, overlooking the #3 green. A circular drive with ample parking leads to a grand portico framed by scrolled columns and matching circular steps. Inside, a two-story foyer opens to the formal dining room. The dining room connects to the kitchen through a butler's pantry with a wet bar and wine fridge, a layout made for hosting. Also off the foyer, a parlor with a wood-burning fireplace offers a quiet retreat. Brazilian cherry hardwood floors run throughout, and rarely seen craftsmanship can be found throughout in the detailed millwork, graceful arches, transoms, trim, and baseboards. The great room features custom built-ins and a gas fireplace, with views across the patio to the golf course. The chef's kitchen includes a Wolf 6-burner range, an oversized island, a walk-in pantry, a planning desk, and a sunny eat-in area. The main-level primary suite offers his-and-hers closets/baths. Also on the main level are a private office with an adjacent bath, a mud room with a locker bench that conveys, a powder room, and a utility room. Upstairs are four guest bedrooms: two with en-suite baths and two sharing a Jack & Jill bath. The bonus room over the garage is ready for a theater, media room, or rec room. Outside, the fenced yard, patio, and pergola with TV create a true outdoor living room. Additional features include a whole-house vacuum, surround sound, plantation shutters, whole-house water filtration, a buried propane tank, generous closets throughout, and a 2-car garage with workshop and storage space. Minutes to the beaches, dining, and shopping of Pawleys Island and Murrells Inlet. Schedule your private showing today.

Discover the timeless beauty of Low Country living in this exceptional custom-built residence, where Southern elegance, thoughtful design, and an extraordinary natural setting come together in perfect harmony. Located in the picturesque, gated golf community of Willbrook Plantation in Pawleys Island, this beautifully maintained home enjoys a park-like setting surrounded by professional landscaping and majestic, century-old live oaks draped in Spanish moss. Beyond the backyard, historic ricefields and the tranquil marshlands of the Waccamaw River create a breathtaking western vista—and spectacular sunsets paint the evening sky in unforgettable hues of red, orange, and gold. Custom built with exceptional quality and superior craftsmanship, this bright and inviting home has been meticulously maintained and thoughtfully enhanced. Recent improvements include a new roof with transferable warranty (April 2026), new main-level HVAC (May 2026), new water heater (June 2026), front gutters, gutter guards on all gutters, and a new irrigation pump (September 2026). A generator and exterior elevator also convey. The flowing floor plan offers generous living spaces, abundant natural light, four bedrooms, hardwood flooring throughout the main living areas and bedrooms, and three full baths plus one-half bath. The inviting great room features a brick gas-log fireplace with custom mantel and built-in cabinetry, soaring vaulted ceiling and upper windows that fill the room with natural light. The well-appointed kitchen features stainless-steel appliances, gas cooktop, farmhouse sink, quartz countertops, trash compactor, pantry and breakfast bar. The elegant formal dining room features French doors opening to the expansive front porch. One of the home's most appealing spaces is the exceptional three-season room with a wonderful connection to the outdoors. A corner gas-log fireplace and expansive windows showcase the beautifully landscaped backyard and natural beauty beyond. The first-floor primary suite provides a private retreat with large windows and back porch access. The luxurious ensuite bath features two custom walk-in closets, dual granite vanities, whirlpool tub, tiled shower, tile flooring and plantation shutters. Two additional guest bedrooms share a Jack-and-Jill bath. The fourth bedroom has its own full bath, ideal as a private guest suite. An expansive family room, versatile flex room, laundry room, half bath and additional flexible room provide space for an office, craft room, exercise studio, media room or hobby. A dedicated storage/supply room offers excellent organization and covered outdoor access. The oversized three-car garage offers ample room for vehicles, storage and projects and includes a workbench. Outside, the original patio has been expanded with pavers, creating an inviting space for outdoor dining and entertaining. Residents of Willbrook Plantation enjoy a gated setting, community pool, clubhouse and the esteemed Dan Maples-designed golf course. Perhaps most special is the community's exclusive access to private oceanfront amenities at Litchfield by the Sea, conveniently accessible by golf cart. Amenities include private beach parking, tennis courts, beach clubhouse, showers, sun decks, fishing and crabbing docks, and miles of pristine Atlantic coastline. Ideally situated in Pawleys Island, this remarkable residence is close to renowned restaurants, boutique shopping, Brookgreen Gardens, Huntington Beach State Park and Charleston. More than a beautifully crafted home, this is an opportunity to embrace the relaxed sophistication, natural beauty and timeless charm of Low Country coastal living.

Enjoy the serenity of the end of the cul-de-sac location bordered by natural wetlands. A birdwatchers delight. Beautiful view from dining room, great room and owner's suite. Owner's suite includes large bedroom with fireplace opening onto a porch. Bath has a soaking tub, large walk in shower and twin vanities. From the great room with fireplace, step out to a screened porch surrounded by nature. When guests arrive, they can enjoy their own private space above the garage with 2 bedrooms, bath, sitting area and their own porch. Gated community with access to Litchfield by the Sea. Call today to see this very special home.

Perfectly positioned along the picturesque fairways of the prestigious Willbrook Plantation Golf Club, 15 Ruddy Duck Lane captures the very essence of refined Lowcountry living. Overlooking tranquil pond views and the beautifully manicured 15th hole of the acclaimed Dan Maples designed golf course, this exceptional all-brick residence offers an impressive combination of timeless elegance, spacious design, and relaxed coastal comfort. Thoughtfully crafted to offer 4 bedrooms and 5.5 baths, the home is surrounded by mature landscaping and enhanced by a new roof installed in 2024. Entering the home the detailed craftsmanship is evident at every turn, including substantial crown molding, custom built-ins and architectural details that elevate each space. The inviting living room serves as the heart of the home, anchored by a beautiful brick gas-log fireplace with a custom mantel and lovely built-in cabinetry. A wall of oversized windows stretches to the ceiling, framing breathtaking pond and golf course views while filling the home with natural light. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the custom kitchen is a standout feature, offering granite countertops, extensive custom cabinetry, a butcher block work island with secondary sink, breakfast bar seating, built-in desk area, gas range, wall oven, convection microwave, wine cooler, tile backsplash, tile flooring, and a spacious walk-in pantry. The adjoining breakfast nook is wrapped in windows and provides a peaceful setting to enjoy morning coffee while overlooking the serene backyard. Elegant formal spaces include a beautifully appointed dining room with tray ceiling, chair railing, and hardwood flooring, along with a handsome den that offers additional flexibility for a home office, library, or quiet sitting area. The first-floor primary suite is a private retreat featuring large windows, a double tray ceiling, an expansive custom walk-in closet, and a luxurious ensuite bath complete with dual granite vanities, a spa-style soaking tub, tiled shower, and tile flooring. Two additional guest suites are also located on the main level, each offering generous closet space and private baths for added comfort and privacy. Blending indoor and outdoor living, the spacious Carolina room is a favorite gathering space. Sliding glass panels effortlessly transform the room into a screened porch, creating the perfect place to relax and enjoy peaceful pond and golf course views year-round. Additional main-level features include an oversized laundry room with cabinetry, folding counter, utility sink, abundant storage, half bath, and an oversized side-load three-car garage complete with workshop space and substantial unfinished storage above. Upstairs, the expansive 26’ x 28’ recreation room with soaring ceilings offers endless possibilities for entertaining, gaming, media space, or billiards. Built-in cabinetry with sink and mini refrigerator add convenience, while a large walk-in closet and nearby full bath enhance functionality. The 4th bedroom with private bath and an additional 10’ x 18’ office or flex space are also located on this level. An impressive 38’ x 18’ walk-out attic provides exceptional storage rarely found in homes of this caliber. Residents of Willbrook Plantation enjoy the privacy of a gated golf course community along with exceptional amenities including a community pool and clubhouse. Even more impressive is the exclusive access to the private ocean beach amenities at Litchfield by the Sea, easily reached by golf cart and featuring private parking, tennis courts, beach clubhouse, showers, sun decks, fishing and crabbing docks, and miles of pristine coastline. Conveniently located near renowned restaurants, boutique shopping, Brookgreen Gardens, Huntington Beach State Park, and within easy reach of Charleston, this remarkable residence offers an extraordinary opportunity to experience the very best of coastal South Carolina living.

Welcome to 280 Oatland Lake Road in prestigious Willbrook Plantation, where refined coastal living meets effortless comfort. Perfectly positioned along the 3rd fairway of the Dan Maples-designed golf course, this exceptional 4-bedroom, 2 full bath, 2 half bath residence offers timeless elegance, thoughtful updates, and a truly enviable Pawleys Island lifestyle. From the inviting front porch, step into a gracious foyer that sets the tone for the home’s warm and sophisticated interior. A formal dining room and private office are located just off the entry, while a graceful winding staircase adds architectural charm. The expansive great room showcases stunning golf course views through oversized windows, filling the space with natural light and creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The main-level primary suite provides a peaceful retreat, complete with a beautifully updated en suite bath. On the opposite side of the home, the gourmet eat-in kitchen, updated in 2023 with new appliances, offers a stylish and functional space for casual dining and hosting. Upstairs, a spacious workout room and hallway lead to three additional bedrooms and a private bath, providing comfort and flexibility for family and guests. Designed for year-round enjoyment, the home also features an enclosed rear porch and an expansive Trex deck with a brand new hot tub tucked privately next to the en suite, creating the perfect place to relax after a day at the beach or on the course. With new hardwood flooring in 2022, updated kitchen and appliances in 2023, completely new HVAC systems in 2024, and new roof in 2019, this home delivers both luxury and peace of mind. Just a golf cart ride from private beach access, and minutes from boutique shopping and fine dining, this remarkable property offers the best of Coastal Carolina living in one of Pawleys Island’s most desirable and historic communities.

Discover 423 Chapman Loop, a beautifully maintained traditional residence set within Willbrook Plantation, one of the Grand Strand’s most desirable gated neighborhoods. Offering more than 3,300 heated square feet with 4 generous bedrooms and 3.5 updated baths, this property provides the room, comfort, and refined touches that today’s buyers appreciate. Inside, you’ll notice immediately how well the home has been cared for. New flooring added in 2022, classic plantation shutters, and thoughtful finishes throughout create an inviting, timeless feel. The kitchen is designed for cooks who love to entertain, complete with a new cooktop and plenty of workspace for everyday meals or hosting friends. Major improvements include (2) new hot water heaters installed in 2024 and 2022, along with a brand-new roof completed in January 2025, giving the next owner confidence and lasting value. A standout feature of the home is the screened-in porch overlooking the 8th green of the Willbrook Plantation Golf Course. It’s the ideal spot to enjoy your morning coffee, relax at sunset, or take in peaceful views year-round. The property also includes a well-fed irrigation system, helping maintain a lush lawn while keeping utility costs down. The lifestyle within Willbrook Plantation is just as appealing as the home itself. Residents have access to a community pool and clubhouse, plus exclusive privileges at Litchfield by the Sea. A quick golf-cart ride brings you to private beach access with tennis courts, a beach clubhouse, restrooms, showers, and docks perfect for fishing or crabbing. Miles of unspoiled shoreline offer endless opportunities to enjoy the coast. 423 Chapman Loop delivers not only a beautiful home but an exceptional way of life, blending comfort, elegance, and the relaxed charm Pawleys Island is known for. Conveniently located near shops and fine dining, it’s also just 70 miles from historic Charleston and about 25 miles from Myrtle Beach attractions. Experience the best of coastal living in this remarkable Willbrook Plantation residence.

Coastal elegance meets Lowcountry charm in this exceptional all-brick home, gracefully positioned along the scenic fairways of the Dan Maples designed Willbrook Plantation Golf Course. Framed by mature landscaping and overlooking serene pond views, this 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath estate offers nearly 5,000 square feet of beautifully curated living space designed for relaxed luxury and effortless entertaining. From the moment you step into the soaring two-story foyer, light and space come together in perfect harmony. Sunlight filters through the generous windows, highlighting the home’s fine craftsmanship—detailed crown moldings, custom finishes, and thoughtful architectural touches throughout. The expansive Great Room invites gatherings by the gas fireplace, while the gourmet kitchen, a true centerpiece of the home, is both functional and stunning. Granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a gas range, dual ovens, and custom cabinetry make it a dream for the home chef. Enjoy casual mornings at the breakfast nook, elegant dinners in the formal dining room, or relax in the Carolina Room where floor-to-ceiling windows frame spectacular views of the golf course. The primary suite on the main level is a peaceful retreat—featuring a double-tray ceiling, his-and-her walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, granite counters, a whirlpool tub, and a beautifully tiled shower. Two additional guest bedrooms are privately tucked away, each with ample closet space and access to a well-appointed guest bath. Upstairs, you’ll find the perfect blend of versatility and comfort - a spacious bonus/game room with a wet bar, a guest bedroom, a full bath, and an additional private bedroom suite with large walk-in closet with a pull-down to more storage above. A separate flex room provides endless possibilities for a home office, fitness space, or additional sleeping area. For those who love to blend indoor comfort with outdoor living, the 3-season room is sure to be a favorite. Sliding glass panels open to create a breezy screened porch, perfect for morning coffee or a favorite beverage later in the day while taking in peaceful views of the pond and fairway. An oversized three-car side-load garage with tall ceilings, a half bath, and abundant storage completes this exceptional home. Willbrook Plantation is a gated golf course community that offers exceptional amenities to residents including a community pool and clubhouse. Residents can also enjoy a short golf cart ride to the private ocean beach access at Litchfield by the Sea providing abundant parking, tennis courts, beach clubhouse, showers, restroom conveniences, sundecks, fishing/crabbing docks as well as miles of gorgeous ocean beach to explore and enjoy! The home’s location provides easy access to some of the very best features the area has to offer including an abundance of incredible restaurants, unique shops, the renowned Brookgreen Gardens, Huntington Beach State Park and a short drive to Historic Charleston. 272 Chapman Loop embodies the perfect blend of sophistication, comfort, and the relaxed coastal lifestyle the South Carolina Lowcountry is known for.

Gracious Southern Living in Prestigious Willbrook Plantation! Nestled within the exclusive, gated golf course community of Willbrook Plantation, this custom-built, single-level all-brick residence offers timeless elegance and thoughtful design. Overlooking the 16th hole of the acclaimed Dan Maples-designed course, the home blends luxurious updates with classic architectural details, creating a serene and refined retreat. Step inside to discover a beautifully updated interior featuring a gourmet kitchen adorned with white custom cabinetry, marble countertops, a gas cooktop, and a functional work island—perfect for entertaining or quiet evenings at home. The vaulted family room, anchored by a charming fireplace flanked by custom bookcases, is flooded with natural light through four sets of French doors that open to the expansive rear deck and paver patio, inviting indoor-outdoor living. The well-appointed split-bedroom layout ensures privacy and comfort. A spacious primary suite is complemented by a walk in custom closet as well as a custom built armoire. A formal dining room adds a touch of sophistication for holiday gatherings or intimate dinners. Enjoy morning coffee or evening cocktails in the delightful sunroom, complete with a wet bar and tranquil golf course views. Outdoor living and entertaining is a breeze with the large deck and paver patio. Additional features include a new roof (March 2024), new HVAC system (September 2024), and an attached two-car garage with a dedicated workroom—ideal for hobbies or extra storage. Located in one of the Grand Strand’s most sought-after communities, with access to private beach facilities at Litchfield by the Sea, this exceptional home is a rare opportunity to experience Lowcountry living at its finest. *Measurements and square footage are approximate. The buyer/buyer's agent is responsible for verifying ALL information in the MLS including lot size, HOA Information, square footage, etc.

Welcome to your dream home in the desirable community of Allston Point in the Willbrook Plantation community. This charming 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath brick one story is perfectly situated on an oversized corner lot, surrounded by an beautiful azaleas, shrubbery and large oak trees framing this beautiful home. As you step inside you will discover an inviting open floor plan that seamlessly connects large living spaces with an abundance of natural light. Ideal for hosting gatherings and entertaining guests, this residence boasts a spacious great room with fireplace, cozy den and a delightful Carolina room. The primary suite is generously sized, featuring a large walk-in closet, double vanity and a shower complimented by a garden tub. The kitchen is spacious, featuring granite countertops and cabinetry and large breakfast area with an inside grill. The Carolina room opens up to a fenced-in backyard, complete with a side garden and room for a pool, making it an ideal spot for entertaining. Willbrook Plantation is a gated golf course community that offers a community pool, club house and as a resident, you can enjoy a brief golf cart ride to the exclusive Litchfield by the Sea private resort. LBTS offers a variety of amenities including a private beach, sun deck with stunning views of the ocean, showers/restrooms, tennis, fishing and more. Located in Pawleys Island, SC and a perfect blend of tranquility and convenience, with quaint shopping and excellent dining options just moments away. Situated approximately 90 miles from the historic city of Charleston. This home is a canvas for your creativity - make it your own and enjoy the incredible lifestyle that comes with living in Willbrook Plantation

Welcome to 383 Oatland Lake Road, a skillfully designed, custom-built, all brick home nestled in the historic and exclusive Willbrook Plantation Community! Proudly offered by the original owners, this exceptional home presents a unique opportunity to embrace a lifestyle of elegance and comfort while surrounded by natural beauty. Situated on an exquisitely landscaped .65-acre lot, the home offers unobstructed backyard views of the 7th hole and fairway of the Dan Maples designed Willbrook Plantation Golf Course, as well as unrestricted views of the 3rd hole and fairway presented from the front of the home. Recent removal of all wallpaper and freshly painted, this custom built provides exceptional quality and superior craftsmanship. The home has a newer roof (approx. 6 yrs old) and newer HVAC systems (2022, 2020 & mini-split 2017). This bright and cheerful home offers 4 Bedrooms, 3 Full and One Half Baths, spacious Great Room, impressive Kitchen, appealing Family Room, separate Office, exceptional Carolina Room, a generously sized Bonus Room/Bedroom on the second level with a full bath and an abundance of additional storage space, a laundry room, an over-sized 2 car side-load attached garage and a separate workshop with private entrance. The tastefully appointed Kitchen features attractive LVT flooring, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom 42” cabinets, breakfast bar, breakfast nook, work island and a new range. The Formal Dining Room is the perfect place for family gatherings or when entertaining friends. This lovely room has a set of tall windows with an above transom that showcases the beautifully landscaped front yard and captivating golf course views. The Great Room is accented with an impressive coffered ceiling, offering stunning views of the gorgeous backyard and manicured golf course beyond. Additionally, the custom French Doors enhanced with an elegant glass transom above leads to the sizeable, raised patio overlooking the surroundings making this the ideal place to sip that morning coffee or later in the day with a favorite beverage. The Carolina Room also offers stunning golf course views through the floor-to-ceiling windows that enclose this charming addition that can be enjoyed throughout all seasons due to the added mini-split. The inviting Family Room has an attractive gas log fireplace embellished by custom, decorative built-ins. The Primary Bedrooms also offers a cozy gas log fireplace to offset those chilly nights, along with hardwood flooring, two walk-in closets and a linen closet. The en-suite has a double vanity sink, tub and separate glass shower. The main level also provides two guest bedrooms, office, half bath and laundry room with tile flooring, utility sink and full-size washer & dryer. The sprawling Bonus Room is located on the second level with a full bath with a tiled, glass shower and pedestal sink. This versatile room easily accommodates guests or family with privacy and space while also providing an abundance of storage space. The side-load garage also offers additional storage. The separate workshop with private entrance can be utilized for an endless number of possible uses including a craft room, sewing room, mancave, etc. 3M Hurricane safety film was added to all windows except in the Carolina Room. Willbrook Plantation is a gated golf course community that offers exceptional amenities to residents including a community pool and clubhouse. Residents can also enjoy a short golf cart ride to the private ocean beach access at Litchfield by the Sea providing abundant parking, tennis courts, beach clubhouse, showers, restroom conveniences, sundecks, fishing/crabbing docks as well as miles of gorgeous ocean beach to explore and enjoy! The home’s location provides easy access to some of the very best features the area has to offer including an abundance of incredible restaurants, the renowned Brookgreen Gardens, Huntington State Park and Historic Charleston.

Located in Oak Point Estates within Willbrook Plantation. 509 Heston Point is an estate home, nestled on 1.83 acres among a canopy of majestic live oak and 300 year old cypress trees draped with Spanish moss. BRAND NEW ROOF! This property exudes the timeless charm and tranquility of the low country. Situated on the banks of Oatland Creek which joins the ICW/River. Only a 5-10 min cruise to the River! The tranquil tidal creek, beckons you to escape the hustle and bustle and embrace the serenity of creek-front living. Approaching the home, the driveway meanders through a lush landscape of native flora, offering glimpses of the natural setting that lies beyond. As you enter, you will notice the custom metal doors which opens up to an expansive living area offering warm tones, vaulted ceilings, built-ins, gas fireplace, hardwood flooring and vast windows allowing sunlight to filter throughout. This is a 5 bedroom, 5.5 bath home with two office spaces, Carolina room with gas logs, wine bar area, exercise room with floor to ceiling windows overlooking the creek and a large in-law suite over the garage. The primary suite is on the first level with a private patio overlooking the natural setting, where you can sip your morning coffee and watch the sunrise in solitude. The primary bath boast a double vanity, whirlpool tub, shower, water closet and his/her walk-in closets. One of the bedrooms is used as a media room. The kitchen and dining room is a chef’s delight with custom cabinetry, granite countertops, gas range, stainless steel appliances, under counter and overhead lighting. The open kitchen flows nicely into the Carolina Room to enjoy every season! A few other highlights include amazing views from every room, a huge laundry room, ample storage, fresh paint, oversized garage and brand new garage doors! A screened breezeway leads to the in-law suite, which also has its own private entrance. All furnishings seen within the in-law suite will stay! French doors along the back of the home leading you out to the backyard sanctuary. Outside, a sprawling deck extends from the rear of the home, offering an ideal spot for entertaining. Discover your own “Brookgreen Gardens” with brick walkways, sitting areas, bird watching and a fire-pit to enjoy on the cool evenings. Enjoy your private dock and the Oak Point Estates community boat ramp. Whether you're launching a boat, casting a line in search of the day's catch, or simply basking in the beauty of nature, the navigable creek offers so much serenity. A wooden dock stretches out over the water, providing easy access for boating or simply enjoying the sunsets. Willbrook Plantation has 24 hour gated security, community pool, golf course, tennis courts, and private beach access at LBTS. This is a one of a kind property!

Discover the timeless Low Country charm that is exhibited throughout this well-designed all-brick home bestowing stylish southern elegance. Located in the picturesque Willbrook Golf Community, featuring the esteemed Dan Maples designed course, the home is perfectly positioned on a corner cul-de-sac. Sequestered in a beautiful park-like setting surrounded by lush landscaping and century old live oaks draped in Spanish Moss that leads to the historic ricefields and the marshlands of the Waccamaw River. Custom built with exceptional quality and superior craftsmanship, this bright and cheerful home offers 4 bedrooms, 3 full and one half baths, generously sized great room, impressive kitchen, family room with attractive gas log fireplace, 2 separate offices, exceptional 3 season room with a full wall of windows showcasing the spectacular backyard, side screen porch, flex room, laundry room, lots of storage space and an over-sized attached garage that measures 29’ x 24’ and can easily accommodate 3 cars, a golf cart, workshop and more. The garage also offers a 240v ready for EV Charger. The roof was replaced in 2020 to SC Safe Home construction standards, the stunning wood floors that flow through the main living space and stairs to second level were refinished in 2024 and new carpet was added in the two guest bedrooms and hallway on the upper level, as well. The tastefully appointed kitchen offers Silestone quartz countertops and includes a unique desk/work area, black stainless steel appliances, smooth glass-cook top, an abundance of custom designed cabinetry with built-in pantry and a second larger pantry, tile backsplash, commercial “clear ice” maker and a spacious alcove to accommodate gatherings. For those who prefer a gas range cooktop, there is a propane gas line readily available for easy transfer. Adjacent to the kitchen is the family room with a soaring vaulted ceiling accented with wooden beams, prominent brick gas log fireplace and floor to ceiling windows enhanced with arched transoms making this the perfect location for continued after dinner conversations. The well-appointed primary bedroom offers a double tray ceiling with a ceiling fan and two walk-in closets. The en-suite offers tile flooring, double sink vanities, jetted soaking tub and a tiled shower. The 26’x14’ three season room provides the most peaceful and serene views of the magnificent backyard. And, whether it be while sipping an early morning cup of coffee or while enjoying the company of family and friends, this 3-season room provides the perfect place to capture these delightful views. Three guest bedrooms, two full baths, extended bonus room, flex room and easily accessible walk-out attic space are all situated on the second floor. A few additional features worth mentioning include custom polycarbonate hurricane shutters conveniently located in the garage closet, 2 separate 40 gallon water heaters, cost-saving separate water meter for irrigation combined with a drip irrigation system installed to water potted plants. Willbrook Plantation is a gated golf course community that offers exceptional amenities to all residents including a community pool and clubhouse. Additionally, residents can also enjoy a short golf cart ride to the private ocean beach access at Litchfield by the Sea providing abundant parking, tennis courts, beach clubhouse, showers, restroom conveniences, sundecks, fishing/crabbing docks as well as miles of gorgeous ocean beach to explore and enjoy! The home’s location provides easy access to some of the very best features the area has to offer including additional distinguished golf courses, established tennis & pickleball courts, an abundance of incredible restaurants, the renowned Brookgreen Gardens, Huntington State Park, Myrtle Beach International Airport and much more. Also, Historic Charleston is a quick and easy drive from Pawleys Island, allowing for an exciting and fun day trip option.

A picture-perfect setting in the Prestigious Willbrook Plantation Community! Welcome to 356 Chapman Loop! This stunning brick home is nestled under magnificent century old live oak trees draped in Spanish moss while bestowing unpretentious southern elegance. Surrounded by an abundance of flowering hydrangeas, camellias, azaleas and a variety of additional plantings – the home also offers stunning views of the 9th Tee Box and Fairway of the Dan Maples designed Willbrook Plantation Golf Course! Additionally, unobscured views of the 8th Green are granted from the front of the home, as well. Custom-built and well-designed, the home offers 5 bedrooms, 3.5 baths with an extended sideload garage. Upon entry, the two-story foyer with an abundance of natural light streaming through the set of decorative windows located above is most impressive – while also promoting the beauty of the hardwood flooring and soaring staircase before you. The beautiful hardwood flooring continues into the expansive living room with ornate crown molding, and a gas log fireplace enriched with a handcrafted mantle that provides cozy warmth on cool evenings. Breathtaking views that surround the home can be captured from this room due to the well– designed floorplan that extends from front to back of the home. This impressive feature is also incorporated in the kitchen. The kitchen was recently updated to include granite countertops, custom cabinetry that includes pull-out drawers, a double oven, new refrigerator, dishwasher, pantry and a breakfast nook. Additionally, easy access to the second floor can be reached by way of the spiral staircase that is cleverly positioned here. The formal dining room, with easy access from the kitchen, is the perfect place for family gatherings or when entertaining friends. This lovely room has an appealing large bay window showcasing the beautifully landscaped backyard along with captivating golf course views. The decorative crown molding, ornamental ceiling medallion and chair railing add additional charm to this dining area that can easily accommodate a large table, sideboard and a hutch, while providing direct entry to the formal living room which is the perfect place for continued after dinner conversations. The spectacular Carolina Room with beautiful hardwood flooring, electric fireplace and wall to ceiling windows provides spectacular views of the lush backyard and the golf course. This serene space is perfect for relaxing and taking in all the natural beauty that surrounds this exceptional oasis. The primary bedroom suite is also located on the main floor. This room features a sitting area flanked by custom built-ins on either side of windows enhanced with plantation shutters, crown molding, and ceiling fan. The ensuite also offers plantation shutters, an easy entry shower, dual vanities, a large walk-in closet, two spacious closets and linen closet and a large walk-in. This main level also provides a conveniently located half bath, a washer & dryer and, as an added feature, this main level is entirely handicap accessible. The second level also offers spectacular views and provides 4 bedrooms and 2 full baths. One bath is a Jack & Jill with double sinks and a shower/tub combination and there is also a laundry room with a full-size washer & dryer. Each bedroom has a ceiling fan and an abundance of closet space with the largest bedroom offering built-ins with shelving to provide flexibility. Custom Hurricane shutters are stored in the garage and there is also an irrigation system. Willbrook Plantation is a gated golf course community that offers exceptional amenities to its residents that include a community pool and clubhouse. Residents can also enjoy a short golf cart ride to the private ocean beach access at Litchfield by the Sea providing abundant parking, tennis courts, beach clubhouse, showers, restroom conveniences, sun decks, fishing/crabbing docks as well as miles of gorgeous ocean beach to explore & enjoy!
