descriptions.desc: Welcome to 104 Spreading Oak Drive, a beautiful custom-built Lowcountry home located in the highly sought-after gated community of Litchfield Plantation in Pawleys Island. Offering five bedrooms, five full bathrooms, and one half bath, this elegant home was thoughtfully designed for both comfortable everyday living and entertaining. Each of the five bedrooms features its own private en suite bathroom, providing exceptional comfort and privacy for family and guests alike. Beautiful hardwood floors extend throughout the first floor, where spacious living areas flow seamlessly together. The gourmet kitchen features a large center island and wet bar and opens to the family room and formal dining room, creating an inviting space for gathering and entertaining. The first-floor primary suite offers beautiful built-ins and a luxurious private bath. Designed with indoor and outdoor living in mind, the home's expansive porches provide peaceful views of Chapel Creek and the surrounding natural beauty. Beyond the home itself, Litchfield Plantation offers a lifestyle unlike any other along the South Strand. Enter through the gated entrance and travel beneath the centuries-old live oaks draped in Spanish moss along the iconic Avenue of Oaks, a setting that captures the timeless charm of the Lowcountry. Residents enjoy access to the historic plantation house, a beautiful community pool overlooking the former rice fields, and a private oceanfront beach house on Pawleys Island. For boating enthusiasts, a privately owned marina within the plantation offers access to the Waccamaw River and Intracoastal Waterway. Just minutes from the beaches, golf courses, restaurants, and shopping of Pawleys Island, Litchfield Plantation offers a rare combination of history, natural beauty, and convenience. With its spacious floor plan, private guest accommodations, inviting outdoor living spaces, and peaceful creekside setting, 104 Spreading Oak Drive is a wonderful opportunity to experience Lowcountry living in one of Pawleys Island's most distinctive communities. Listing agent is related to the sellers.

Some homes are defined by what’s inside. This one may be remembered for how it feels to live here. Welcome to 723 Tuckers Road, a special home tucked within the beautiful surroundings of Litchfield Plantation, where peaceful water views, inviting outdoor spaces, and the relaxed rhythm of Pawleys Island come together. Imagine starting your morning in the Carolina room with coffee and a view of the water, then ending the day outside as the light settles across the backyard. With multiple levels of patio space surrounded by an amazing yard, there are places to gather with friends, enjoy dinner outdoors, curl up with a good book, or simply sit back and appreciate the setting. This is outdoor living that feels like a natural extension of the home. Inside, the 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath floor plan offers comfortable spaces for both everyday living and entertaining. Separate dining room off the gourmet kitchen provides great space for family get-togethers. A versatile bonus room provides the flexibility for a home office, media room, hobby space, or additional guest area, while the Carolina room may quickly become a favorite place to relax by the wood fireplace and take in the view. Custom cabinetry throughout, upscale appliances, Plantation Shutters, high-end Marvin windows contribute to the luxurious feel of this custom home built in 2020. Ownership of this home is not limited to the home itself. It includes use of the original 1750 Plantation House, a community pool overlooking the ricefields, and access to the community-owned oceanfront beach house on Pawleys Island. And when you’re ready to venture out, the beaches, restaurants, golf, shopping, and laid-back lifestyle of Pawleys Island are just minutes away. 723 Tuckers Road isn’t simply about bedrooms and baths. It’s about morning coffee overlooking the water, evenings on the patio, time spent with people you enjoy, and having a place that makes it easy to slow down and enjoy where you live. Come experience what makes this home—and its setting—so special.

From the moment you drive through the gates of Litchfield Plantation, you know you’ve arrived somewhere special. The beautiful live oaks lining the road into the plantation, dripping with Spanish moss, immediately set the tone for what makes this community so special. Litchfield Plantation is one of the most desired gated communities in Pawleys Island. This Lowcountry home with a welcoming front porch boasts 5 bedrooms and 3½ baths. The home has a wonderful floor plan with a primary suite on the first floor and a beautiful guest suite upstairs with its own private bath. The first floor has so many lovely details, including plantation shutters, recessed lighting, antique gates, crown molding, pantry, foyer closet and a screened porch. I particularly love the privacy of the side yard, where you can sit and enjoy the beautiful landscaping surrounding the home with a lighted wall. The palms, Japanese Maple, and mature greenery give the yard such a peaceful, established feeling. And then there is the community pool… truly one of the prettiest settings I’ve ever seen. It overlooks the marsh and is surrounded by live oaks covered in Spanish Moss. There is something so peaceful about sitting there and taking it all in. The community also has its own private beach house with bathrooms and parking, making beach days so easy and convenient. For those who love being on the water, there is boat storage and a marina available for an additional fee. There is even a beautiful historic plantation house within the community available for special events, which adds to the history and charm of this very special place. With a ¼-acre lot, beautiful landscaping, private guest suite, wonderful amenities, beach access, and that unmistakable Pawleys Island charm, this home is more than just a place to live; it is a place you, your family and guests will always enjoy.

Beautiful custom-built home in Litchfield Plantation. As you pass through the gated entrance and drive beneath the 200-to 300-year-old moss-laden live oaks lining the Avenue of the Oaks, you will realize you have arrived at one of the most stunning settings on the Hammock Coast. This community offers an exceptional lifestyle, featuring exclusive beach access at a private oceanfront beach house reserved for owners and guests. The private marina provides direct access to the Waccamaw River and the Intracoastal Waterway, while the inviting pool overlooking the historic rice fields is a neighborhood favorite. Residents and local wildlife—including deer, snowy egrets, great blue herons, and owls—live in perfect harmony here. Do not miss this opportunity to embrace a true Low Country living experience in an extraordinary community. This 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Lowcountry home is situated on a spacious 1-acre lot and features a screened porch overlooking a large backyard and lagoon .Call today for details

Experience uniquely spectacular views from this exceptional home overlooking the sweeping rice fields, complete with unforgettable sunsets. Located in the highly coveted, gated community of Litchfield Plantation, residents enjoy access to a private oceanfront beach house and a beautiful community pool. This pristine 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home with an attached two-car garage showcases an open, thoughtfully designed floor plan with 10’ ceilings and exquisite LVP flooring throughout. The gourmet kitchen features an 8’ island with an apron-front stainless farmhouse sink, quartz countertops, custom gray cabinetry, subway tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and a gas range. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the main living and dining areas, where two sets of French doors open to a large screened porch capturing the breathtaking marsh and water views. A stylish sliding barn door leads to the laundry room and pantry, and a convenient half bath is located just off the kitchen. The main-floor primary suite includes two closets (one walk-in), a ceiling fan, a tiled shower, and a quartz-top vanity. The lower level offers access to the garage, a guest bedroom with closet and ceiling fan, a full bath with tiled garden-tub/shower combo, and a den with French doors opening to a Trex deck—perfect for enjoying the serene marsh landscape. Additional features include a metal roof, under-stair storage, shiplap accents, plantation shutters, custom shades, tankless gas water heater, exterior gas line for grilling, and a transferable termite bond. Litchfield Plantation offers an unmatched lifestyle with proximity to world-class golf, outstanding restaurants, charming shops, abundant water activities, and miles of pristine beaches. Put 19 Red Skiff on your list to see.

Experience refined coastal luxury in this exceptional new construction residence located within the prestigious gated community of Litchfield Plantation. Thoughtfully designed with elevated finishes and timeless Lowcountry architecture, this 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath home offers an ideal blend of sophistication, comfort, and energy-efficient living. Inside, 10-foot ceilings and an open, airy floor plan create a seamless flow throughout the main living spaces. The gourmet kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring semi-custom cabinetry, a Bosch stainless steel appliance package, premium finishes, and an effortless connection to the spacious living and dining areas. Rich wood flooring, detailed trim work, recessed LED lighting, and a gas fireplace add warmth and refinement throughout the interior. Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed to provide privacy and comfort, while the beautifully appointed bathrooms showcase elegant fixtures and tile flooring. Constructed with both quality and durability in mind, the home includes impact-rated windows and doors, 2x6 framing, a tankless water heater, and a high-efficiency 16 SEER HVAC system. Exterior features include fiber cement siding, architectural shingles, professionally landscaped grounds with irrigation, and inviting front porch spaces that embrace the relaxed coastal lifestyle. Located in one of Pawleys Island’s most iconic communities, residents of Litchfield Plantation enjoy unmatched amenities including a historic plantation clubhouse, community pool overlooking the rice fields, option to join private marina, and an oceanfront beach house on Pawleys Island. This is a rare opportunity to own a beautifully crafted new construction home in one of the Lowcountry’s most sought-after neighborhoods.

Don't miss this better than new two-story townhome, offering 4 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, and an impressive level of craftsmanship throughout. Built in 2024, and thoughtfully designed for both comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining, this upscale residence blends sophisticated finishes with the timeless character and natural beauty of Pawleys Island. The beautifully appointed kitchen is a true showpiece, featuring premium Miele and Sub-Zero appliances, complemented by high-end finishes throughout the home. Designer lighting and luxurious bathroom fixtures add an unmistakable sense of quality, while the spacious two-story floor plan offers privacy and flexibility for family and guests. Step outside to an extraordinary outdoor setting featuring a screened porch, incredible landscaping, outdoor kitchen, a distinctive brick wall, and a private putting green—creating a beautiful and inviting extension of the living space. Whether enjoying morning coffee, entertaining friends, or practicing your short game, this thoughtfully designed outdoor area is truly special. Set within the prestigious gated community of Litchfield Plantation, the townhome is surrounded by majestic live oaks, historic Lowcountry character, and peaceful natural beauty. Residents enjoy access to a community pool overlooking the picturesque ricefields, along with a community beach house on Pawleys Island, offering an ideal place to enjoy the beach and coastal lifestyle. From the exceptional interior finishes to the beautifully crafted outdoor spaces, this is Lowcountry living at its finest—where luxury, history, nature, and the Pawleys Island lifestyle come together in one remarkable property. Schedule your showing before it's too late!

Litchfield Plantation is a stunningly beautiful and historic landmark situated on the Intracoastal Waterway. Also known as The Waccamaw River. As you enter the guard at Litchfield Plantation, you will see the magnificent "Avenue of Oaks" and feel as you are stepping back in time. Driving through the "Avenue Of Oaks" will be an experience that never gets old as you make your way to your residence located on a corner parcel. 223 All Saints Loop offers all you are looking for an updated and beautifully appointed home. This 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home has two separate living areas, one upstairs along with 3 very large bedrooms upstairs. Plenty of storage with under stairs storage, finished garage has extra room for storage and pull down attic storage, all bathrooms have linen closets and 3 of the 4 bedrooms all have walk in closets. Beautiful outdoor space; screened in porch, oversized wood deck off the back of the house and a few oak trees that ties it all together. This home also features hand scraped wood style flooring throughout main living, predominantly all brick with a few Hardi plank accents on the back of the home, granite countertops, Kitchen Aid Professional series appliance package, shaker cabinets, subway tile backsplash, formal dining room with crown molding, Plantation shutters, whole house generator, balcony, gas propane fireplace and more. Amenities include a private beach House on Pawleys Island, a pool set among beautiful oak trees overlooking the Ricefields and gorgeous sunsets. There is also a small marina and a Historic Plantation house available for special occasions.

Welcome to this exceptional custom-crafted residence designed by renowned architect Thomas Krowka of Walsh Krowka & Associates, where timeless architecture meets high-performance living. Thoughtfully curated with an emphasis on quality, efficiency, and refined comfort, this home offers a truly elevated lifestyle both inside and out. From the moment you enter, you’re greeted by soaring 10-foot ceilings and beautifully finished, locally sourced oak flooring in mixed-width planks, creating a warm yet sophisticated backdrop. Every detail reflects intentional design—from impact-rated windows and doors with Low-E, argon-filled glass for energy efficiency and storm protection, to premium shutters that enhance both form and function. At the heart of the home is a stunning designer kitchen built for gathering and entertaining. A dual-island layout, including a handcrafted butcher-block centerpiece, is complemented by custom soft-close cabinetry with extensive built-in storage solutions. The walk-in pantry features custom shelving, power, and a hidden coffee station behind a bespoke chalkboard barn door. A Wolf 6-burner gas range with pot filler, custom wood hood, and additional wall oven complete this chef’s dream space. The home’s living spaces are equally impressive, offering custom built-ins, a private office with handcrafted pocket doors and built-in bookcases, and a beautifully designed mudroom with custom organizational features. A fully finished bonus room with full bath provides flexible space for guests, recreation, or a private retreat, while additional semi-finished storage areas offer practical versatility. The primary suite is a true sanctuary, featuring a tray ceiling, dual custom walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired bathroom complete with a steam shower for a luxurious, everyday escape. An in-suite wet bar with a vented wine refrigerator adds an extra layer of comfort and convenience. Each secondary bedroom includes walk-in closets with upgraded systems, and guest bathrooms have been thoughtfully renovated with high-end finishes, including rainfall showers, sliding glass doors, solid wood vanities, and stylish barn door accents. Designed for both comfort and peace of mind, the home is equipped with top-tier systems including a whole-house generator, multiple tankless water heaters, a multi-zone HVAC system with UV filtration, and a fully encapsulated crawlspace with dehumidification for enhanced air quality and long-term durability. Outdoor living is seamlessly integrated with over 1,000 square feet of updated composite decking, ideal for entertaining or relaxing. A custom pergola with built-in lighting, fan, and propane connection creates the perfect setting for gatherings, while a private outdoor shower adds convenience after beach days or outdoor activities. The property also includes a fully wired workshop designed to match the home and professionally enhanced topography for superior drainage and lasting landscape integrity. A temperature-controlled three-car garage with added sound barrier, ceiling-mounted storage, and finished storage space completes this exceptional offering. This one-of-a-kind home blends luxury craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and modern efficiency—delivering an unparalleled living experience for those seeking the very best in coastal living. Some photos in this listing have been virtually staged.

Discover this beautifully renovated villa nestled in the heart of the gated community - Litchfield Plantation. This stunning unit offers the convenience of a master bedroom on the main level, making it as functional as it is beautiful. Step outside onto the large back deck and take in a truly serene setting — mature live oaks draped in Spanish moss frame a peaceful water view that makes every day feel like a retreat. Whether you're enjoying your morning coffee or unwinding at sunset, the natural beauty surrounding this home is simply unmatched. As a resident of Litchfield Plantation, you'll enjoy access to the community pool as well as the private beach house on Pawleys Island - an exclusive perk available only to plantation residents. Complete with parking, restrooms, a full kitchen, and plenty of space to relax, the beach house serves as the perfect home base for a day at the beach. A stunning clubhouse and a marina for easy river access are also located within this stunning neighborhood!

Located in the historic Litchfield Plantation community of Pawleys Island, SC , 11 Chapel Creek Road offers the best in coastal living as a beautifully maintained two-story townhouse with timeless low country charm. No more so evident than the lovely, azalea ladened court yard entrance under the live oaks leading to stunning, huge wood front door with entrance to a warm foyer with classic brick flooring. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence features a bright and inviting interior floor plan with an open living, dining and kitchen area overlooking a beautiful backyard and pond. The kitchen offers generous cabinetry, beautiful wood countertops and ample workspace with a functional and convenient bar to the dining area. With all this your favorite "room" in the townhouse may well be the cozy rear screened porch with free standing fireplace and beautiful pond view—creating a natural and pleasant extension of the living space. The main living floor also features a large pantry, storage closet and beautiful half bath. Wonderful low country living is finished off by a private courtyard just off the kitchen providing a wonderful but secluded outdoor setting ideal for dining, entertaining, or enjoying the a little private time. Meticulously maintained and thoughtfully updated, the home offers peace of mind with a newer roof (2021), energy-efficient HVAC system (2021), tankless water heater (2021), plus replacement of significant siding and exterior paint (2024). Additional improvements include upgraded windows, a screened porch addition, and ongoing crawl space encapsulation and moisture control. Up the intriging architectural stairway, finds a spacious primary bedroom suite overlooking the rear grounds and peaceful pond features a beautifully updated en-suite bath. Two additional bedrooms share a remodeled bath offering flexibility for guests, family or perhaps an office. Other pluses of this second floor oasis are professionally outfitted closet spaces, huge storage closet and a wonderful, spacious laundry room. Steeped in history and natural beauty, Litchfield Plantation is known for its iconic Avenue of Oaks, centuries-old ricefields, and unmatched Lowcountry setting. Residents enjoy exceptional amenities, including a pool overlooking the former ricefields, a marina on the Waccamaw River, and access to a private oceanfront beach house on the north end of Pawleys Island. Conveniently located just minutes from beaches, dining, and golf, this property offers the perfect blend of comfort, character, and classic Lowcountry living.

Classic Southern Charm in Litchfield Plantation. Experience the timeless beauty and unmatched amenities of Litchfield Plantation with the stunning 4-bedroom, 2.5 bath home designed for comfortable coastal living. From the moment you arrive, the home's signature double front porches welcome you with classic Lowcountry charm and inviting curb appeal. Inside, you'll find a spacious open kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The formal dining area provides an elegant space for gatherings, while the private study with a fireplace offers a cozy retreat for work or relaxation. Step outside to enjoy the screened porch overlooking a beautifully, fully fenced backyard-ideal for outdoor living and privacy. This home also features a large walk-in panty and an oversized laundry room complete with a separate soaking sink, offering both convenience and ample storage. As a resident of Litchfield Plantation, you'll enjoy exclusive access to exceptional amenities, including a picturesque pool overlooking the historic rice fields and marsh, a private beach house on Pawleys Island, and a marina on the Intracoastal Waterway - perfect for boating enthusiasts. Whether you're searching for a primary residence or a coastal retreat, this home offers lifestyle, charm and space you've been looking for.

Double primary suites, two screened porches, and timeless Southern design come together in this beautifully detailed Litchfield Plantation home. Classic Southern architecture meets modern comfort in this beautifully detailed home in Litchfield Plantation—featuring double primary suites, two screened porches, and thoughtfully selected upgrades throughout. With 10-foot ceilings, rich walnut-stained hardwood floors, quartz countertops, and a gas range, this home blends Charleston-inspired design with a floorplan that lives effortlessly for today’s lifestyle. From the moment you arrive, the tabby-accented drive, walkways, and porches set the tone—subtle nods to classic Lowcountry craftsmanship that carry throughout the home. Sweeping porches, a standing seam metal roof accent, and a charming courtyard-style side entry create a presence that feels both welcoming and enduring. Inside, natural light highlights the home’s thoughtful placement and architectural detail—from substantial trimwork and molding to the elevated feel of 10-foot ceilings and 8-foot doors on the main level. Rich walnut-stained engineered hardwood floors provide a substantial, grounding backdrop for décor, while custom shutters and blinds and handsome built-ins flanking the stone-accented fireplace and chimney create a level of finish that feels both refined and enduring. The kitchen is designed to gather—anchored by quartz countertops, a gas range, stainless appliances, and stylish fixtures—all opening seamlessly to the dining area and great room with gas fireplace. It’s a space that lives as well as it looks. A standout feature of this home is how the porches naturally extend the living spaces. The main-level screened porch, complete with tabby flooring, offers a relaxed, shaded retreat just off the living area—perfect for quiet mornings or unwinding at the end of the day. Upstairs, a second screened porch extends from the primary suite, finished with durable decking and elevated views of the surrounding natural areas and ricefields. The floorplan offers flexibility without compromise, with two primary suites—one on each level—each featuring a private bath and walk-in closet. The main-level suite includes a spacious bath with double vanities, a soaking tub, and an oversized tiled shower with rain head and built-in seating. Upstairs, the second suite enjoys private porch access, dual vanities, and a walk-in tiled shower with a corner seat—thoughtfully designed for comfort and privacy. The second level continues with a loft-style living area ideal for a den, media space, or playroom. Two additional guest bedrooms are both generously sized and finished with carpeting for comfort. One bedroom features an accent wall with custom wainscoting—a signature design detail that adds character and charm—while both rooms share a well-appointed Jack-and-Jill bath. Additional features include a Rinnai gas tankless water heater, irrigation system, and an oversized two-car garage with side-load entry—thoughtfully positioned to maintain the home’s curb appeal. Litchfield Plantation remains one of the most distinctive communities along the South Strand—where history, natural beauty, and lifestyle come together in a way that simply can’t be recreated. From the iconic Avenue of Oaks to the historic plantation house, pool and pool house overlooking the ricefields, and private oceanfront beach house on Pawleys Island, ownership here is about more than a home—it’s about becoming part of something lasting.

Elegant, Low-Maintenance Living in Gated Historic Litchfield Plantation Welcome to this beautifully furnished 4-bedroom, 3-bath townhome offering spacious, open-concept living with upscale finishes throughout. Enjoy hardwood floors, 8-ft solid wood doors, high ceilings, rich trim work, plantation shutters, and top-tier appliances. The first-floor owner’s suite features a jetted tub, custom tile shower, dual marble vanities, and a walk-in closet. A private guest suite with full bath is also on the main level. Upstairs, find two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a versatile loft—ideal as an office or media space. Relax outdoors on the screened porch or back deck, and take advantage of the oversized two-car garage. Major updates include a new roof and HVAC in 2022. As a resident, enjoy access to the private oceanfront beach house, a community pool overlooking historic rice fields, and the serene, gated surroundings of Litchfield Plantation. Conveniently located near Pawleys Island shops, dining, golf, Brookgreen Gardens, and Huntington Beach State Park—with Myrtle Beach just 20 miles north and Charleston 60 miles south. Live your best Lowcountry lifestyle—this move-in ready home awaits!

Elegant Elevated Living in Historic Litchfield Plantation. Discover refined coastal living in this beautifully upgraded townhouse, located within the historic, gated community of Litchfield Plantation in Pawleys Island. From the moment you enter the main gates, a breathtaking avenue of centuries-old live oaks welcomes you home, setting the tone for the elegance and serenity that define this exceptional property. Designed for elevated living, the main level features plantation shutters throughout and a thoughtfully crafted open floor plan that flows seamlessly from the living room to the dining area and chef’s kitchen—perfect for both everyday comfort and entertaining. The chef’s kitchen is a true showpiece, featuring a gas range, separate Frigidaire Professional Series refrigerator and freezer, a spacious pantry, and a shiplap-accented island that adds coastal charm and sophistication. The main-level primary suite offers a private retreat, complete with a separate seating area, a luxurious en-suite bath, and a custom walk-in closet. A convenient half bath and laundry room complete the main floor. The lower level includes an extended one-car garage, two generously sized guest bedrooms, and a shared full bath. Both bedrooms open to a screened porch, which leads to an extended patio—ideal for relaxing and enjoying the Lowcountry breeze. Residents of Litchfield Plantation enjoy exceptional amenities, including a community pool overlooking scenic rice fields and exclusive access to a private oceanfront beach house on Pawleys Island—delivering the ultimate Lowcountry lifestyle. This is a rare opportunity to own a high-grade townhouse that seamlessly blends historic surroundings, luxury finishes, and unparalleled coastal amenities.

Experience elevated Lowcountry living in this stunning 2022-built residence, perfectly positioned on a total of 1.66 acres overlooking the historic Carolina Gold Ricefields. With three combined lots and an expansive stretch of tidal creek frontage, this property offers unmatched privacy, panoramic views, and room to create the outdoor retreat of your dreams—whether that includes a guest house, pool house, or a custom pool designed to frame the breathtaking water and wildlife vistas. This thoughtfully designed two-story home blends modern craftsmanship with timeless Lowcountry charm. Inside, the main level features an impressive two-story living room with soaring ceilings and a wall of UV-resistant windows that flood the home with light while capturing the sweeping views of the ricefields. The spacious kitchen includes premium upgrades such as a wine fridge, trash compactor, and a reverse osmosis water filtration system. Two bedrooms, including a primary suite, are located on the main level, with an additional guest suite upstairs—perfect for privacy and versatility. Built for both comfort and resilience, the home includes a whole-house generator, on-demand tankless gas water heater, gutter guards, and a dual-function irrigation system that can run from either river water or county water. A central vacuum system adds convenience throughout. Outdoor living is at the heart of this property. Enjoy the stone paver patios at the front and back of the home, an outdoor fireplace and grill, and ample space for future expansions. A 50-Amp exterior outlet provides easy accommodation for electric vehicles. Residents of Litchfield Plantation enjoy access to the community pool and the exclusive private beach house, along with the rich history, charm, and natural beauty that define this iconic community. A rare offering of acreage, modern luxury, and unspoiled Lowcountry scenery—this is a property that truly stands apart.

Single-Story Ranch with Breathtaking Carolina Gold Ricefield Views This single-story ranch-style home offers spectacular panoramic views of the historic Carolina Gold Ricefields and sits on over an acre of tidal creek frontage. Majestic live oaks surround the property, creating an authentic Lowcountry feel that is both timeless and serene. Inside, you’ll find a spacious great room, a centrally located kitchen, and a separate dining room—each designed to take full advantage of the incredible natural scenery. The home features two master suites and an office/study with views that are simply unforgettable. From the great room, dining room, and study, you can enjoy sweeping vistas of the ricefields and abundant wildlife that frequent the creek. This is single level Lowcountry living at its best. Beyond the home, residents enjoy access to Litchfield Plantation’s community pool and private beach house, along with all the charm and history this iconic community has to offer. Adding to its unique story, this was the first single-family residence built in Litchfield Plantation. The home was commissioned by Wolfgang Jansen, former President of Georgetown Steel, who came from Germany and oversaw its construction. Recent improvements include the installation of three basins, all connected with a drain line extending beyond the home and releasing water toward the creek, ensuring proper drainage and long-term property health. A rare blend of heritage, craftsmanship, and natural beauty, this home is a true Lowcountry treasure.

Pristine Townhome in Litchfield Plantation! Welcome to 99 Vineyard Place, immaculate 3-bedroom, 3-bath townhome built in 2022, located in the prestigious gated community of Litchfield Plantation—one of Pawleys Island’s most sought-after addresses. Surrounded by breathtaking live oaks, residents enjoy exceptional amenities including a stunning pool complex overlooking the rice fields, an exclusive oceanfront beach house, and an optional private marina. Thoughtfully designed for comfort and style, this open-concept home features two bedrooms and two baths on the main level, with a third ensuite bedroom upstairs—ideal for guests or a private retreat. The spacious kitchen offers granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a walk-in pantry, large island, and breakfast bar that flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas, perfect for entertaining. The private primary suite boasts a walk-in shower, double vanity with granite countertops, linen closet, and a generous walk-in closet. Additional highlights include plantation shutters, abundant natural light, a private patio, and a one-car garage with shelving. Generous storage areas, perfect for a primary residence if desired. Residents of Litchfield Plantation enjoy access to the community pool and clubhouse, optional marina, and the exclusive Oceanfront Beach House at 148 Atlantic Avenue, featuring parking, restrooms, showers, a picturesque boardwalk, and indoor relaxation areas. After a day at the beach, return home for a golf cart ride beneath the tranquil, oak-lined streets of this historic community. Ideally located near top-rated golf courses, fine dining, boutique shopping, and just a short drive to Charleston to the south and Myrtle Beach to the north—this move-in ready home at 99 Vineyard Place is a rare opportunity not to be missed. Call today to schedule your private tour!

descriptions.desc: Pristine, polished, and beautifully appointed, 205 Berwick Drive embodies timeless Lowcountry elegance and relaxed coastal living within the prestigious, gated Heritage Plantation Community. Enter the community beneath a magnificent canopy of century-old live oaks, where winding roads meander alongside the award-winning golf course toward the Waccamaw River. Tucked away on a quiet side street, this appealing all-brick residence is surrounded by mature landscaping and a fully fenced backyard. A decorative brick-paver driveway adds charm and curb appeal. The move-in-ready home features a desirable split-bedroom floor plan with three bedrooms, two baths, a Carolina Room, spacious office, laundry room and a conditioned bonus room above the side-load two-car garage. Recent updates include an HVAC system installed in 2021 and professionally maintained, a water heater installed in 2024, a whole-house air purification system installed in November 2025, custom-made metal storm shutters and a transfer switch and panel installed in the garage for a portable generator. Inside, an abundance of windows, glass doors, skylights, solar tubes, and decorative transoms fill the home with natural light. The beautifully appointed kitchen offers a vaulted ceiling, tile flooring, granite countertops, abundant custom cabinetry, pantry, and a spacious sink and counter seating. The adjacent dining area overlooks the backyard and provides convenient access to the patio and grilling area. A two-sided gas-log fireplace connects the dining area to the family room while complementing the open, vaulted-ceiling design. A 100-gallon underground propane tank supplies the outdoor gas grill on the patio and the family room fireplace. The propane system also provides the capability to power an industrial-grade generator, gas range, home heating system, and clothes dryer. The main living area flows into a conditioned Carolina Room, where surrounding glass doors frame peaceful views of the manicured backyard. This inviting space is ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying the beauty of the outdoors throughout the seasons. The primary suite offers a private retreat with a ceiling fan, large walk-in closet, and direct access to the back patio. Its vaulted ensuite bath includes a double-sink vanity, separate sitting vanity, jetted tub, and walk-in shower. Two spacious guest bedrooms offer ceiling fans and ample closet space, with one providing direct access to the Carolina Room. Positioned between the guest bedrooms, the guest bath includes a vanity sink, shower, linen closet and skylight. A generously sized office overlooks the landscaped front yard and offers an ideal work-from-home space. The laundry room includes a full-size washer and dryer, utility sink, cabinetry, and closet storage. The attached two-car garage provides ample storage along with a workbench and located above is a versatile and convenient bonus room that also provides storage space. With its exceptional setting, thoughtful floor plan, extensive updates, and beautifully maintained outdoor spaces, 205 Berwick Drive is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of Lowcountry living. Heritage Plantation residents enjoy 24-hour security and an impressive array of amenities, including a large swimming pool, Har-Tru clay tennis courts, pickleball courts, croquet green, children’s playground, and owners’ clubhouse with fitness center, party room, and card room. The community-owned marina features an entertaining party deck overlooking the Waccamaw River, a dock house operated by a full-time dockmaster, 40 boat slips, a boat ramp, and dry-dock storage. The Heritage Plantation Golf Course, designed by Dan Maples, is ranked among Golf Digest’s “50 Best Public Courses in America.” Conveniently located near premier golf courses, exceptional restaurants, unique shops, boating and other water activities, and miles of beautiful ocean beaches, Heritage Plantation offers an unparalleled coastal lifestyle.

Extensively updated golf-course home in Heritage Plantation! Welcome to 20 Wentworth Place, a beautifully refreshed 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home situated directly on the Heritage Club golf course in one of Pawleys Island's most sought-after gated communities. Since July 2024, the current owner has completed an impressive list of improvements, including a new roof, upgraded kitchen, fresh interior paint throughout, plantation shutters and window blinds, new flooring throughout, updated landscaping, new garage door opener and tension bar, screened-in covered patio, new HVAC condensers and new thermostats. Luxury vinyl flooring was added throughout the first floor in 2026, with new carpet installed upstairs and in the primary bedroom in 2024. Inside, the home offers a bright and inviting floor plan centered around a spacious living room with vaulted ceilings, fireplace and views toward the golf course. The renovated kitchen features white cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, tile backsplash, generous workspace and a large center island. The adjoining breakfast area flows easily into the screened porch, creating a great setup for everyday living and entertaining. The first-floor primary suite provides privacy from the additional bedrooms and includes a large walk-in closet and private bath. Upstairs are three additional bedrooms and a full bath, offering plenty of flexibility for guests, family, office space or hobbies. A formal dining area, dedicated laundry room, powder room and attached two-car garage complete the layout. Outside, enjoy the Lowcountry setting from the newly screened covered patio overlooking the golf course. The backyard has also been refreshed with new lawn and landscaping, creating an attractive outdoor space surrounded by mature trees. Heritage Plantation offers an exceptional Pawleys Island lifestyle with a clubhouse, swimming pool, tennis and pickleball courts, fitness facilities, security, marina access and golf. Just minutes from the beaches, restaurants and shopping of Pawleys Island, 20 Wentworth Place combines location, golf-course views and a long list of recent improvements into a home that is truly move-in ready.

A must-see, move-in-ready, beautifully designed home in Heritage Plantation! This exceptional home has 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, a 3/2024 roof, 12/2024 HVAC, two fireplaces, two private patios, and an oversized 2.5-car garage, a unique home combines quality construction, thoughtful design, comfort, and functionality. Enter through the foyer into an impressive open-concept living area featuring vaulted ceilings, an electric fireplace, accent uplighting, dining area, and breakfast nook. The beautifully appointed kitchen offers light granite countertops, whitewashed maple cabinetry, an updated backsplash, under-cabinet lighting, a deep lighted pantry, and 2025 gas range and dishwasher. The spacious primary suite is a true retreat with double tray ceilings, an elongated double vanity, an oversized walk-in shower with dual shower heads, linen storage, and a generously sized walk-in closet that conveniently connects directly to the laundry room. The laundry room provides exceptional functionality with additional pantry storage, cabinetry, a built-in ironing station, and an additional refrigerator. The desirable split-bedroom floor plan includes two guest bedrooms sharing a second full bath on the main level. Completing the first floor is an oversized, beautifully decorated Carolina Room with a gas fireplace. Two newly designed private patios border the Carolina Room, providing wonderful spaces for outdoor seating, entertaining, and grilling while overlooking the peaceful, wooded setting. Upstairs, a private guest suite features a full bath with shower and a nook ideal for a desk, reading area, or additional seating. An expansive walk-in attic located just off the bedroom provides exceptional easily accessible storage. The oversized 2.5-car garage offers room for two vehicles and a golf cart, along with a built-in workshop area and utility sink. An extended driveway provides plenty of additional parking for family and guests. Situated at the end of a cul-de-sac, the property offers an added sense of privacy and tranquility. Heritage Plantation offers an exceptional coastal lifestyle with an owners' clubhouse, fitness center, large swimming pool, tennis courts, pickleball courts, and playground. Take a golf cart ride to the spectacular marina and enjoy the large party deck overlooking the Intracoastal Waterway. For boating enthusiasts, wet slips, a boat ramp, and dry storage are available. Quality construction and attention to detail are abundant throughout this meticulously maintained home. With its thoughtful floor plan, extensive storage, beautiful indoor and outdoor living spaces, recent major-system updates, and peaceful setting, this home truly is the total package. Call today and begin enjoying the best of coastal living in Heritage Plantation!

Tucked inside Heritage Plantation, this three-bedroom, two-bath brick home offers a comfortable layout, classic curb appeal, and a backyard scene that knows how to slow the day down. The open floor plan keeps the main living areas connected, so conversations can travel easily from the living room to the kitchen without anyone missing the good parts of dinner or the latest family story. A formal dining room adds a more polished space for holidays, celebrations, or takeout that you plate nicely and call entertaining. In the kitchen, granite countertops bring both style and durability, while the breakfast nook looks out over the generous backyard and mature trees. Just beyond, the screened porch is made for morning coffee, evening breezes, and those moments when doing absolutely nothing feels like an accomplishment. The newly installed concrete patio adds even more room for cookouts, visiting with neighbors, or testing your skills as the unofficial weekend grill expert. Roof replaced in 2022, HVAC replaced in 2021, New Patio Installed 2025, New Gutters 2026, New Hot Water Heater 2026 and redesigned landscaping in backyard in 2025. Life here extends well beyond the front door. Heritage Plantation offers a peaceful setting with convenient access to the Intracoastal Waterway for boating, kayaking, and fishing, plus unforgettable sunsets over the Waccamaw River. The beach is only a short drive away, making salt air and sandy walks easy to work into your routine. Daily errands are simple too, with grocery shopping nearby. If you have been looking for a home that blends comfort, outdoor enjoyment, and a true Pawleys Island lifestyle, make time to see this one in person.

PRICE REDUCED! Experience ultimate Lowcountry luxury at 292 Portrush Loop. To provide absolute peace of mind, the motivated seller is offering a generous credit to buyer for roof replacement and a 1-year premium home warranty with an acceptable offer! Enjoy sweeping marsh and marina views with zero upcoming maintenance worries. Welcome to 292 Portrush Loop, a remarkable custom-built waterfront estate in the prestigious gated community of Heritage Plantation. Set against sweeping views of the marsh, marina, and Intracoastal Waterway, this exceptional residence offers more than 5,300 heated square feet of refined living space and an extraordinary Lowcountry boating lifestyle. Designed for both comfort and flexibility, the home features primary suites on two levels. The ground-floor suite is ideal for convenient one-level living, while the upper-level owner’s retreat offers elevated privacy and panoramic waterfront views. Complete with a private laundry room and kitchenette, the upstairs suite feels like a secluded sanctuary. Built with lasting quality and peace of mind in mind, the residence includes impact-rated hurricane windows and doors, energy-efficient construction, a whole-house generator, and an elevator serving every floor. Expansive windows fill the interior with natural light while showcasing spectacular water views from nearly every room. Inside, custom cherry cabinetry, extensive millwork, soaring ceilings, and three fireplaces create an atmosphere of warmth and timeless sophistication. The chef’s kitchen features premium Viking appliances, generous preparation space, custom cabinetry, and an open layout designed for everything from intimate dinners to large-scale entertaining. Spacious guest suites provide exceptional comfort and privacy for family and visitors. A dedicated laundry room on the guest level adds another layer of convenience. Outdoor living is equally impressive. Multiple covered balconies and inviting gathering areas provide the perfect setting for enjoying coastal breezes, breathtaking sunsets, and the ever-changing scenery of the marsh, marina, and Intracoastal Waterway. For boating enthusiasts, Heritage Plantation’s deep-water marina is located directly behind the home, providing convenient access to the Intracoastal Waterway. The marina offers deep-water slips accommodating vessels up to 60 feet, along with 50-amp shore power—making spontaneous days on the water effortless. Heritage Plantation residents enjoy an exceptional collection of amenities, including an award-winning golf course, an elegant golf clubhouse, a private owners’ clubhouse overlooking the marina, a heated and cooled 50-meter lap pool, tennis courts, new pickleball facilities, scenic walking trails, and the added security of a 24-hour gated community. An oversized, climate-controlled garage completes the property, offering abundant space for multiple vehicles, golf carts, boating equipment, recreational gear, and a workshop. More than a luxury waterfront residence, 292 Portrush Loop is a rare opportunity to experience boating, golf, and gracious coastal living in one of the South Carolina Lowcountry’s most desirable communities.

Opportunities like this don’t come around often in Pawleys. Set on approximately 1.05 acres inside Heritage Plantation, one of the most sought-after gated communities on the South End, 140 Heritage Drive has the kind of space, setting, and feel that is hard to find. From the moment you walk in, it just feels right. Wide open spaces, natural light, and a layout that flows the way you want it to. The main living areas connect effortlessly, with wood floors, high ceilings, and just enough detail to give it character without feeling overdone. The Carolina room is one of those spots you’ll keep coming back to, whether it’s slow mornings or having people over. The views out back really set this one apart. The kitchen is dialed in with a large island and prep sink, quartz countertops, high-end Monogram appliances, a wine cooler, and plenty of space to actually use. It opens into a casual dining area and a comfortable keeping room with a fireplace, creating a seamless, connected living space. This home is set up as a five bedroom, three and a half bath layout. The primary suite is tucked away on the main level with a sitting area, oversized closet, and a clean, well-done bath with double vanities, soaking tub, and walk-in shower. Also downstairs are two additional bedrooms connected by a Jack and Jill bath, both with large closets, along with another flexible room that works well as a bedroom, office, or additional guest space. Not to mention you’ve got a powder room and a solid laundry area on the main level. Upstairs, the room over the garage is currently being used as a guest room and gives you even more flexibility depending on how you want to use the space. The garage goes beyond just parking, with built-ins, a dedicated work area, and a Tesla charger already in place. Outside is where this one really separates itself. A custom screened-in porch was added with wide steps and railings leading down to a large paver patio, creating a true indoor-outdoor setup. A natural flagstone pathway winds through a hydrangea garden and connects to a dedicated play area. The driveway has been extended with a clean brick border that ties everything together. Mature landscaping, privacy, and a setting that’s hard to replicate. Residents of Heritage Plantation enjoy 24-hour gated security and a strong lineup of amenities including a pool, Har-Tru clay tennis courts, pickleball, croquet, a playground, and a clubhouse with fitness center, gathering spaces, and card room. The marina on the Intracoastal Waterway adds another layer, with a social deck, dock house with full-time dockmaster, boat slips, ramp access, and dry storage.This is one of those homes where the lot, layout, and feel all come together. All measurements and data are deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Purchaser and or purchaser’s professional to verify.

Introducing 376 Congressional Drive, an exquisite Lowcountry residence nestled within the serene and sought-after Heritage Plantation of Pawleys Island. If you are looking for privacy, this is the property for you as it backs to a large wooded area. This 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home offers ample space and seclusion, ideal for outdoor gatherings and leisure activities. Featuring dual master bedroom suites, one on each level, this property ensures adaptability and comfort. The expansive living area showcases a gas fireplace, illuminated built-in shelving, and LVT flooring, while the kitchen dazzles with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and bar seating. Additional highlights encompass a versatile bonus/media room, a spacious office, formal dining room, and a two-car garage. Upstairs, two supplementary bedrooms share a full bath, complementing the secondary master suite. Residents of Heritage Plantation enjoy an array of amenities, including a distinguished golf course, community center, tennis facilities, and a full-service marina featuring wet-slips and a boat ramp. Recent updates include New Roof, New Gutters, New Exterior Paint, New Frameless Shower and Soaking Tub, New Sinks with Waterfall Faucets throughout, New Buried Propane 600 Gallon Tank, and the list continues. Please review full list in Associated Documents. Seize the opportunity to own a beautiful property within one of Pawleys Island's most amenity-rich neighborhoods. Welcome to your new home!

Experience timeless Lowcountry living in Heritage Plantation, one of Pawleys Island's premier gated Intracoastal Waterway and golf course communities. Nestled beneath a canopy of majestic live oaks on a beautifully wooded homesite, this elegant 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence offers exceptional craftsmanship, spacious living, and the relaxed coastal lifestyle that makes Heritage Plantation one of the area's most desirable addresses. Designed with both comfort and convenience in mind, this thoughtfully planned home features three bedrooms on the main level, including a spacious primary suite, providing the ease of one-level living while offering plenty of room for family and guests. Soaring ceilings, rich hardwood flooring, abundant natural light, and timeless architectural details create a warm, inviting atmosphere throughout. The spacious great room flows effortlessly into the well-appointed kitchen, complete with granite countertops, a center island, abundant cabinetry, and generous workspace—ideal for entertaining or everyday living. Just beyond, the bright and airy Carolina room is the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee, unwind with a good book, or gather with friends while overlooking the private, beautifully landscaped backyard. The main-level primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a large walk-in closet and an ensuite bath featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath are also located on the main level. Upstairs, a private fourth bedroom with its own full bath creates the perfect guest suite, media room, hobby room, or flexible living space. Downstairs, a dedicated office with custom built-ins, a convenient powder room, and an oversized garage with abundant storage complete this exceptional floor plan. Recent upgrades include new roof in 2022. Newer AC units, stove, custom size refrigerator, microwave, brand new security system, water heater, carpet and toilet in bonus room, with fresh paint throughout. Beyond the home, residents enjoy the outstanding amenities that make Heritage Plantation one of the Lowcountry's most coveted communities. Amenities include a championship golf course, 75-foot owners' swimming pool, hot tub, Har-Tru clay tennis courts, pickleball courts, a fully equipped fitness center, and a full-service marina with boat ramp providing direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway and the scenic Waccamaw River. Beautiful tree-lined streets, mature landscaping, and an active social atmosphere create an unmatched Lowcountry lifestyle. Ideally located just minutes from the pristine beaches of Pawleys Island, Brookgreen Gardens, Huntington Beach State Park, boutique shopping, exceptional dining, and the renowned MarshWalk, this home offers the perfect blend of elegance, recreation, and coastal living. Discover why Heritage Plantation remains one of Pawleys Island's most sought-after communities and schedule your private showing today. ***The seller is offering comprehensive buyer's incentives to include a Home Warranty and generous concessions toward buyer's closing cost.***

Set on a corner lot in Heritage Plantation, this one-owner, brick home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a comfortable single level floor plan with an open living area and fireplace. The screened porch overlooks a private backyard creating a quiet place to relax while enjoying the natural surroundings. One of the property's unique features is the added privacy along the left side of the home, where golf course owned wooded land borders the driveway, providing a natural buffer with no neighboring home beside you. A two-car garage and mature landscaping complete the exterior. Lovingly maintained over the years, this home is ready for your personal updates and offers a great opportunity to make it your own in one of Pawleys Island's most established gated communities. Heritage Plantation residents enjoy a community pool, tennis and pickleball courts, playground, marina on the Waccamaw River, and the option to join the Heritage Club golf course. Conveniently located just minutes from beaches, shopping, dining, and everything that makes Pawleys Island such a special place to call home.

Tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac beneath a canopy of mature trees, this beautifully updated home offers the perfect blend of privacy, elegance, and everyday comfort in one of Pawleys Island's most sought-after gated communities Heritage Plantation. From the moment you walk inside, you'll notice this home was designed for the way people actually live. The spacious, light-filled floor plan flows effortlessly from room to room, creating inviting spaces for entertaining friends, hosting family gatherings, or simply enjoying a quiet evening at home. The completely renovated kitchen is the centerpiece of the home, featuring custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, stunning Vetrostone quartz and glass countertops, under-cabinet lighting, and a dedicated coffee and wine bar that's ready for your morning routine or evening unwind. The adjoining Carolina Room and multiple outdoor living spaces create seamless indoor-outdoor living surrounded by lush landscaping and peaceful natural views. The oversized primary suite feels like a private retreat with a beautifully remodeled spa-inspired bath, generous walk-in closet with motion-sensor lighting, and a relaxing sitting area. Two additional bedrooms, a spacious loft/mezzanine that's perfect for a home office, art studio, media room or guest retreat, plus an abundance of storage make this home as functional as it is beautiful. Thoughtful upgrades can be found throughout, including LeafGuard gutters, a 50-year transferable roof warranty, iron filtration for the irrigation system, retractable deck awning, pocket doors, pull-down attic storage, USB-equipped outlets, motion-sensor lighting, a separate water line for the coffee station, and a tranquil Zen-inspired fountain that enhances the peaceful outdoor setting. Living in Heritage Plantation means enjoying an exceptional lifestyle with a private owner's clubhouse, fitness center, swimming pool, tennis courts, new pickleball courts, marina access, golf, and a vibrant community atmosphere just minutes from Pawleys Island beaches, exceptional restaurants, shopping, and some of the finest golf courses on the Grand Strand. If you've been searching for a home that offers timeless character, thoughtful updates, incredible community amenities, and a setting that truly feels like your own private retreat, 444 Dornoch Drive deserves a place at the top of your list.

Nestled within the prestigious gates of Heritage Plantation, one of the South Carolina coast’s most sought-after golf and marina communities, 358 Doral Place offers an exceptional blend of timeless Lowcountry elegance, thoughtful upgrades, and resort-style living. Situated on a beautifully landscaped homesite surrounded by mature trees and lush gardens, this meticulously maintained all-brick residence offers approximately 2,864 square feet of comfortable living space with three bedrooms, two-and-a-half baths, a dedicated office, and inviting indoor and outdoor gathering spaces designed for both everyday enjoyment and effortless entertaining. From the moment you arrive, the care and pride of ownership are immediately evident. Mature landscaping, enhanced natural light from selective tree removal, and extensive garden improvements create a welcoming first impression. Inside, custom built-in bookcases added to both the family room and office provide warmth, character, and functionality while enhancing the home’s architectural appeal. The spacious floor plan flows effortlessly from room to room, offering generous living areas filled with natural light. The kitchen has been enhanced with updated appliances including a newer refrigerator and a brand-new Bosch dishwasher. A newer washer and dryer provide additional convenience. Beyond the interior, the outdoor living spaces have been thoughtfully transformed. A beautifully finished patio and garden retreat create the perfect setting for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or evening gatherings. A newly added pathway, expanded hardscape areas, flowering azaleas, and extensive landscape improvements provide a private backyard sanctuary that blooms with color throughout the seasons. Additional updates include: • Custom built-in shelving in family room and office • New refrigerator • New washer and dryer • New hot water heater • New Bosch dishwasher • Updated irrigation system with rain-sensing controller • Seamless gutters and drainage improvements • Expanded patio and garden spaces • Extensive landscaping enhancements including 27 azalea plantings • Tree removal and trimming to enhance natural light and curb appeal • Improved pathways and foundation protection around sunroom What truly sets this property apart is its location within Heritage Plantation, a private gated community renowned for its unmatched amenities and coastal lifestyle. Residents enjoy: • 24-hour gated security • Championship Heritage Golf Club • Private marina with access to the Intracoastal Waterway • Boat storage and launch facilities • Tennis and pickleball courts • Resort-style swimming pool and spa • Fitness center • Owners’ clubhouse • On-site restaurant and social activities • Scenic walking and biking opportunities beneath centuries-old live oaks Just minutes from the pristine beaches of Pawleys Island, renowned dining, boutique shopping, world-class fishing, and the historic charm of Georgetown, this home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the very best of Lowcountry living. 358 Doral Place is more than a home—it is a lifestyle defined by elegance, recreation, and the relaxed sophistication that has made Heritage Plantation one of the Grand Strand’s most treasured communities.

Welcome to 30 Prestwick Drive, located in the prestigious gated community of Heritage Plantation, one of the most sought-after neighborhoods in Pawleys Island’s 29585 zip code. Nestled along the Intracoastal Waterway, Heritage Plantation offers an unmatched Lowcountry lifestyle with world-class amenities including a private marina, Owners Club featuring a fitness center, meeting space, showers, swimming pool, pickleball courts, clay tennis courts, and one of the South Strand’s premier golf courses. Residents also enjoy the iconic Plantation Clubhouse with its restaurant and bar overlooking the historic rice fields and marshlands, providing breathtaking views year-round. This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home is truly move-in ready and showcases an impressive list of upgrades throughout. The stunning kitchen has been completely transformed with elegant quartz countertops, premium stainless-steel appliances including Bosch stove, dishwasher, and microwave, upgraded cabinetry with soft-close doors, under-cabinet lighting, and modern fixtures that create a space as functional as it is beautiful. The home’s interior has been thoughtfully enhanced with updated flooring, skylights featuring remote-controlled shades, a gas fireplace insert, upgraded lighting fixtures, ceiling fans, dimmers, remotes, plumbing, and electrical improvements throughout. A new HVAC system and ductwork provide comfort and efficiency. Both bathrooms have been tastefully remodeled with custom showers, custom cabinetry, upgraded countertops, and designer finishes. The spacious primary suite features a custom-designed walk-in closet, while one of the guest bedrooms offers a custom Murphy bed with built-in cabinetry, maximizing both function and flexibility. The laundry room has been completely reimagined with custom cabinetry, countertops, a utility sink, and a convenient pull-down hanging rack. The garage has also been upgraded with built-in cabinetry and countertops, creating an organized and user-friendly workspace. One of the home’s most desirable features is the enclosed four-season room, transformed from the original covered patio and enhanced with custom cabinetry, mini-split HVAC, new windows, and a storm door, providing year-round enjoyment and additional living space. Outside, the meticulous landscaping creates exceptional curb appeal with decorative edging, sod, mature plantings, trees, stone accents, a paver patio, paver walkways, fencing, a new irrigation pump, and sprinkler system. Additional improvements include a new hot water heater and the replacement of all original windows in 2024. Every detail has been thoughtfully considered, making this exceptional Heritage Plantation home a rare opportunity for buyers seeking luxury, comfort, and peace of mind. Simply move in and start enjoying everything this remarkable home and community have to offer.

A half-acre with views of the 2nd fairway. All brick. One owner. Custom-built. The kind of homesite and home that don't come up often in Heritage Plantation. Set behind a tree-lined drive on a 0.54-acre lot framed by mature live oaks, tall pines, and established landscaping, 474 Muirfield Drive offers space, privacy, and the warmth of a single-level ranch designed and lovingly maintained by its original owners. Inside, oak hardwood floors and crown molding run through the main living areas. The family room anchors the home with antique exposed beams, a brick wood-burning fireplace with a substantial hearth, and a full wall of built-in bookshelves. Two sets of French doors open out — one to a freshly rebuilt deck, the other to a standout screened porch with vaulted ceiling and ceiling fans. Sliding glass doors from the kitchen also open to the porch, creating a true second dining space for al fresco entertaining. The kitchen features cherry cabinetry with glass-front display cabinets, tile floors, generous workspace, and a casual eat-in dining area, with a pantry, laundry/utility room with mud sink, and walk-in larder just beyond. A formal living room with vaulted ceiling and a wall of windows, a formal dining room with vintage brass chandelier, a half bath off the kitchen, three bedrooms including a generously sized primary suite with bay window and walk-in closet, two full baths, an outdoor shower, side-load 2-car garage, and a whole-house stainless steel hurricane protection system round out the home. Heritage Plantation is one of the few Grand Strand communities offering both a championship golf course and a deep-water marina on the Waccamaw River — with the marina, junior Olympic pool, har-tru tennis, pickleball, fitness center, and owners' clubhouse all included in the HOA. Gated, patrolled, and minutes from Pawleys Island beaches, Brookgreen Gardens, and the shops and restaurants of Highway 17. Homes like this — golf course view, custom-built, all-brick, one-owner, half-acre — don't often come available in Heritage. 474 Muirfield Drive is ready for its next chapter.

This lovely all brick home is located in the sought after Heritage Plantation. Built around the highly rated Heritage Golf Club, the community features beautiful natural surroundings with ponds, and century old Live Oaks. It offers all the amenities you desire such as a lap sized pool, 4 Har-Tru tennis courts, 4 pickle ball courts, clubhouse with fitness center, marina with boat launch, boat slips and decking, and dry dock storage! On site is a dock master and an on site Property manager. This beautiful well manicured .41 acres lot has been lovingly cared for. Extremely private back yard with plenty of room for a pool if that is your desire. But if nature and peacefulness is what you're after, just enjoy the wildlife that visit and the beautiful lush landscape. The roof, HVAC and hot water heater all have been replaced in the last few years. The three bedrooms on the main level are a split floor plan. The 4th bedroom/bonus room has a 1/2 bath. The Carolina room has all new windows, flooring and is now heated and cooled. The Primary bedroom is spacious with doors that open to the deck. Also, a walk in closet, double sink vanity and jetted tub with a separate shower. The garage is immaculate and extra large at 24 x 27 feet deep so plenty of room for 2 cars and a golf cart....which you will want to ride down to the marina for the incredible sunsets! This part of the neighborhood has sidewalks to enjoy your morning walks. There is a bridge at the 10th tee box that allows you to walk, bicycle or cart ride over to the main area for easy access to all the amenities. This is a must see house and neighborhood. Call for your private showing today!

Welcome to Heritage Plantation — Where Timeless Lowcountry Charm Meets Refined Coastal Living Perfectly positioned at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac framed by centuries-old live oaks draped in Spanish moss, this beautiful brick and stucco single-level home offers approximately 2,400 square feet of elegant living in one of Pawleys Island’s most sought-after gated communities. Set along the 3rd fairway of the Heritage Golf Course, this home captures tranquil views and soft coastal breezes that make every day feel like a retreat. Designed for comfort and style, it features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and an office or craft room with its own fireplace — ideal for work, creativity, or quiet relaxation. The heart of the home is the updated kitchen (2019), showcasing HOLT custom cabinetry, GE Profile/Monogram stainless-steel appliances, and refined finishes that balance beauty and functionality. The open floor plan flows easily into the dining and living areas, leading to a bright Carolina Room where floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light and frame sweeping golf course views. The primary suite offers a peaceful escape with a walk-in closet, double vanities, whirlpool tub, and separate shower. Additional highlights include plantation shutters, luxury laminate flooring (2022), and a Trane HVAC system (2019) with smart controls. Recent updates provide peace of mind and lasting appeal — new high-impact insulated windows (2024), a new roof and leaf guard system (2024), fresh exterior paint (2025), and a new driveway (2023). Outdoors, the shaded backyard with Empire Zoysia sod, mature landscaping, and motion lighting creates a tranquil setting for gatherings, golf course sunsets, or simply enjoying the sounds of nature. Beyond your backyard, Heritage Plantation offers a lifestyle unlike any other along the Grand Strand. Residents enjoy 24-hour gated security, an Olympic-sized pool, fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, and a beautifully maintained marina on the Intracoastal Waterway. The marina features a full-time dockmaster, boat and kayak storage, RV parking, and dry dock facilities, making it effortless to enjoy boating and fishing right from your own community. Spend the day exploring winding creeks by kayak, fishing or crabbing in Pawleys Creek, or cruising the scenic Intracoastal Waterway out to the ocean. Heritage Plantation’s prime Pawleys Island location means you’re just minutes from boutique shops, family-owned restaurants, world-class golf, and the pristine Pawleys Island beaches — all within a 5–10 minute drive. Experience refined Lowcountry living where every day feels like a vacation. Schedule your private showing today and discover why Heritage Plantation remains one of the most treasured communities on the South Carolina coast. What are you waiting for? You and your family deserve this home. Relax… I’ll take it from here®. Note: Square footage is approximate and should be verified by the buyer.

When envisioning your ideal Pawleys Island retreat, be sure to place this exceptional property at the top of your list. This single-story brick ranch home sits on a beautifully maintained lot, lovingly cared for by its original owner, and surrounded by exquisite year-round gardens that create a true sense of serenity. Upon entering the foyer, you are welcomed by impressive 11-foot ceilings that immediately enhance the home’s open and airy feel. The living room centers around a charming wood-burning fireplace, offering a natural gathering point for family and friends. A wall of expansive windows offers stunning views of the lush outdoor sanctuary, seamlessly blending indoor comfort with the beauty of the surrounding landscape. One of the standout features of this home is the spacious screened porch addition, thoughtfully designed to provide a peaceful transition to the private backyard. This inviting space is ideal for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or evening relaxation while enjoying the coastal breeze. The kitchen comes fully equipped with all major appliances and offers convenient connectivity to the dining room, making it easy to entertain or enjoy casual meals. The primary suite is generously sized and filled with natural light, leading into a recently remodeled ensuite bathroom complete with dual sinks and a walk-in closet. The split-bedroom floor plan ensures privacy for guests, with a pocket door that allows the secondary bathroom to function as an ensuite when needed. The third bedroom offers flexibility as either an office with built-ins or a traditional bedroom layout as it includes both a closet and a door. Additional features include a dedicated laundry room and a two-car side-load garage with pull-down attic access for extra storage. Heritage Plantation is renowned for its extensive amenities and 24/7 security, making it one of the area’s most desirable communities. Residents enjoy access to a community pool, four tennis courts, four pickleball courts, a fitness center, marina, and clubhouse. Internet and cable services are also included, adding to the convenience and value of this exceptional neighborhood.

Introducing 376 Congressional Drive, an exquisite Lowcountry residence nestled within the serene and sought-after Heritage Plantation of Pawleys Island. If you are looking for privacy, this is the property for you as it backs to a large wooded area. This 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home offers ample space and seclusion, ideal for outdoor gatherings and leisure activities. Featuring dual master bedroom suites, one on each level, this property ensures adaptability and comfort. The expansive living area showcases a gas fireplace, illuminated built-in shelving, and LVT flooring, while the kitchen dazzles with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and bar seating. Additional highlights encompass a versatile bonus/media room, a spacious office, formal dining room, and a two-car garage. Upstairs, two supplementary bedrooms share a full bath, complementing the secondary master suite. Residents of Heritage Plantation enjoy an array of amenities, including a distinguished golf course, community center, tennis facilities, and a full-service marina featuring wet-slips and a boat ramp. Recent updates include New Roof, New Gutters, New Exterior Paint, New Frameless Shower and Soaking Tub, New Sinks with Waterfall Faucets throughout, New Buried Propane 600 Gallon Tank, and the list continues. Please review full list in Associated Documents. Seize the opportunity to own a beautiful property within one of Pawleys Island's most amenity-rich neighborhoods. Welcome to your new home!

Welcome to 973 Doral Drive — a beautifully crafted Lowcountry home tucked beneath a canopy of live oaks and set along the 3rd Fairway of the Heritage Club. From the moment you arrive, this classic Southern residence feels special. Brick walkways, mature landscaping, and a welcoming front porch set the tone for a home that is warm, gracious, and exceptionally well cared for. Inside, thoughtful design and quality craftsmanship shine throughout. The foyer opens to bright, connected living spaces filled with natural light. The Great Room features soaring ceilings, a cozy brick-surround gas fireplace, built-ins, and French doors that lead to the screened porch. The formal dining room, enhanced with tall wainscoting and crisp trimwork, offers the perfect setting for holiday gatherings and everyday meals. The kitchen blends warmth and function with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, upgraded appliances, a center island, and a built-in home management station. A sunlit breakfast nook sits just steps away, flowing naturally into the keeping room—an inviting second living space with backyard views. A side hallway leads to a large laundry/utility room with walk-in larder, powder room, and garage entry. The main-level primary suite is a peaceful retreat with generous windows, dual walk-in closets, double vanities, a soaking tub, and a tiled walk-in shower. Upstairs, the guest level includes three comfortable bedrooms, two full baths, a versatile loft, and a charming office nook with built-ins and a window seat. Outdoor living is a highlight here. The screened porch with vaulted ceiling with skylights and stone flooring is the perfect place to enjoy morning coffee or evening breezes. Brick pathways wind through beautifully landscaped grounds toward sweeping views of the golf course. Whether hosting friends, enjoying quiet moments, or simply taking in the natural setting, the backyard feels like its own private retreat. Buyers will appreciate the important updates already in place: the roof was replaced in 2019 (with remaining warranty), the hot water heater was replaced in 2021, and the home includes ongoing HVAC and termite protection plans. A dedicated irrigation meter supports the beautifully maintained landscaping. Located within Heritage Plantation—one of Pawleys Island’s most beloved gated communities—residents enjoy exceptional amenities including the Owners’ Clubhouse, fitness center, pool, tennis and pickleball courts, private marina, and championship golf. All just minutes from the Intracoastal Waterway, local shops, dining, and the beautiful beaches of Pawleys Island. Warm, welcoming, and filled with Lowcountry charm, 973 Doral Drive offers a lifestyle that feels peaceful, connected, and easy to love.

Spacious Coastal Home in Heritage Plantation! Discover a fantastic floor plan with plenty of space to spread out and enjoy coastal living. This home features a great room with wood-burning fireplace, skylights and wet bar, a den/office, and a loft with skylights for added charm. Relax in the Carolina Room or on the patio overlooking a wooded view and water feature. The layout includes a formal dining room plus a breakfast nook in the kitchen—perfect for entertaining. Update this home to suit your taste and make it your own! Heritage Plantation offers amenities galore, including an owners’ clubhouse with pool, tennis/pickleball courts, exercise room, marina on the Waccamaw River/Intracoastal Waterway, a beautiful golf course with clubhouse, gated entrance, and more!
