descriptions.desc: Pond View! Welcome to 208 Beechwood Court, nestled in the highly desirable Myrtle Trace 55+ community in Conway, South Carolina! This well cared for 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers approximately 1,768 square feet of inviting living space, thoughtfully designed for comfort, relaxation, and effortless coastal living. Step inside to discover soaring vaulted ceilings that create a bright, open, and airy atmosphere, Oversized french doors which open to the rear gated patio overlooking the pond, beautiful granite kitchen countertops, stainless steel appliances, laundry room, custom tile floors, garden tub and much more. One of the home’s standout features is the oversized Carolina room, offering the perfect setting to enjoy your morning coffee, unwind with a good book, or simply take in the tranquil pond views. Surrounded by mature trees and established landscaping, this property offers a peaceful retreat within one of the area’s most sought-after active adult communities. Residents of Myrtle Trace enjoy wonderful amenities, including a clubhouse, outdoor swimming pool, shuffleboard, bocce ball, and a variety of social activities that encourage an engaging and welcoming lifestyle. Conveniently located near Conway Medical Center, golf courses, shopping, dining, and the beautiful beaches of the Grand Strand, this home offers the perfect combination of serenity and accessibility. Whether you’re looking to downsize without sacrificing comfort or embrace the next chapter of coastal Carolina living, 208 Beechwood Court is ready to welcome you home. Schedule your private showing today and experience the charm of Myrtle Trace! Room measurements are approximate; Buyer to verify. All major kitchen & laudry appliances convey.

Welcome to 255 Candlewood Drive, a beautifully updated waterfront home tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the highly sought-after Myrtle Trace community. From the moment you walk in, this home feels bright, open, and exceptionally well cared for, but what truly sets it apart is the setting. Out back, you’ll find a peaceful and private retreat overlooking the water, with mature surroundings that create a wonderful sense of separation. Whether you’re enjoying your morning coffee, entertaining friends, or simply relaxing at the end of the day, the backyard and water views make this home feel like your own private escape. Inside, the spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bath Charleston floor plan offers approximately 2,326 heated square feet with a thoughtful split-bedroom design that provides plenty of privacy for both owners and guests. The living area flows naturally into a light-filled Carolina room surrounded by windows overlooking the water, creating a comfortable space that brings the outdoors in. The kitchen has been beautifully refreshed with quartz countertops, refaced cabinetry, new soft-close doors and drawers, cabinet rollouts, updated electrical outlets and island lighting, a newer range hood, garbage disposal, and faucet. The adjoining dining and living areas are comfortable and inviting, while updated lighting and luxury vinyl plank flooring give the home a clean and cohesive feel throughout. The primary suite is privately positioned on its own side of the home and features a large walk-in closet, tray ceiling, ensuite bath with a separate walk-in shower and jetted tub, and convenient access toward the backyard. On the opposite side of the home, two additional bedrooms and baths provide an excellent setup for family and guests, including a rear bedroom with its own attached bath. This is also a home where many of the most important improvements go well beyond what you can see. The owners have invested in high end updates and improvements, including a high-efficiency Bosch heat pump, air handler, and new ductwork installed in 2025, an Ecobee thermostat, all-new Window World windows, luxury vinyl plank flooring, a 50-gallon water heater, and a Halo H2 whole-home water filtration system. The kitchen improvements are complemented by a Frigidaire induction range with built-in air fryer and a newer Frigidaire French-door refrigerator. Additional improvements include updated lighting, new kitchen electrical outlets, new pull-down attic stairs, paint, blinds, and numerous other updates throughout the home. Several of the major improvements also include remaining or transferable warranty coverage; buyers should verify applicable warranty terms and transfer requirements. The oversized 22’ x 24’ two-car garage provides additional storage, pull-down attic access, a utility sink, and convenient access to the yard. Myrtle Trace offers a relaxed lifestyle with community amenities including a clubhouse, outdoor pool, and recreation areas. The location is another major advantage, providing convenient access to shopping, restaurants, medical facilities, golf, entertainment, and everyday necessities while still allowing you to come home to a peaceful residential setting. Bright, extensively updated, beautifully maintained, and positioned on a private waterfront setting, 255 Candlewood Drive offers the combination of comfort, privacy, location, and significant recent improvements that can be difficult to find. With so much invested into the home, much of the work has already been done. All that’s left is for the next owner to move in and enjoy it.

Located on a serene corner Lot with Pond views in the highly desirable Myrtle Trace 55+ Community is this well maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath home. The show stopper is the oversized screened-in patio, an incredible outdoor living space with storage room accessible from the Living Room, Primary Bedroom and the Den/Bonus Room. Relax and enjoy your morning coffee or an evening cocktail while enjoying the Carolina weather. New HVAC installed February 2026 and freshly painted as well as LVP and tile flooring throughout! Enjoy the relaxed lifestyle Myrtle Trace is known for with Golf, Clubhouse/Saltwater Pool, community events, shuffleboard and Bocce Ball Court. Centrally located to shopping, dining, medical and a short drive to the Beach. Spend your days golfing, soaking up the Sun by the pool with friends or enjoying the activities at the clubhouse. This isn't just a home, it's an opportunity to enjoy the laid back lifestyle you've been waiting for! Some photos have been virtually staged.

MOTIVATED SELLERS! Located in the desirable 55+ community of Myrtle Trace, this well-maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers comfortable living with serene pond views. The inviting living room features a beautiful built-in fireplace with custom bookcase surround, while the spacious Carolina room is filled with natural light from floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors overlooking the rear deck and pond. The kitchen offers abundant cabinet and counter space along with newer appliances, including a refrigerator (1.5 years), dishwasher (2 years), and stacked washer and dryer. Luxury vinyl plank flooring extends throughout the main living areas, with tile in the kitchen, bathrooms, and laundry room. The carpeted primary suite features a walk-in closet, private access to the rear deck, and an updated ensuite bath with a granite-top vanity and tiled walk-in shower. Two additional guest bedrooms are carpeted, including one with a convenient Murphy bed, and share a guest bath with a granite-top vanity. Relax or entertain on the spacious rear deck overlooking the pond, complete with two attached storage closets for added convenience. Myrtle Trace surrounds Burning Ridge Golf Course and is ideally situated between Highways 501 and 544, providing easy access to the beaches, shopping, dining, and entertainment of the Grand Strand. This home is an excellent choice for a primary residence, vacation retreat, or investment opportunity.

Welcome to this charming home in the highly desirable 55+ community of Myrtle Trace, where peaceful living meets a golfer's paradise. This well-positioned home offers a relaxing outdoor space with a pleasant view of the surrounding golf course from your private back patio. Step inside to an inviting, open-concept living area featuring vaulted ceilings and expansive windows that fill the space with natural light while showcasing the scenic golf course backdrop. Freshly painted throughout and featuring all new carpeting, this home offers a bright, refreshed, and welcoming atmosphere that is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The sunroom is an ideal retreat for relaxing with a good book, sipping your morning coffee, or simply taking in the tranquil views. Residents of Myrtle Trace enjoy wonderful community amenities, including a clubhouse and swimming pool, along with beautifully maintained grounds filled with mature trees and lush landscaping that create a quiet, peaceful setting. Conveniently located near downtown Conway, Carolina Forest, the Grand Strand, and the area's beautiful beaches, you'll also find an abundance of shopping, dining, golf, and everyday conveniences just minutes away. Whether you're looking for a primary residence or the perfect second home, this hidden gem offers comfort, convenience, and a relaxed lifestyle in one of the area's most welcoming communities.

Opportunity awaits in the highly desirable 55+ community of Myrtle Trace! Priced to sell, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers incredible potential to make it your own while enjoying a peaceful golf course setting on the 11th hole of the Burning Ridge Golf Course.
